581.de: In the foreground on the right, a tall corner of a house and a wooden plank fence running parallel to the picture plane, with a small house at its edge. A narrow path leads to the house from the front, with two human figures on it. Further back, another fence with bare trees and houses visible in the distance. The ground and roofs covered with snow.

610.d: Lõuendil ligi 11/12 enda alla võtva lagendiku keskel istub last imetav naine.

611.de: In the foreground an old man with a woman and two children. The smaller of them is in the woman's lap. In the background a post mill.

612.d: Paremal tütarlaps ja vanamees jalgupidi vees; vasemal kaks naist. Taustaks küngas hoonetega.
612.de: On the right a girl and an old man standing in water; on the left two women. In the background a hill with buildings.

613.d: Esiplaanil jõgi mida läbimas mehi hobustega. Tagapool tõusev maastik. Fooniks mets.
613.de: In the foreground a river being crossed by men with horses. Further back a rising landscape. Forest as background.

614.d: Esiplaanil kolm kaluri figuuri paadis angerja mõrda tühjendamas. Tagapool paat kahe naise ja ühe mehe figuuriga angerjamõrra juures.
614.de: In the foreground, three fisherman figures in a boat emptying an eel trap. Further back, a boat with the figures of two women and one man by an eel trap.

616.d: Ees keskel esijalgupidi mutta vajunud härg profiilis vasakule. Paremal heledapäine tüdruk. Taga soomaastik laugaste ja üksiku jändriku männiga.
616.de: In the front in the middle a bull sunk into the mud up to its front legs, in profile to the left. On the right a fair-haired girl. Behind, a bog landscape with pools and a single gnarled pine.

617.d: Esiplaanil kõrged vanad lehtpuud. Vasakul taluhoone nurk. Puude tüvede vahelt vaade taluhoonetele. Keskel puude all sammuv naisfiguur selgvaates.
617.de: In the foreground tall old deciduous trees. On the left the corner of a farm building. Between the tree trunks a view of the farm buildings. In the middle a woman's figure walking under the trees, seen from the front.

618.d: Sügisene maastik. Esiplaan lage, pruunides toonides. Teisel plaanil reana küpressikujulised puud, paremal kaks madalat hoonet. Paremal maaliservas teisel plaanil metsatukk. Tagaplaanil lage maastik. Taevas sinine tuules tormavate tumedate pilvedega. Pintslitõmbed pikad.
618.de: An autumn landscape. The foreground bare, in brown tones. On the second plane a row of cypress-shaped trees, on the right two low buildings. On the right edge of the painting, on the second plane, a small patch of forest. In the background a bare landscape. The sky blue with dark clouds rushing in the wind. The brushstrokes long.

619.d: Esiplaanil kaks paati madalas vees. Esimesel ümber hulk inimesi. Keskel paadis mees purje kokku panemas, paremal poiss pruuni hobuse seljas, vasakul kaks naist.
619.de: In the foreground, two boats in shallow water. Around the first, a number of people. In the middle, a man in a boat folding up a sail; on the right, a boy on a brown horse; on the left, two women.

620.d: Tumedates rohekates ja pruunikates toonides kompositsioon. Esiplaanil alepõletaja ja kündja, kaugemal lehmakari.
620.de: Composition in dark greenish and brownish tones. In the foreground a slash-and-burn farmer and a ploughman, further away a herd of cows.

621.d: Sinakasrohelistes ja pruunides toonides külamaastik talumajade ja roigasaedadega lehtpuude vahel.
621.de: Village landscape in bluish-green and brown tones with farmhouses and pole fences among deciduous trees.

622.d: Rohekas-punakal tumedal taustal paremal ülaltpoolt ahenev hallikas kann väikeseõieliste, roosakates õiekobarates lilledega. Maalitud hoogsalt, vineertahvel kumb läbi värvi.
622.de: Against a greenish-reddish dark background, on the upper right a narrowing greyish jug with small-flowered, pinkish clusters of flowers. Painted vigorously, plywood board showing through the paint in places.

623.d: Ees, diagonaalselt alt paremast nurgast vasakusse serva kalapaatide rivi, mille vahel askeldavad inimesed hobuveokitega. Paremal all neli naisefiguuri võrkude juures. Taamal paistavad kaks kalurihütti. Merepind tumeroheline, taevas pilvine.
623.de: In front, diagonally from the lower right corner to the left edge, a row of fishing boats, among which people are busy with horse-drawn carts. On the lower right four female figures by the nets. In the distance two fishermen's huts can be seen. Sea surface dark green, sky cloudy.

624.d: Sinakas-rohekas koloriidis maastik. Vasakus servas all kaks kadakat. Paremal kaob diagonaalse joonena pildi sügavusse metsaviirg. Taevas mõned valkjad pilved.
624.de: Landscape in bluish-greenish colouring. In the lower left corner two junipers. On the right a strip of forest recedes into the depth of the picture as a diagonal line. A few whitish clouds in the sky.

634.d: Hobune meesratsanikuga ja hobusest vasakul naisfiguur kasukas, püss seljas, käsi ette sirutatud. Nii naisel kui mehel talvised rõivad, sõjaeelsed eestis levinud üles keeratud servaga ja kuklas seosega lambanahksed talimütsid;naine lühikeses kasukas, seljal püss, parem käsi hobuse turjal,
634.de: A horse with a male rider, and to the left of the horse a female figure in a fur coat, a rifle on her back, hand stretched out in front. Both the woman and the man are in winter clothing, pre-war Estonian sheepskin winter caps with turned-up edges and a bow at the back of the head, current at the time; the woman in a short fur coat, a rifle on her back, right hand on the horse's withers,

635.de: A male figure resting on his left knee, right leg bent at the knee, sailor's clothing, a helmet on his head, right hand throwing a grenade, left hand bent to the side.

670.d: Eest vasemalt taha paremale looklev jõgi sillaga esiplaanil. Vasakul ja paremal jõe kaldal hooned.
670.de: A river winding from left to right in front, with a bridge in the foreground. Buildings on the left and right riverbanks.

671.d: Esiplaanil naise ja mehe figuurid vikatitega, paremal vankri juures hobune ja kaks inimfiguuri.
671.de: In the foreground figures of a woman and a man with scythes, on the right a horse and two human figures by a cart.

672.d: Esiplaanil lootsiku juures kolm meest vestlemas. Tagapool vasakul kaks naist, paremal mees tule ääres. Keskel jõekallas lotjadega, taamal linnamaju.
672.de: In the foreground, by a boat, three men talking. Further back on the left two women, on the right a man by a fire. In the centre a riverbank with barges, in the distance town houses.

673.d: Esiplaanil küntud põllulapp. Taamal veekogu ääres hoonete grupp. Horisondil mets.
673.de: In the foreground a ploughed field patch. In the distance a group of buildings by a body of water. Forest on the horizon.

674.d: Esiplaanil kaks palki maas, keskel üksiku männi juures maas istuv mees piibuga, selle kõrval püsti naine lapsega süles. Taamal ehitusel oleva maja juures töötav mees.
674.de: In the foreground two logs on the ground, in the middle a man sitting on the ground by a lone pine with a pipe, next to him a standing woman with a child in her lap. In the distance a man working by a house under construction.

675.d: Esiplaanil paremal kivivedamise vanker, keskel kaks püstiseisvat inimkuju. 'nende taga vanker hobusega ja teisi seisvaid inimkujusid. Taamal üksik mänd ja talu õlgkatus.
675.de: In the foreground on the right a cart for hauling stone, in the middle two standing human figures, behind them a cart with a horse and other standing human figures. In the distance a solitary pine and a farm's thatched roof.

677.d: Laual maalitud teekann, pudel ja taldrik kahe sidruniga.
677.de: On the table, a painted teapot, a bottle and a plate with two lemons.

678.d: Esiplaanil muinasaegseid sõjamehi istumas, püsti ja hobustel, paremal ääres kaks naist seljaga vaataja suunas. Taamal hooneid.
678.de: In the foreground ancient warriors sitting, standing and on horseback, on the right edge two women with their backs to the viewer. Buildings in the distance.

679.d: Ees vasakul kuue haralise lehtpuu all pink ja laud toidunõudega. Laua juures kolme naise figuur. Paremal ees kivil istuv naine. Keset õue kaev loomajootmise künaga ja kahe inimfiguuriga. Taga õlgkatusega talumaja. Selle parempoolse nurga juures vanker ja kaks hobust.
679.de: In front on the left, under a six-branched leafy tree, a bench and a table with food vessels. By the table, the figures of three women. On the right in front, a woman sitting on a stone. In the middle of the yard, a well with a trough for watering animals and two human figures. Behind, a thatched-roof farmhouse. At its right-hand corner, a cart and two horses.

680.d: Ees vasakul jõekaldal kaks hoonet ja puid. Tagapool künklik maastik jõgede, puude ja üksikute hoonetega.
680.de: In front on the left on the riverbank two buildings and trees. Behind a hilly landscape with rivers, trees and individual buildings.

681.d: Esiplaanil kaks naist viljakottidega; (pisut tagapool) grupp mehi tegevuses - ühed veoautole kotte laadimas, teised kotte kaalumas; vasemal naisi ja mehi hobuste ja vankridega. Taga keskel töötajad viljapeksumasina juures, paremal kaks kõrget õlerõuku ja talumaja.
681.de: In the foreground two women with grain sacks; (a little further back) a group of men at work - some loading sacks onto a lorry, others weighing sacks; on the left women and men with horses and carts. Behind in the centre workers by a threshing machine, on the right two tall straw stacks and a farmhouse.

683.d: Lõuna-Eesti maastik. Vaade kollendavalt viljapõllult madalamal asetsevale maastikule koos põldude, hoonete, üksikute puude ja metsaga. Metsa taga veepind. Horisonti piirab helesinine riba.
683.de: A South Estonian landscape. View from a yellowing grain field onto a landscape lying lower, with fields, buildings, single trees and forest. Beyond the forest a body of water. The horizon is bordered by a light-blue strip.

687.d: Esiplaanil paralleelselt pildipinnale suur rühm muistseid sõdureid piikidega. Rühma keskel osa mehi hobuste seljas. Fooniks järvede ja metsatukkadega maastik.
687.de: In the foreground, parallel to the picture plane, a large group of ancient soldiers with pikes. In the middle of the group some men on horseback. Background a landscape with lakes and clumps of forest.

692.d: Esiplaanil kivine rand üksiku lootsiku ja roigastulpadega; tagaplaanil meri.
692.de: In the foreground a stony shore with a lone boat and pole stakes; in the background the sea.

693.d: Esiplaanil põllud kollendava viljaga, tagapool heinamaa puutukkadega. Tagaplaanil mets.
693.de: In the foreground fields with yellowing grain, behind a meadow with clumps of trees. In the background a forest.

694.d: Esiplaanil üksikud raagus puud. Tagaplaanil kivihoonete varemed.
694.de: In the foreground single bare trees. In the background ruins of stone buildings.

695.de: Vase with handle with multicoloured blooms.

696.d: Esiplaanil lumine tänav. Plankaia taga aedades maju ja raagus puid.
696.de: In the foreground a snowy street. Behind the plank fence, houses in gardens and bare trees.

697.d: Esiplaanil paremal veekogu kolme purjekaga. Vasakul kallas puudega. Tagaplaanil majade rida.
697.de: In the foreground on the right a body of water with three sailboats. On the left a bank with trees. In the background a row of houses.

699.d: Ees paremal tool üle seljatoe visatud riideesemega. Keskel vasakul ümmargune laud ühele servale kuhjatud linaga, vaasi, tassi ja väikese töökorviga. Laua taga tool. Taga paremal avatud ukse ees lamamistool. Avatud uksest vaade aeda.
699.de: In front on the right, a chair with a garment thrown over its back. In the centre on the left, a round table with a cloth heaped to one side, a vase, a cup and a small work basket. Behind the table a chair. At the back on the right, a chaise longue in front of an open door. Through the open door a view of the garden.

700.d: Ees vasakul töötav viljapeksumasin. Ümber masina askeldavad inimesed. Keskel kaks härga viljakokkuveosaani ees. Tagapool põhuvirnad. Tagaplaanil mäed.
700.de: In front on the left a working threshing machine. People bustling around the machine. In the middle two oxen in front of a grain-hauling sledge. Further back stacks of straw. In the background, mountains.

701.d: Tõmmunahalise tütarlapse portree - rinnapilt peaaegu en face. Peas rätik. Kaelas tume helmerida.
701.de: Portrait of a dark-skinned girl - bust almost en face. A scarf on her head. A dark string of beads around her neck.

702.d: Vasakul toolide najale seatud lõuendite ees reas istuvad Roos, Soonpää, Lukats, Hoidre, Semper, Adamson, Aavik, Sagrits; taga akna ees seisavad Sannamees ja Okas.
702.de: On the left, in a row in front of canvases set against chair backs, sitting are Roos, Soonpää, Lukats, Hoidre, Semper, Adamson, Aavik, Sagrits; behind, standing in front of the window, are Sannamees and Okas.

703.d: Esiplaanil vasakul tihe rühm demonstrante punase lipu ja loosungitega; nende esiridadest hulk langenuid kivisillutisel maas. Rühma ees keskel noor naine püsti, surudes vasaku käega oma ees seisvat tüdrukukest enda vastu. Parem käsi sajatavalt kõrgele tõstetud. Pildi paremal äärel rühm laskmiseks rivistunud soldateid, püssid palgel; püsside kohal laskmisest tekkinud suitsuvine. Tagapool paremale suunduval tänaval verise sündmuse juurest pagevaid inimesi. Taustaks vasakul puuderühm, keskel ja paremal maju.
703.de: In the foreground on the left, a dense group of demonstrators with a red flag and slogans; in their front ranks, a number of fallen lying on the stone pavement. In front of the group, in the middle, a young woman stands upright, pressing a little girl standing in front of her against herself with her left hand. Her right hand is raised high, cursing. On the right edge of the picture, a group of soldiers lined up for shooting, rifles at the cheek; above the rifles, the wisp of smoke from firing. Further back, on a street leading to the right, people are fleeing from the bloody event. In the background on the left a group of trees, in the middle and on the right, houses.

708.d: Esiplaanil laud lillede ja puuviljadega. Selle ees näoga vaatja poole valge kübaraga naine õun (?) käes. Laua otsas lõuendi parempoolses osas seljaga vaataja poole tumedajuukseline figuur istumas; tema taga meesfiguur. Tagaplaanil linna siluett kiriku ja tornidega. Koloriit rohekas-hall.
708.de: In the foreground a table with flowers and fruit. In front of it, facing the viewer, a woman in a white hat with an apple (?) in her hand. At the end of the table, in the right part of the canvas, a dark-haired figure sitting with their back to the viewer; behind them a male figure. In the background a city silhouette with a church and towers. The colour scheme greenish-grey.

711.d: Roheka varjundiga seinte ja põrandaga ruumis, ümmarguste laudade ääres mees- ja naisfiguur. Paremal suur aken. Taga vasakul orkester.

712.d: Ees vasakul istuvad naine ja poiss. Nende taga kaks seisvat noormeest, paremal kaks meest kalakorviga. Taga purjekas.
712.de: In front on the left a sitting woman and boy. Behind them two standing young men, on the right two men with a fish basket. A sailboat in the background.

713.d: Esiplaanil madal kallas, põõsaga paremal ääres. Keskel veekogu purjekaga, taamal vees peegelduv linna siluett kirikutorniga.
713.de: In the foreground a low shore, with a bush at the right edge. In the middle a body of water with a sailboat, in the distance the silhouette of a city with a church tower reflected in the water.

714.d: Triibulisel riidel pruun vaas kirjude põllulilledega.
714.de: On striped fabric a brown vase with colourful meadow flowers.

716.d: Esiplaanil neli inimest rehade ja vikatitega õlal. Keskplaanil paremal puu, vasakul kolm puud, mille ees kolm hobust rohtu söömas. Tagaplaanil künklik maastik.
716.de: In the foreground four people with rakes and scythes on their shoulders. In the middle ground on the right a tree, on the left three trees, in front of which three horses are grazing. In the background a hilly landscape.

718.d: Esiplaanil käänuline oja vesikuppude ja rohtukasvanud kallastega. Paremal kasesalu, vasemal vaade künklikule maastikule metsaga.
718.de: In the foreground a winding stream with water-lilies and grassy banks. On the right a birch grove, on the left a view of a hilly landscape with forest.

719.d: Toolil seisev kirju vaas, milles kimp mitmesuguseid lilli: rukki-, mooni-, nisuõisi jt. Taust valge, kahel pool pruunikad pinnad.
719.de: A patterned vase standing on a chair, holding a bouquet of various flowers: rye, poppy, wheat blossoms, etc. Background white, with brownish planes on both sides.

720.d: Esiplaanil valge linaga kaetud laud, mille taga vasakul istub naise poolakt otsevaates. Paremal profiilis teine istuv naine kollase- ja mustatriibulises kleidis, kohvitassiga käes; tema vastupeegeldus näha peeglis. Foon tumepunane.
720.de: In the foreground a table covered with a white cloth, behind which on the left a woman's half-nude figure sits in frontal view. On the right, in profile, a second seated woman in a yellow- and black-striped dress, holding a coffee cup; her reflection visible in a mirror. Background dark red.

721.d: Alasti naise istuv põlvfiguur, parem käevõruga käsi kuklal, vasak suu juures, maalitud heledalt. Foonil punane ja roheline draperii. Vasakul ümmargusel laual tumedates toonides natüürmort kannuga.
721.de: Sitting knee-length figure of a nude woman, right hand with a bracelet on the back of the neck, left hand near the mouth, painted in light tones. In the background red and green drapery. On the left, on a round table, a still life in dark tones with a jug.

722.d: Kollases interjööris esiplaanis kaks seisvat rohekasmusta naisfiguuri. Neist vasakul ja paremal lauad istuvate figuuridega. (eesti)
722.de: In a yellow interior, in the foreground two standing greenish-black female figures. To their left and right tables with seated figures.

723.d: Esiplaanil keskel musta rõivastatud daam valges kübaras punase laua taga. Temast vasakul mustas rõivastuses otsevaates mees punase laua taga.
723.de: In the foreground centre a lady dressed in black wearing a white hat behind a red table. To her left a man dressed in black, seen frontally, behind the red table.

724.d: Hallika balustraadi ja sinise taeva foonil mees ja naine lamamistoolides. Vasakul kaetud laud.
724.de: Against a background of a greyish balustrade and blue sky, a man and a woman in deck chairs. To the left a set table.

725.d: Kompositsioon heledas kleidis naise ja kolme maskeraadikostüümis mehega.
725.de: Composition with a woman in a light-coloured dress and three men in masquerade costumes.

726.d: Oranžil foonil istuv naise figuur. Pea pööratud paremale, parema käega toetub toolile, vasak lebab vabalt süles. Tooli kõrval ornamendiga kaetud kann.
726.de: A seated female figure on an orange background. Head turned to the right, resting with the right hand on a chair, the left lying freely in the lap. Beside the chair a jug covered with ornament.

727.d: Ümmargusel, osaliselt roosa linaga kaetud laual tagaplaanil kaks suurt kõrgekaelalist keraamilist kannu, nende kõrval paremal kõrvuti kaks väikest vaasi. Viimaste ees laual vasakul tume, kõrgel jalal tühi puuviljavaas, selle ees laual kaks kirssi. Helesinine foon.
727.de: On a round table partly covered with a pink cloth, in the background two large tall-necked ceramic jugs, next to them on the right two small vases side by side. In front of the latter on the table on the left a dark, empty fruit bowl on a high stem, in front of it on the table two cherries. Light blue background.

2399.de: Landscape motif with trees in light nuanced tones, finely painted throughout.

2419.d: Pruunides sukkades täidlane naisakt rohelisel diivanil, pea pööratud, vasak käsi seljatoele toetumas. Diivani ees paremal ümmargune laud nikerdatud jalaga ja suur kummipuu. Kahvatud roosad ja rohelised toonid, hõredate pintslilöökide vahelt kumab läbi paberi pind.
2419.de: A full-figured female nude in brown stockings on a green sofa, head turned, left hand resting on the backrest. In front of the sofa on the right a round table with a carved leg and a large rubber plant. Pale pink and green tones, the surface of the paper glowing through between sparse brushstrokes.

2424.d: Maali paremas servas, ümmarguse laua juures seisab tumedas ülikonnas mees ja parema käega tooli seljatoele toetuv, heledas seelikus ning pluusis naisefiguur. Vasakul esiplaanil suur pott mingi toataimega. Viimase taga, ruumi sügavuses, küljega vaataja poole lehte lugev naine.
2424.de: On the right side of the painting, by a round table, stands a man in a dark suit, and a female figure in a light-coloured skirt and blouse leaning with her right hand on the back of a chair. In the foreground on the left, a large pot with some houseplant. Behind it, in the depth of the room, a woman reading a newspaper, seen sideways to the viewer.

2426.d: Vasakul, pliidi ääres seisev noor naine, paremas käes oleva kulbiga liigutab auravas potis, vasakuga asetab valge purgi pliidiservale. Naisel seljas õlapaeltega kleit, pearätt peas. Tagapool kolme ruuduga aken, aknalaual potilill, paremal taburett. Maalitud sinakashallis heledas koloriidis õhuliselt, üldistavalt, kohati värvipinda sisse kraapides.
2426.de: On the left, a young woman standing by the stove is stirring in a steaming pot with a ladle in her right hand, while placing a white jar on the edge of the stove with her left. The woman is wearing a dress with shoulder straps, a headscarf on her head. Behind, a window with three panes, a potted plant on the windowsill, a stool on the right. Painted airily and in a generalised manner in a light bluish-grey colour scheme, in places scratching into the paint layer.

2429.d: Etüüdlikus laadis teostatud maastik lagendiku ning taamal olevate suurte lehtpuude grupiga. Värvid pastelsed - roheline, sinine. Maalitud suures osas pahtli või maalinoaga.

2430.d: Ees valge, lamav härg. Tema turjale astumas naine, keda selja tagant toetab mehefiguur. Paremal ja vasakul pool härga kaks põlvitavat figuuri. Tagapool kolm maani rüüdes naist. Vasakul puud. Maalimislaad etüüdlik; värvigamma hele.
2430.de: In front, a white, lying bull. A woman stepping onto its back, supported from behind by a male figure. On the right and left of the bull, two kneeling figures. Behind, three women in floor-length robes. On the left, trees. The painting style is study-like; the colour range light.

2431.d: Kohviku vaade. Keskel ukseava, millest paremal, akna all istuvad kaks meest. Uksest vasakul valge, klaasidega kapp ning pikk, madal lett. Viimase nurga juures seisab heledas särgis kelner, ees valge põll. Maalimislaad impressionistlik.
2431.de: View of a café. In the middle a doorway, to the right of which, under a window, sit two men. To the left of the door a white cabinet with glasses and a long, low counter. At the end of the latter stands a waiter in a light shirt, with a white apron in front. Impressionistic painting style.

3189.d: Esiplaanil paremal väike veekogu, selle taga nurgas tumedate põõsastega, keksel luitunud toonides luht, taamal sinetav metsamüür. Esiplaanil vasakul mägi üksikute mändidega, põõsad pruunika mäerinnaku taga. Taevas kergelt pilves.
3189.de: In the foreground on the right a small body of water, behind it in the corner dark bushes, in the middle a meadow in faded tones, in the distance a bluish forest wall. In the foreground on the left a mountain with solitary pines, bushes behind a brownish mountain ridge. The sky slightly cloudy.

3214.d: Allservas vasakul maadligi katusega hallikaspruun talumaja, mida ümbritsevad luhtunud toonis lehtedega kaetud puud ja põõsad. Paremal mitmeharuline, peenikeste tüvedega, peaaegu kõik lehed kaotanud puu, tuulest sasitud. Pildi kompositsiooniliseks keskpunktiks on suurte, halli servaga valgete pilvedega kaetud ähvardav taevas. Maalitud hallides ja pruunides toonides, allservas on puude lehed ja rohelus maas antud pastoossete värvikänkratena.
3214.de: In the lower part on the left a grayish-brown farmhouse with a low-hanging roof, surrounded by trees and bushes covered with faded-toned leaves. On the right a multi-branched tree with thin trunks, having lost almost all its leaves, tousled by the wind. The compositional focal point of the picture is the threatening sky covered with large white clouds with gray edges. Painted in gray and brown tones, in the lower part the leaves and greenery of the trees on the ground are rendered as pastose lumps of paint.

3215.d: Kompositsiooni keskpunktis on ähvardav llillakashall (ülalt erksinine) taevas, mida kroonib keskel asuv tohutu valge pilvekuhil. Pilvekuhilast allpool, maa kohal, tumehallide pilvede riba. Allservas vasakul pastoosse värviga antud puud. Paremal luitunudroheline niit tuuliku ja tumerohelise puuderibaga silmapiiril.
3215.de: At the centre of the composition is a menacing purplish-grey (bright blue at the top) sky, crowned in the middle by a huge white cloud mass. Below the cloud mass, above the ground, a band of dark grey clouds. In the lower left, trees rendered in impasto. On the right a faded green meadow with a windmill and a dark green strip of trees on the horizon.

3216.d: Halli kikkhabeme, vuntside ja hallide, laubalt pisut taandunud juustega mehe rinnaportree poolpöördes vasakule. Mehel tugev nina, tõsine ilme, seljas veinpunane särk ja lips ning rohekashall pintsak. Mehe parema õla kohal, pildi vasakus servas tumerohelise värviga maskeeritud linnatornid. Foon keskelt lillades, ülal hallides toonides. Foonil ülal vasakul värvikihti kraabitud vapi kontuurid.
3216.de: A bust portrait, in half-turn to the left, of a man with a grey goatee, moustache and grey hair somewhat receded at the forehead. The man has a strong nose, a serious expression, wearing a wine-red shirt and tie and a greenish-grey jacket. Above the man's right shoulder, at the left edge of the picture, city towers disguised in dark green paint. The background in the middle in shades of purple, above in shades of grey. In the background, upper left, the contours of a coat of arms scratched into the paint layer.

3217.d: Pikkade, kaunilt kaarduvate lokkidega heledapäise tütarlapse portree veerandpöördes paremale. Tütarlapsel helesinised silmad, kergelt püstjas nina, kauni vormiga väike suu. Seljas pruun kampsun, mille kaelusest paistab veinipunase pluusi krae. Foon hallides ja beežides toonides. Maalipind kohati pastoosne, juuste piirkonnas on värvikihti pintslivarrega jooni veetud.
3217.de: Portrait of a fair-haired girl with long, beautifully curling locks, in a quarter-turn to the right. The girl has light blue eyes, a slightly upturned nose, a small beautifully shaped mouth. She wears a brown jumper, from whose collar the collar of a wine-red blouse shows. The background is in grey and beige tones. The paint surface is pastose in places, in the hair area lines have been drawn into the paint layer with the brush handle.

3218.d: Esiplaanil jupike karjamaast paremal rohtu sööva loomaga ja kogu pilti horisontaalselt läbiva roigasaiaga. Aia taga puudesse ja põõsastesse mattunud väike punane maja, paremal servas puudegrupp. Taamal paistab tumesinine meri ja kahvatu taevas. Maalitud pisikeste, säbrulist maalipinda loovate pintslilöökidega.
3218.de: In the foreground a patch of pasture with an animal grazing on the right and a pole fence running horizontally across the whole picture. Behind the fence a small red house buried among trees and bushes, on the right edge a group of trees. Further away a dark blue sea and a pale sky are visible. Painted with small brushstrokes creating a rippled paint surface.

3219.d: Pildi vasemas ja paremas servas osa kalurihütist. Vasakul esiplaanil, maja kõrval kolm peene tüvega puud. Majade vahel rannaks üleminev muruplats üksiku punasesse riietatud figuuriga kaldal. Taamal keskel kollakas meri ja aurik, ülaservas hallikas taevas. Maalitud väikeste säbruliste pintslilöökidega.

3220.d: Esiplaanil väike abajas maanina, millel kolm punakate katustega kalurihütti. Vasakul servas rannal ja vees suured kivid, keskel osalt kaldale tõmmatud paat. All paremas nurgas osa lähivaates antud paadist ja mastidest. Taamal ülal sügavsinine meri, ülaservas ribake kahvatut, lillaga varjutatud taevast. Maalitud peamiselt sinakasrohelistes ja punakates toonides, kohati pastoosselt.
3220.de: In the foreground a small bay-like headland with three fishermen's huts with reddish roofs. On the left edge, on the shore and in the water, large stones, in the middle a boat partly pulled up onto the shore. In the bottom right corner, part of a boat and masts seen in close-up. In the distance above, a deep blue sea, at the top edge a strip of pale sky shaded with lilac. Painted mainly in bluish-green and reddish tones, in places impasto.

3661.d: Suvine maastikumotiiv taluga. Ees lattaiaga piiratud külateel ema lapsega. Aia taga kõrgete mändide-kuuskede all talumaja, õues kaev. Kaugemal tume metsaviirg. Jõuline, kohati pastoosselt vormiv maalilaad. Tumedad rohelised toonid.
3661.de: Summer landscape motif with a farmstead. In the foreground, a mother with a child on a village road bordered by a pole fence. Behind the fence, under tall pines and spruces, a farmhouse, with a well in the yard. In the distance, a dark strip of forest. Vigorous, at times pastose modelling painting style. Dark green tones.

3664.d: Etüüdilik kompositsioon rannikul toimetavatest kaluritest. Esiplaanil naised valgete rättide ja seelikutega, kaldal triivivad paadid. Lainetav rohekas meri ulatub silmapiirini, jättes taevale kitsa riba.
3664.de: A sketch-like composition of fishermen at work on the coast. In the foreground women with white kerchiefs and skirts, boats drifting by the shore. The wavy greenish sea reaches to the horizon, leaving a narrow strip for the sky.

3675.de: The head of a youth with a garrison cap, elongated face, the neck area ends with a collar and a necktie knot

3772.d: Esiplaanil koristatud põld. Keskel üksik puu. Sellest paremal ja vasemal viljarõugud. Tagaplaanil metsatukki.
3772.de: In the foreground a harvested field. In the middle a solitary tree. To the right and left of it, sheaves of grain. In the background a small patch of forest.

3803.d: Laual kauss roosade marjadega, pudel, pruun kann, tass alustassiga, vasemal toos, keskel kauss õuntega, esiplaanil kahvel. Foon hall, keskel ülal kaks pruuni (üks triibuline) pinda. Paremal servas tumehallid ja pruunid triibud.
3803.de: On the table a bowl with pink berries, a bottle, a brown jug, a cup with saucer, on the left a box, in the middle a bowl with apples, in the foreground a fork. Background grey, in the middle above two brown surfaces (one striped). On the right edge dark grey and brown stripes.

3813.d: Esiplaanil kaks naist: parempoolsel toetab parem jalg ookrikarva kastile, käed toetavad kivi põlvel, seljas valge lühikeste varrukatega pluus ja punane seelik, peas valge rätik. Vasakpoolne naine hoiab vasaku käega kivi pea peal, parem käsi puusas, seljas valge käisteta pluus ja tume seelik. Foonil vasakul majanurk ja hall kott, paremal maastikufragment.
3813.de: In the foreground two women: the one on the right rests her right foot on an ochre-coloured box, her hands support a stone on her knee, she wears a white short-sleeved blouse and a red skirt, on her head a white kerchief. The woman on the left holds a stone on her head with her left hand, her right hand on her hip, wearing a white sleeveless blouse and a dark skirt. In the background on the left, the corner of a house and a grey bag, on the right a fragment of landscape.

3816.d: Rohekashallides toonides figuraalne kompositsioon: keskplaanis grupp hangude ja rehadega mehi ja naisi suurt heinakuhja tegemas. Neist vasakul istuvast ja joovast mehest ning kahest naisest koosnev grupp, ühel naisel käsi laubale tõstetud. Esiplaanil servas maas reha ja hang, kauss, korv ja suur tumeroheline pudel. Fooniks heinamaade, puude, loomade ja taluehitustega maastik. Taevas kollakasroheline, mõne roosa pilvega.
3816.de: Figural composition in greenish-grey tones: in the middle ground a group of men and women with pitchforks and rakes building a large haystack. To the left of them a group consisting of a seated, drinking man and two women, one woman with her hand raised to her forehead. In the foreground at the edge, on the ground, a rake and a pitchfork, a bowl, a basket and a large dark green bottle. Background a landscape of hayfields, trees, animals and farm buildings. Sky yellowish-green, with a few pink clouds.

3817.d: Figuraalne kompositsioon kartulivõtjatega esiplaanil: kolm tumedas riides pearätikutega naist seisavad, neljas kallab korvist kartuleid pildi keskele maalitud vankrisse, mille maas lebavatel aistel pruun kuub. Naistest vasakul künnab tumedates riietes mees valge hobusega kartulivagusid lahti. Foonil, otsekui läbi udu antud hall küün ning üksikud puud. Taevas tinahall.
3817.de: A figural composition with potato pickers in the foreground: three women dressed in dark clothing with headscarves stand, a fourth pours potatoes from a basket into a cart painted in the center of the picture, on whose bed a brown coat lies. To the left of the women, a man in dark clothes ploughs open potato ridges with a white horse. In the background, as if given through fog, a gray barn and solitary trees. The sky is leaden gray.

3818.d: Esiplaanil paremal tumedas varrukateta kleidis ja valges pearätis istuv naine, heledas särgikeses laps põlvedel. Tema taga pruunis seelikus ja pluusis ning valges rätis naine seismas, väljasirutatud käsi rehavarrele toetamas. Naiste ees, pildi keskel esiplaanil kann, korv ning teised majapidamisesemed. Keskplaanis kaks seelikutes ja pluusides naist ning kaks kaabudes meest, rehad ja hargud õlal, sammumas. Paremal servas pruun hobune, taevas roosakaspruun.
3818.de: In the foreground on the right, a woman sitting in a dark sleeveless dress and a white headscarf, with a child in a light shirt on her lap. Behind her, a woman standing in a brown skirt and blouse and a white scarf, her outstretched hand resting on a rake handle. In front of the women, in the centre foreground, a jug, a basket and other household items. In the middle ground two women in skirts and blouses and two men in hats, rakes and forks on their shoulders, walking. On the right edge a brown horse, the sky pinkish-brown.

3819.d: Väikese aknaga tumedate seintega ruumis esiplaanil alasti naisfiguur oma tumedaid juukseid pesemas. Naise jalgade ja niuete ümber helevalge lina, selja taga valge kauss. Ruumi avatud uksel seisab vastu valgust teine naisekuju pruuni linaga ümber jalgade. Avatud uksel ripuvad riided ja rätikud.
3819.de: In a room with dark walls and a small window, in the foreground a nude female figure washing her dark hair. Around the woman's legs and hips a very light-coloured sheet, behind her back a white bowl. In the open doorway of the room stands, against the light, another female figure with a brown cloth around her legs. On the open door hang clothes and towels.

3820.d: Esiplaanil paremal valges kleidis mustade juustega naine peseu pesemas. Vasakul foonil üks must ja teine punakaspruun hobune ning kaks inimest: valges kleidis ja rätikus naine ja triibulistes riietes musta mütsiga mees, pikk roigas õlal. Tagaplaanil heinasaadudega kollane põld ja roheline metsaviirg. Taevas kollakasroosa.
3820.de: In the foreground on the right, a black-haired woman in a white dress is washing herself. In the background on the left, one black and one reddish-brown horse and two people: a woman in a white dress and headscarf and a man in striped clothing with a black cap, a long pole on his shoulder. In the background, a yellow field with haystacks and a green strip of forest. The sky is yellowish-pink.

3881.d: Noore naise kolmveerandfiguur, käes avatud kirju päevavari. Seljas õrnlilla kleit, peas tume kübar kahe valge kunstlillega.
3881.de: Three-quarter figure of a young woman, holding an open patterned parasol. Wearing a pale lilac dress, a dark hat on her head with two white artificial flowers.

3887.d: Esiplaanil jõgi sinakasmustade põõsapuhmastega alumistes nurkades. Üle jõe mõned tuules kooldunud tumedad puud punaka paadiga nende vahel. Taamal rohekashall väli, väga kõrge horisont. Koloriit tume, peamiselt sinakates ja rohelistes toonides, pilvisest taevast varjutatud.
3887.de: In the foreground a river with bluish-black bush clumps in the lower corners. Across the river some dark trees bent by the wind, with a reddish boat between them. In the distance a greenish-grey field, a very high horizon. The colouring dark, mainly in bluish and green tones, shaded by an overcast sky.

3889.d: Esiplaanil pruunil toolil istuva noore naise portree kerges pöördes paremale. Seljas mustast ja hallist riidest kombineeritud valge kraega kleit. Poolpikad kastanpruunid juuksed on otsmikult tagasi kammitud. Naise parem käsi toetub küünarnukiga lauale, millel pikk rida raamatuid. Käes rohekas-hallist savist tass alustassiga. Foon täppivalt mustaga kaetud, alt kumab läbi roheline toon. Kohati pastoosne, selgelt eristuvate pintslijälgedega.
3889.de: In the foreground, a portrait of a young woman sitting on a brown chair, slightly turned to the right. Wearing a dress combined of black and gray fabric with a white collar. Her shoulder-length chestnut-brown hair is combed back from her forehead. The woman's right hand rests with the elbow on a table, on which there is a long row of books. In her hand a cup with a saucer made of greenish-gray clay. The background is covered with dotted black, through which a green tone shows below. Somewhat pastose, with clearly distinguishable brushstrokes.

3893.de: A bushy, leafy flower arrangement in a vase with handles, beside it a plate and a fruit branch. Bright blue tone dominates the colour scheme.

3917.d: Kohvikustseen: esiplaanil paremal valge linaga kaetud laud, millele parema, sigaretti hoidva käega, toetub mustas pintsakus, hallide pükste ja kikilipsuga mees. Mehe ees poolik õllekruus. Laua taga seisab mustas ülikonnas kelner, valge rätik üle parema käe ning kirjutab tellimust üles. Vasakus servas istub sinepikollases kleidis ja sama värvi kübaras daam, punakaspruun sall tooli käetoel. Foonil üksikuid külastajate ja kelnerite figuure. Foon sinakaroheline, ülalt paremalt punakaspruun.

5617.d: Esialal keskel kaks naisfiguuri rannaliival kalu sorteerimas. Nende taga neli püsti meest: ühel paljastatud ülakehaga noormehel on püsti puss, tema kõrval habemik rauk võrgulinaga, kuna parempoolsem näitab kahele paremal äärel rannaliival istuvale tütarlapsele suuremat kala. Tagapool vasakul rannaliiva jooksnud purjeka juures kaks noormeest askeldamas, kaugemal merel teine purjekas, millel näha kolm figuuri.
5617.de: In the foreground centre two female figures on the beach sand sorting fish. Behind them four standing men: one young man with a bared upper body holds a knife upright, beside him a bearded old man with a net cloth, while the one on the right shows a larger fish to two girls sitting on the beach sand at the right edge. Further back on the left, by a sailboat run up on the beach sand, two young men busy themselves, further out at sea a second sailboat, on which three figures can be seen.

6046.d: Kõrgete puude all väikese lapse figuur sinises kleidis.
6046.de: Under tall trees, the figure of a small child in a blue dress.

6049.d: Paremal pool suured puud. Vasakul sild ja telefonipostid. Puude vahelt paistab punane katus.
6049.de: On the right large trees. On the left a bridge and telephone poles. Through the trees a red roof is visible.

6052.d: Ülaltvaade ererohelisele lagedale maastikule, paremal sik-sakina sinakas müür, vasakul ojakäär. Kaugemal sinakas vines madalad tööstushooned, keskel valgete rünkpilvedega taeva taustal kahe kõrge korstnaga ehitus. Maalitud tihkete lühikeste pintslilöökidega.
6052.de: A bird's-eye view of a bright green open landscape, on the right a zigzagging bluish wall, on the left a bend in a stream. Further away, low industrial buildings in a bluish haze, in the middle a building with two tall chimneys against a sky with white cumulus clouds. Painted with dense short brushstrokes.

6057.d: Suvine maastikumotiiv puude ja sinise majaga. Esiplaani keskel lopsakad puud, põõsad kahvatusinise taeva taustal. Tagapool paremal viilkatusega sinine maja abihoonetega. Taamal vasakul põlluserval paistmas naise figuur. Lühike pintslilöök, sinkjasroheline koloriit.
6057.de: Summer landscape motif with trees and a blue house. In the centre of the foreground lush trees, bushes against a pale blue sky background. Further back on the right a blue house with a gable roof and outbuildings. In the distance on the left a woman's figure visible at the edge of a field. Short brushstroke, bluish-green colouring.

6090.dm: kõrgus: 75.0 cm; laius: 60.0 cm; kõrgus: 89.0 cm (raamiga); laius: 74.0 cm (raamiga)
6090.d: Kahe kurb-tõsise ilmega poisiohtu noormehe 3/4 figuurid teineteise taga seismas: ees vasakul noorem tumedas mantlis, müts käes, taga peakattes vanem poiss otsevaates. Monokroomne gamma, ekspressiivne maalilaad.
6090.de: The 3/4 figures of two sad, serious-looking adolescent boys standing one behind the other: in front on the left, a younger boy in a dark coat, cap in hand; behind, an older boy in headwear, facing forward. Monochrome palette, expressive painting style.

6091.d: Tugevate näojoonte, ovaalse kujuga kahvatu naisenägu õlgadeni. Tumedad pikad juuksed, silmad suletud, suu veidi paokil. Tume punakas, roheline foon. Ekspressiivne kujutamisviis.
6091.de: Pale woman's face with strong facial features, oval in shape, down to the shoulders. Dark long hair, eyes closed, mouth slightly open. Dark reddish, green background. Expressive manner of depiction.

6092.d: Põldude ja puudega maastiku taustal ees paremal maas istuv tumedas riides noor mees, kirst kõrval, parem käsi ümber sarga. Kurb-tõsine pilk kaugusesse suunatud. Rohekad, pruunikashallid toonid, ekspressiivne kujutamisviis.
6092.de: Against a background of fields and trees with trees, in the foreground on the right a young man dressed in dark clothes sitting on the ground, a coffin beside him, right hand around the coffin. Sad-serious gaze directed into the distance. Greenish, brownish-grey tones, expressive manner of depiction.

6093.d: Mustjast taustast joonistub välja tugevate joontega heledam naisenägu: tugev lõug, nina, suu kriipsuna kokku pigistatud, silmad veidi kõõrdi vasakule suunatud. Tumedad juuksed pead ümbritsemas. Ekspressiivne maalilaad
6093.de: Against a blackish background a lighter woman's face is drawn with strong lines: strong chin, nose, mouth pressed together as a line, eyes slightly slanted to the left. Dark hair surrounding the head. Expressive painterly style

6094.dm: kõrgus: 61.5 cm; laius: 47.7 cm; kõrgus: 72.6 cm (raamiga); laius: 59.0 cm (raamiga)
6094.d: Esiplaanil kahvatu alasti naise poolfiguur lebamas, pea veidi küljel, silmad suletud, pikad rohekad juuksed küljel. Taustal öine tumesinine maastik. Taevas täiskuu peegeldumas veekogus. Ekspressiivne maalilaad.
6094.de: In the foreground, the pale half-figure of a nude woman lying down, head slightly turned to the side, eyes closed, long greenish hair to the side. In the background, a dark blue nocturnal landscape. In the sky, a full moon reflected in a body of water. Expressive painting style.

6095.dm: kõrgus: 45.0 cm; laius: 60.5 cm; kõrgus: 56.0 cm (raamiga); laius: 72.0 cm (raamiga)
6095.d: Ees vasakul hallis kleidis kahvatu näoga noore naise poolfiguur vaataja suunas, kätega kõrvu sulgemas. Lumelaikudega maastik taustal, kus kolm musta hobust regedega kihutamas, taevas rünkpilvedest mustriga kaetud. Sinkjad, hallikad, enamasti heledad toonid üksikute tumedate aktsentidega. Ekspressiivne maalilaad.
6095.de: In front, on the left, a half-figure of a pale-faced young woman in a grey dress facing the viewer, her hands covering her ears. A snow-patched landscape in the background, where three black horses are racing with sledges, the sky covered with a pattern of cumulus clouds. Bluish, greyish, mostly light tones with individual dark accents. Expressive painting style.

6096.dm: kõrgus: 39.5 cm; laius: 30.0 cm; kõrgus: 58.0 cm (raamiga); laius: 48.5 cm (raamiga)
6096.d: Pruun-beežikal rakumustrilisel taustal triibulises vangiriietuses kõhna mehe poolfiguur otsevaates, käsi tõstetud rinnale. Mehel kahvatu jume, pöetud pea, kriipsuna pigistatud suu, pilk suunatud alla. Sinkjashallid, pruunikad toonid. Ekspressiivne maalilaad.
6096.de: Half-figure, frontal view, of a thin man in striped prison clothing against a brown-beige checkered background, hand raised to his chest. The man has a pale complexion, a shaved head, a mouth pressed into a line, gaze directed downward. Bluish-gray, brownish tones. Expressive painting style.

6108.d: Linnavaade kollendavate puude ja trammiteega. Paremal suure maja nurk. Sõiduteel sagivad inimesed vihmavarjudega, paar hobuveokit, ooteplatvormidel trammi ootav rahvahulk.
6108.de: A city view with yellowing trees and a tram line. At right the corner of a large building. On the roadway people bustle about with umbrellas, a couple of horse-drawn carts, a crowd waiting for the tram on the waiting platforms.

6126.d: Mehe portree: Noorepoolse tumedapäise mehe rindportree kerges pöördes paremale, käed vaheliti rinnal. Mehel piklik nägu,hallikad silmad, ilme tõsine. Hele kollakasroosa mosaiigitaoline taust.
6126.de: Portrait of a man: Bust portrait of a youngish dark-haired man in a slight turn to the right, hands crossed on the chest. The man has an elongated face, greyish eyes, a serious expression. Light yellowish-pink mosaic-like background.

6142.d: a) Autoportree. Noore naise rindportree poolpöördes vasakule, pilk vaatajale suunatud. Naisel pruunid silmad,pehmed näojooned; keskelt lahkukammitud pikki lopsakaid juukseid hoiab soengus ümber pea seotud lilla rätik. Heleroheka jaki hõlmade vahelt paistab roosa pluus. Taustal paremal seinal rippuva pildi nurk.
6142.de: a) Self-portrait. A bust portrait of a young woman in a half-turn to the left, her gaze directed at the viewer. The woman has brown eyes, soft facial features; her long, luxuriant hair, parted in the middle, is held in place by a purple kerchief tied around her head. Between the lapels of her light green jacket a pink blouse is visible. In the background, on the right, the corner of a picture hanging on the wall.

6146.d: Tumedal foonil, poolprofiilis vasakule, tüdruku rinnaportree, peas kollakas, veidi kirju, lõua alt seotud rätik, suu veidi avatud, seljas valge pluus ja punane vest. Pilk vasakule.
6146.de: On a dark background, in half-profile to the left, the bust portrait of a girl, on her head a yellowish, slightly patterned kerchief tied under the chin, mouth slightly open, wearing a white blouse and a red vest. Gaze to the left.

6234.d: Paremal nurgas esiplaanil mäenõlvak, millel kasvab hallide tüvede ja tumerohelise okstetihnikuna antud kuusemets. Taamal paistab läbi tüvede heledamini valgustatud lagendik.
6234.de: In the right corner, in the foreground, a mountain slope on which grows a spruce forest rendered as grey trunks and dark green thicket of branches. Further back, a more brightly lit clearing shows through the trunks.

6235.d: Vaade Tallinna vanalinnale Tornide väljaku lähedalt. Keskplaanis viis punase katusekiivriga linnamüüri kaitsetorni. Vasakul, kahe torni vahelt, paistab Niguliste kiriku torni osa. Ees kahekorruseline valge, planguga ümbritsetud kivimaja ning raagus puud.
6235.de: View of Tallinn's Old Town from near Tornide Square. In the central plan five city-wall defence towers with red tiled roof helmets. On the left, between two towers, part of the tower of St. Nicholas' Church is visible. In front a two-storey white stone house surrounded by a plank fence, and bare trees.

6251.d: Keskel tahasuunduv tee, millel liikumas sõdureid ja veokeid.
6251.de: In the middle a road receding into the distance, with soldiers and trucks moving on it.

6253.d: Esiplaanil liivaselt rohtunud rannalt vaade vahutavate lainetega merele. Vasakul tuulest painduvate okstega puude vahel võrke kandvad mehed ja paat. Paremal puud.
6253.de: In the foreground a view from a sandy, grassy shore to the sea with foaming waves. On the left, among trees with branches bending in the wind, men carrying nets and a boat. Trees on the right.

6254.d: Esiplaanil diagonaalselt vasakult paremale lahtiaetud kartulivagude kohale kummardunud inimfiguurid. Keskel hobune kastiga, selle ees kartuleid noppiv mees. Paremal poolik kartulikuhi, selle juures korvi tühjendav mees, kummarduv naine. Kaugemal kollendavad põllud ja puud.
6254.de: In the foreground, diagonally from left to right, human figures bent over opened potato furrows. In the middle a horse with a cart, in front of it a man picking potatoes. On the right a partial pile of potatoes, next to it a man emptying a basket, a bending woman. In the distance yellowing fields and trees.

6271.d: Hoonete keskel vasakul kõrge torn, paremal teistest hoonetest kõrgemale tõusev kuppelkatusega torniga ehitus.
6271.de: Among the buildings, on the left a tall tower, on the right a structure with a domed-roof tower rising higher than the other buildings.

6272.d: Ees paremal mees kaamliga ja kolm ratsurit eeslitel, vasakul mees eeslil. Keskel loss, lossi sissekäik kahe tornitaolise ehituse vahel.
6272.de: In front on the right a man with a camel and three riders on donkeys, on the left a man on a donkey. In the middle a castle, the castle entrance between two tower-like structures.

6273.d: Kivine rannik. Vasakul maalipoolel: ees kaks mängivat last, grupp mehi nendes üks ajalehte ette lugemas. Tagapoolt paistab tükike merd, kaldal üksik mänd, inimfiguure. Keskel kaldale tõmmatud paate. Paremal: tagaplaanil majade grupp, ees ristpuudele riputatud esemeid, inimfiguure. Taevas rahutuis pilveis.
6273.de: A rocky coast. On the left side of the painting: in front two children playing, a group of men, one of them reading a newspaper aloud to the others. Behind, a piece of sea is visible, on the shore a solitary pine, human figures. In the middle, boats pulled up onto the shore. On the right: in the background a group of houses, in front objects hung on crossbars, human figures. Sky with restless clouds.

6274.d: Ees mereäärsel rannikul kolm harkidega meest ja naine. Nende taga hobune reega. Paremal vee ääres kaks inimfiguuri. Taamal sügavsinine meri.
6274.de: In front on a seaside coast three men with pitchforks and a woman. Behind them a horse with a sledge. On the right by the water two human figures. In the distance a deep blue sea.

6275.d: Ees vasakul eesti talupoja riietuses mees sarve puhumas. Tema taga mees odaga. Paremal suurte okaspuude all grupp odadega varustatud mehi.
6275.de: In front on the left a man in Estonian peasant dress blowing a horn. Behind him a man with a spear. On the right, under large conifers, a group of men equipped with spears.

6276.d: Ees paremal ristleja külg linnapoole suunatud kahuritorudega. Taga vasakul laevu, paremal linn (Tallinn).
6276.de: In front on the right, a cruiser's side with cannon barrels aimed towards the town. In the back on the left, ships, on the right the town (Tallinn).

6277.d: Esiplaanil keskel tütarlapse laip, vasakul taluhoone ees kolm mundris ja üks tsiviilrõivastuses fašist. Paremal seljataha seotud kätega mehe taga okupantide sõdur laskevalmis revolvriga käes.
6277.de: In the centre foreground the corpse of a girl, on the left in front of a farmhouse three fascists in uniform and one in civilian clothing. On the right, behind a man with hands bound behind his back, an occupying soldier with a revolver at the ready.

6278.d: Esiplaanil eesti sõjameeste ja hobuse laibad. Ees paremal ülestõstetud rusikaga maas istuva naise figuur. Taga paremal põlevad varemed, vasakul lahkuvate ordulaste grupp.
6278.de: In the foreground, the corpses of Estonian soldiers and a horse. In front, on the right, the figure of a woman sitting on the ground with a raised fist. Behind on the right burning ruins, on the left a group of departing Knights of the Order.

6287.d: Õhtuse kohviku interjöör, ümmarguste, valge linaga kaetud laudade taga seltskonnad. Esiplaanis tumerohelises, vöötatud kleidis, mustas kübaras, pruunide juustega daam, näoga vaataja poole. Pooleldi tema selja taga, paremal, lillakaspunases kleidis, valge tanu ja kandikuga ettekandja. Vasakul all paistab osa lauast, millel kõhukas napsipudel ja laua taga istuja vasak käsi klaasiga. Taamal vasakul istub laua taga roosas ja kollases kleidis daamidest ning sinises ülikonnas härrast koosnev seltskond. Foonil, hallikassinisel seinal kaks seinalampi.
6287.de: Interior of an evening café, groups of people at round tables covered with white cloths. In the foreground, a lady with brown hair, in a dark green striped dress and black hat, her face turned toward the viewer. Half behind her, on the right, a waitress in a purplish-red dress with a white cap and a tray. At lower left part of a table is visible, on which stands a squat little bottle of spirits, and the left hand, holding a glass, of the person sitting at the table. In the background at left, at a table, sits a company consisting of ladies in pink and yellow dresses and a gentleman in a blue suit. In the background, on a greyish-blue wall, two wall lamps.

6288.d: Kolmest osast koosnev suurema kompositsiooni kavand.
6288.de: Sketch for a larger composition consisting of three parts.

6290.d: Peamiselt sinakashallides toonides figuraalne kompositsioon: keskel paremal must, heleda lakaga hobune ja hall varss. Neist vasakul triibulises särgis ja pruunis kuues mees hoiab tumepruuni hobuse suitsetest, ise näoga vaataja poole. Tagapool, palja ülakeha ja siniste pükstega mees, kaabu peas, seljaga vaataja poole, hoiab suitsetest helehalli hobust. All paremas nurgas istub kivil piipu popsutav noor mees, tema kõrval paistab osa seisvast mehefiguurist. Taamal hall meri paadiga, ülal roosa taevas.
6290.de: A figural composition mainly in bluish-grey tones: in the centre right, a black horse with a light mane and a grey foal. To their left, a man in a striped shirt and brown coat holds the reins of a dark brown horse, facing the viewer. Further back, a bare-chested man in blue trousers and a hat, with his back to the viewer, holds the reins of a light grey horse. In the lower right corner, a young man sits on a rock smoking a pipe; beside him part of a standing male figure is visible. In the distance, a grey sea with a boat, above it a pink sky.

6295.d: Ülaltvaade hilissuvistele rannaäärsetele, roigasaedadega piiratud põllusiirule. Mere pool vasakul rukkihakid, üksikud puud vee piiril, rannal paate. Helesinise, pilvevines taeva all meretriip, silmapiiril laeva siluett. Õhuline skitseeriv maalilaad.
6295.de: Bird's-eye view of a late-summer field by the seashore, enclosed by pole fences. On the sea side to the left, sheaves of rye, single trees at the water's edge, boats on the shore. Under a pale blue, cloudy-hazy sky a strip of sea, the silhouette of a ship on the horizon. Airy, sketch-like painting style.

6296.d: Paremas servas istub tumedal toolil blond, käharate juustega noor naine, seljas helesinine lühikeste varrukatega pluus ja lilleline pihikseelik, käed süles vaheliti, pilk suunatud naise ees olevale, vaataja poole seljaga seisvale, poisile. Poisil heledad lühikesed juuksed, seljas sinine pluus ja pruuni traksidega püksid. Vasakul on pruuni ja halliga markeeritud toahämarus.
6296.de: On the right edge sits a blonde, curly-haired young woman on a dark chair, wearing a light blue short-sleeved blouse and a floral pinafore skirt, her hands folded in her lap, her gaze directed at the boy in front of her, who stands with his back to the viewer. The boy has light short hair, wears a blue blouse and brown trousers with braces. On the left the twilight of the room is marked in brown and grey.

6297.d: Madala horisondiga rannavaade: esiplaanil liivane rand, vasakul mõned pruunid paadid, paremal allservas kaldale uhutud paat. Keset liiva seisab oranžis pearätikus, rohekas pluusis ja tumepruunis seelikus naine, seljaga vaataja poole, aer käes. Taamal paremal üksik vahutavasse kaldavette lükatud paat. Silmapiiril tumesinine mereviirg, ülal hele, kõrge, kohati hallikate ja roosade pilvedega kaetud taevas.
6297.de: A low-horizon coastal view: in the foreground a sandy beach, on the left a few brown boats, at the bottom right a boat washed ashore. In the middle of the sand stands a woman with an oar in her hand, wearing an orange headscarf, a greenish blouse and a dark brown skirt, with her back to the viewer. In the background on the right a solitary boat pushed into the foaming water at the shore. On the horizon a dark blue strip of sea, above a bright, high sky, in places covered with greyish and pink clouds.

6298.d: Neljakandilisel laual valgusega ülekallatud esemed: esiplaanil hallikas taldrik, mille taga vasakul roosa tass ja värviliste  puuviljadega täidetud kauss. Tassi taga kaks tumesinist pudelit. Seadeldise taga aken, aknalaud ja lillakasroosa kardin. Kohati maalitud pisikeste säpsivate pintslilöökidega.
6298.de: On a square table, objects bathed in light: in the foreground a greyish plate, behind it to the left a pink cup and a bowl filled with colourful fruit. Behind the cup, two dark blue bottles. Behind the arrangement, a window, windowsill and a lilac-pink curtain. Painted in places with small, brisk brushstrokes.

6299.d: Lillakaspunaste draperiidega kaetud alusele nõjatuv naisakt: alakeha vaataja suunas, ülakeha pööratud vasakule, toetub taha küünarvartele, pea kallutatud vasakule alla. Hoogne skitseeriv maalilaad, keha heledatele kontrastiks tausta tumedad hallikaspruunid toonid.
6299.de: A female nude leaning against a base covered with purplish-red drapery: lower body towards the viewer, upper body turned to the left, resting back on the forearms, head tilted down to the left. Vigorous sketch-like painting manner, contrasting with the light body dark greyish-brown tones of the background.

6309.d: Diagonaalselt paremalt vasakule suunduv kivine merekallas. Paremal üksik puu. Vasakul kaldale tõmmatud punane paat. Taeval üksik valge pilv.
6309.de: A rocky sea shore running diagonally from right to left. On the right a single tree. On the left a red boat pulled up on the shore. A single white cloud in the sky.

6310.d: Lage mererand. Esiplaanil teivasaed ja madalad kadakapõõsad. Tagapool vasakul üksik kuur. Eemal meri.
6310.de: Open seashore. In the foreground a stake fence and low juniper bushes. Behind on the left a single shed. In the distance the sea.

6311.d: Lagendik metsaserval, mille keskel ilma tiibadeta pukktuulik.
6311.de: A clearing at the forest edge, in the middle of which a wingless post mill.

6312.d: Esiplaanil seisev naine mannergust joomas. Vasakul istuv grupp, mehel lõõtspill. Paremal töötavaid inimesi.
6312.de: Woman standing in the foreground drinking from a tankard. On the left a seated group, a man with an accordion. On the right people working.

6388.dm: kõrgus: 77.0 cm; laius: 59.7 cm; kõrgus: 91.5 cm (raamiga); laius: 74.5 cm (raamiga)
6388.d: Keskealise naise poolfiguur enface. Seljas särgilõikega hall ürp. Mõlema käega hoidmas kirvest enda ees. Taustaks lahe rannikumaastik.
6388.de: Half-figure of a middle-aged woman en face. Wearing a grey shirt-cut garment. Holding an axe in front of her with both hands. Background a coastal landscape with a bay.

6389.d: Esiplaanil lage muru, piiratud keskosas risti üle pildi kulgeva kivimüüriga. Viimase taga künkalisel niidul üksikuid ja puuderühmi, taamal mets.
6389.de: In the foreground, open grass, bounded in the central part by a stone wall running crosswise across the picture. Behind it, on a hilly meadow, isolated trees and groups of trees, further back a forest.

6392.dm: kõrgus: 37.5 cm; laius: 33.0 cm; kõrgus: 49.0 cm (raamiga); laius: 44.5 cm (raamiga)
6392.d: Heledate juustega noore naise pea otsevaates.
6392.de: Head of a young woman with fair hair, frontal view.

6395.d: Valges rätikus noore naise kolm-neljandik figuur frontaalselt istumas. Tume kleit ja tume foon.
6395.de: Three-quarter figure of a young woman in a white headscarf, seated frontally. Dark dress and dark background.

6397.dm: kõrgus: 45.0 cm (km); laius: 45.0 cm (vineer); kõrgus: 45.0 cm (vineer); laius: 38.5 cm (km)
6397.d: Noore, tumedajuukselise naise õlgadeni kujutus kerges pöördes paremale. Hele foon, lilla kleit. Vasakul riba maalimata pinda.
6397.de: Depiction of a young dark-haired woman down to the shoulders, in a slight turn to the right. Light background, purple dress. A strip of unpainted surface on the left.

6398.d: Madal punutud korv kõrgete lilledega. Esiplaanil paindunud vartega tulbid, nende taga levkoid ja priimula.
6398.de: A low wicker basket with tall flowers. In the foreground tulips with bent stems, behind them stocks and a primrose.

6399.dm: kõrgus: 55.0 cm (km); laius: 73.5 cm (vineer); kõrgus: 63.0 cm (vineer); laius: 73.5 cm (km)
6399.d: Esiplaanil mees labidaga ja vanker. Tagapool paremal veel kaks figuuri ning hobused vankritega.
6399.de: In the foreground a man with a spade and a cart. Further back on the right two more figures and horses with carts.

6400.d: Tumedajuukselise naise 3/4 figuur istumas kerges pöördes vasakule.
6400.de: A 3/4 figure of a dark-haired woman sitting in a slight turn to the left.

6401.d: Tumedate juuste ja kleidiga vanema naise kolmveerandfiguur istumas kerges pöördes paremale. Modelli vasak käsi toetatud punase riidega kaetud tooli seljale, parem lebab põlvedel.

6402.d: Laua najale toetuva, punase treeningülikonnas poisikese täisfiguur. Laual vasakul purk pintslitega, paremal värvipotid.
6402.de: Full figure of a boy in a red tracksuit leaning against a table. On the table on the left a jar with brushes, on the right paint pots.

6403.d: Istuva vanema naise kolmveerand figuur otsevaates. Süles kokku pandud kätes hoiab kindaid. Tume müts ja mantel, mille hõlmad eest lahti.
6403.de: Three-quarter figure of an older seated woman in frontal view. Holding gloves in her hands folded in her lap. Dark hat and coat, its front flaps open.

6404.d: Istuva patsidega tütarlapse kolmveerandfiguur otsevaates. Rohelisekirju pikkade varrukatega pluus, must põll.
6404.de: A three-quarter figure of a seated girl with braids, in a frontal view. A green-patterned blouse with long sleeves, a black apron.

6405.d: Istuva naise poolfiguur kerges pöördes vasakule. Must kleit, mida kaunistab lai kaelakett. Pruunid pealigi kammitud juuksed.

6406.d: Tumedajuukselise, ruudulises kleidis naise poolfiguur. Keha pööratud kergelt vasakule, pea otse.

6407.d: Istuva tütarlapse kolmveerandfiguur otsevaates. Käed toetatud kahele poole kõrvale. Tumedad lühikesed juuksed. Lillakasvalge kraega kleit.

6408.d: Kõrge silmapiiriga lumine maastik. Esiplaanil vasakul kaks seisvat naisfiguuri. Paremal üksikud tumedad põõsad. Taga metsariba ja madalad talumajad.
6408.de: A snowy landscape with a high horizon. In the foreground on the left two standing female figures. On the right solitary dark bushes. Behind a strip of forest and low farmhouses.

6409.d: Tumeda mantli ja paretiga poisikese täisfiguur otsevaates, käed sirgelt kõrval. Hele foon.

6416.d: Etüüd "Surnuvankrile". Tuules ja vihmas hobustepaar vankriga liikumas vasakule. Maalitud hallikas gammas, õhukeselt, vineeripind suures osas nähtav.
6416.de: Study "For the Death Cart". A pair of horses with a cart moving to the left in wind and rain. Painted in a greyish gamut, thinly, the plywood surface largely visible.

6418.d: Esiplaanil lumine ala, keskel põõsad ja puu, taga mets. Maapind ja taevas maalitud heledatena, puud tuhmides rohekas-sinakates toonides.
6418.de: In the foreground a snowy area, bushes and a tree in the middle, forest behind. The ground and sky painted in light tones, the trees in faded greenish-bluish tones.

6420.d: Kaks meest rindportreena: parempoolne otsvaates, pikkade juuste ja habemega, punakas riietuses, teda suudleb mees profiilis, käsi teise õlale toetatud.
6420.de: Two men as a bust portrait: the one on the right full-face, with long hair and a beard, in reddish clothing, is being kissed by a man in profile, his hand resting on the other's shoulder.

6421.d: Istuv naisakt põlvini, pöördega vasakule. Fooniks maastik haralise puuga vasakul. Akt maalitud heledana, maastik tuhmides hall-rohekates toonides.
6421.de: A seated female nude to the knees, turned to the left. Background a landscape with a branching tree on the left. The nude is painted in light tones, the landscape in fading grey-greenish tones.

6452.dm: kõrgus: 95.3 cm; laius: 77.0 cm; kõrgus: 110.5 cm (raamiga); laius: 92.5 cm (raamiga)
6452.d: Esiplaanis hallides ja pruunides toonides maalitud kehvas kuues, kõverdunud näoga, peast eemale hoidvate kõrvadega vanem mees, käed väsinult külgedel ripakil. Fooniks punakaspruunides ja roosades toonides lage väli üksiku raagus puutüükaga paremas servas.
6452.de: In the foreground, painted in grey and brown tones, an elderly man in shabby clothes, with a crooked face and ears held away from his head, hands hanging tiredly at his sides. The background is an empty field in reddish-brown and pink tones with a single bare tree stump at the right edge.

6457.dm: kõrgus: 47.1 cm; laius: 40.7 cm; kõrgus: 52.0 cm (raamiga); laius: 46.0 cm (raamiga)
6457.d: Naise portree ekspressiivses laadis, tumedates toonides, tugevate mustade kontuuridega. Kohkunud ilmega naine on surunud parema käe suule. Taust hallikais toonides, naise kleit pruun. Maalil neljas kohas ca 1 cm2 suurused tükid vineeri pealiskihist puuduvad, pinnad üle maalitud.
6457.de: A woman's portrait in an expressive style, in dark tones, with strong black contours. The woman, with a startled expression, has pressed her right hand to her mouth. The background is in greyish tones, the woman's dress is brown. In four places on the painting, pieces of about 1 cm2 of the plywood's surface layer are missing, the surfaces have been repainted.

6471.dm: kõrgus: 84.0 cm (vm); laius: 103.0 cm (arm); kõrgus: 85.0 cm (arm); laius: 102.0 cm (vm)
6471.d: Helendava mereliiva taustal jookseb grupp valgetes supeltrikoodes noori naisi. Kõigil päevitunud kehad. Näojooned ebaselged. Juuksed lendlevad tuules. Liivale langevad nende varjud.
6471.de: Against a background of glowing sea sand a group of young women in white swimsuits are running. All have tanned bodies. Facial features indistinct. Hair flying in the wind. Their shadows fall on the sand.

6489.d: Toolil istuva tumedajuukselise naise täisportree. Pea poolprof. pöördega vasemale. Parem käsi toetub tooli istmelauale, vasak rüpes. Üle vasaku õla punane mantel.
6489.de: Full-length portrait of a dark-haired woman seated on a chair. Head in half-profile turned to the left. Right hand resting on the seat of the chair, left in her lap. A red coat over the left shoulder.

6491.d: Esiplaanil lage tasane muru, taamal puude vahel kaks punase katusega maja.
6491.de: In the foreground open flat lawn, in the distance among trees two houses with red roofs.

6493.d: Prillidega keskealise toolil istuva mehe põlvpilt, enface. Keha puusadest kerge pöördega paremale. Parem käsi tooli leenil, vasak põlvel.
6493.de: Knee-length portrait of a middle-aged bespectacled man sitting on a chair, en face. Body slightly turned to the right from the hips. Right hand on the armrest of the chair, left hand on the knee.

6526.d: Esiplaanil kivisel rannal kalu korvidesse sortreerijate grupid. Nende taga keskel ninapidi rannaliivale tõmmatud paadi ümber naisi. Vasakul ja keskel meri, paremal kivine kalurihüttide, askeldavate inimeste ja metsatukkadega rannik.
6526.de: In the foreground, on a stony shore, groups of people sorting fish into baskets. Behind them, in the centre, women around a boat drawn up nose-first onto the sandy shore. Sea on the left and centre, on the right a rocky coastline with fishing huts, bustling people and patches of forest.

6527.d: Ees vasakul meri järsu kõrge kaldaga. Keskel põõsaid ja paremal rohtunud maal kari ja karjane.
6527.de: On the left the sea with a steep, high shore. In the middle bushes, and on the right on grassy land a herd and a herdsman.

6528.d: Kalaranna esiplaanil ruttav mees, püksid põlvini üleskääritud, kalakorviga õlal, tema kõrval vasakul naine. Keskosas rannarahvast askeldavas tegevuses. Parempoolses osas taga näha paari ülestõmmatud purjedega paati, neist paremal rannal võrgumajad. Majade taga üksikuid kuuski. Taevas pilves.
6528.de: In the foreground of a fishing shore a hurrying man, trousers rolled up to the knees, a fish basket on his shoulder, beside him on the left a woman. In the middle section shore folk busy with various activities. In the right part, further back, two boats with hoisted sails can be seen, to their right on the shore net-houses. Behind the houses a few solitary spruces. The sky is cloudy.

6529.d: Esialal vasakul puust kahejärguline paadisild, mille alumisel järgul mehed silla ääres seisvaist paatidest üleantavaid täis kalakaste virna ladumas. Sama silla kõrgema järgu kaitsepuudel kuivamas võrkusid. Kergemal lameda katusega sadama teenistushoone. Esialal paremal virvendav veepind, kaugemal rida ankrus seisvaid, allalastud purjedega purjekaid - kuunareid. Tagaplaanil, pilvistatud taeva taustal Tallinna siluett, Oleviste torniga keskosas ja mitme suitseva tehase korstnaga vasakul.
6529.de: In the foreground on the left, a two-tiered wooden pier bridge, on the lower tier of which men are stacking piles of fish crates being handed over from boats standing by the bridge. On the railings of the higher tier of the same bridge, nets are drying. Lighter, a flat-roofed harbour service building. In the foreground on the right, a rippling water surface, further away a row of schooners at anchor with sails lowered. In the background, against a clouded sky, the silhouette of Tallinn, with the tower of Oleviste [St. Olaf's Church] in the middle section and several smoking factory chimneys on the left.

6536.d: Esiplaanil keskel naised sirpidega rukist lõikamas, vihku sidumas, hakki kandmas. Vasakul nurgas lapsed rukkivihkudel istumas. Kaugemal hakirida, põlluääres vanad õlgkatusega talumajad. Taevas tume.
6536.de: In the foreground, women cutting rye with sickles, tying sheaves, carrying stooks. In the left corner, children sitting on rye sheaves. Further away a row of stooks, old thatched-roof farmhouses at the edge of the field. Dark sky.

6539.d: Kivine rand üksikute hoonetega ja keskel asuva suure männiga. Paremal paadid, vasakul metsatukk.
6539.de: A rocky shore with a few buildings and a large pine tree in the middle. Boats on the right, a small forest on the left.

6542.d: Kärestikulisel jõel 7 meest pootshaakidega palgiparvel. Taga kallas metsaribaga. Taevas pilvine.
6542.de: On a rapid river, 7 men with pike poles on a log raft. Behind, a bank with a strip of forest. Sky cloudy.

6545.d: Liivasel rannal askeldavad inimesed kalakasti juures, paremal helehalli mere kaldal naised ja mehed paatide ümber, neist vasemal neli figuuri mingi töövahendiga, tagapool inimesi kalakuuride juures, vasemale jääb hobune vankriga. Koloriit hele: hallikas, ookerjas, üksikuid punakaid ja sinakaid aktsente, esiplaanil rohekaid rohututte.
6545.de: On a sandy beach people are busy by a fish crate, on the right on the shore of a light-grey sea women and men around boats, to their left four figures with some tool, further back people by fish sheds, to the left a horse with a cart. Light colour scheme: grayish, ochreish, occasional reddish and bluish accents, greenish tufts of grass in the foreground.

6554.d: Heleda taeva taustal eesti rahvariietes naised tervitavad sõjamehi. Vasakul viiest inimesest grupp: Kolm Harjumaa rõivastes (sinisetriibuline seelik, pitsidega pluus, rahad rinnas) noorikut pöörduvad nende ees paremal seisvate sineleis, kiivrites sõdurite poole. Vasakpoolne mees selg-, parem külgvaates. Lõuendil paremal kaks vestlevat sõjameest: Eespool vasakul õlgkübaras, püss seljas mees selgvaates, tema vastas paremal sinelis-kiivris sõdur otsevaates. Taamal keskel ja paremal rahvariietes figuurid. Maal heledais hallikates, pruunides toonides.
6554.de: Against a light sky, women in Estonian folk costume greet soldiers. On the left a group of five people: three young women in Harjumaa costume (blue-striped skirt, lace blouse, coins on the chest) turn towards soldiers standing in front of them on the right, wearing greatcoats and helmets. The left-hand man is seen from behind, the right one in side view. On the right of the canvas two soldiers conversing: in front on the left a man in a straw hat with a rifle on his back, seen from behind, opposite him on the right a soldier in greatcoat and helmet seen frontally. In the background, in the centre and on the right, figures in folk costume. The painting is in light greyish, brown tones.

6555.d: Esiplaanil vasakul istuv tütarlaps rahvarõivais: seljas valge tikitud varrukate ja pitsist kraeservaga pluus, punane vest, valge seelik laiade horisontaalsete triipudega, pluusi kaeluses sõlg. Tütarlapsel kuldpruunid, pealael soengusse kammitud juuksed, käed rüpes. Tema kõrval paremal seisab tumedas mulgi kuues tumedapäine vurrudega noormees. Foon põhiliselt rohekashall, servadest kirju.
6555.de: In the foreground on the left a seated girl in folk costume: wearing a white blouse with embroidered sleeves and a lace-edged collar, a red vest, a white skirt with wide horizontal stripes, a brooch at the blouse's neckline. The girl has golden-brown hair combed into a hairstyle on top of her head, her hands in her lap. Next to her, on the right, stands a dark-haired, moustached young man in a dark Mulgi costume. The background is mainly greenish-grey, patterned at the edges.

6556.d: Ettepoole tormav mees, paremas tõstetud käes mõõk, teine käsi kuklal. Maalitud hoogsalt, visandlikult. Sinakaspruun figuur roosakal foonil.
6556.de: A man rushing forward, a sword raised in his right hand, the other hand on the back of his head. Painted vigorously, in a sketchy manner. A bluish-brown figure on a pinkish background.

6559.d: Pruunis läkiläkis ja kuues, rohelise särgiga noore mehe rinnaportree. Pea pisut paremale kallutatud, pilk suunatud otse vaatajale. Foon maalimata.
6559.de: Chest portrait of a young man in a brown coat and jacket, with a green shirt. Head tilted slightly to the right, gaze directed straight at the viewer. Background unpainted.

6566.dm: lehe laius: 21.5 cm; lehe kõrgus: 25.6 cm
6566.d: Hoogsalt, skitseerivas laadis maalitud noormehe rinnaportree otsevaates. Mehel tumedad veidi turris juuksed, vuntsid nina all, tumedad kulmud, pilk tõsine. Seljas sinine jopp. Paberibind osaliselt katmata.
6566.de: A vigorously, sketchily painted bust portrait of a young man in full front view. The man has dark, somewhat tousled hair, a moustache under his nose, dark eyebrows, a serious gaze. Wearing a blue jacket. The paper mount partly uncovered.

6572.d: Esiplaanil eest taha vasakule suunduva tänava ääres aiad. Paremal aedades maju üksikuid põõsaid ja puid. Taamal suitsev vabriku korsten. Taustaks suitsune taevas.
6572.de: In the foreground gardens along a street running from front to back towards the left. On the right houses in gardens, scattered bushes and trees. In the distance a smoking factory chimney. Background of smoky sky.

6573.d: Esiplaanil vasakul varemed, paremal rusuhunnik. Taga purustatud Niguliste kiriku varemed.
6573.de: In the foreground on the left ruins, on the right a heap of rubble. Behind, the ruins of the destroyed Niguliste Church.

6575.d: Ees keskel kolme laiba vahel selgvaates valges Liivi ordu riides mees odaga. Vasakul kaks ordutüütli figuuri. Paremal ordurüütlid hobustel. Taga keskel grupp inimesi.
6575.de: In the front centre, among three corpses, a man in white Livonian Order attire with a spear, seen clearly. On the left two figures of Order sergeants. On the right Order knights on horses. Behind, in the middle, a group of people.

6591.d: Esiplaanil paremal kolm kajakat. Taamal bulvar raagus puudega ja majade rida.
6591.de: In the foreground on the right, three gulls. In the distance, a boulevard with bare trees and a row of houses.

6703.d: Vanema, valgejuukselise mehe tugitoolis istuv põlvpilt. Küünarnukid toetatud toolileenidele, käed süles. Vasakult näha tiibklaveri serv.
6703.de: Knee-length portrait of an older, white-haired man sitting in an armchair. Elbows resting on the chair arms, hands in his lap. The edge of a grand piano visible from the left.

6704.d: Prillidega vanema mehe rinnapilt poolprofiilis paremale. Peas hall kaabu, õlgadel kapuutsiga keep.
6704.de: Chest portrait of an older man with glasses, in half-profile to the right. Grey hat on his head, a hooded cape on his shoulders.

6705.d: Tumedajuukselise keskealise sõjaväelase rinnapilt poolprofiilis vasakule. Avatud sineli all näha tumesinine kindrali esindusvormi kuub. Rinnas rida aumärke.
6705.de: Bust portrait of a dark-haired middle-aged military man, half-profile to the left. Under the open greatcoat a dark blue general's dress uniform coat is visible. A row of decorations on the chest.

6706.dm: kõrgus: 76.3 cm (arm); laius: 65.5 cm (lm); kõrgus: 79.4 cm (lm); laius: 63.5 cm (arm)
6706.d: Tumedajuukselise keskealise mehe rinnapilt peapöördega paremale. Mustaraamiliste prillidega, sinises ülikonnas.
6706.de: Bust portrait of a dark-haired middle-aged man with head turned to the right. Wearing black-framed glasses, in a blue suit.

6707.d: Vanema mehe rinnapilt kolmveerand vasakule madalate hallide juustega sinise särgikraega, ookerkollasel foonil.
6707.de: Bust portrait of an older man three-quarters to the left, with low grey hair, blue shirt collar, on an ochre-yellow background.

6708.d: Kiilaspäise keskealise mehe põlvpilt kerge pöördega vasakule. Avatud kaelusega tööpluusi katab rinnuni ulatuv tugev sepa tööpõll. Tööle asumiseks kindaid kätte tõmbavast mehest vasakul ees sepavasar, kuna tagant paistavad sepikoja mehaanilised seadmed.
6708.de: Knee-length portrait of a bald-headed middle-aged man with a slight turn to the left. An open-collared work blouse is covered by a sturdy blacksmith's apron reaching to the chest. To the left in front of the man, who is pulling on gloves to start work, a blacksmith's hammer, while behind him the mechanical equipment of the smithy can be seen.

6709.d: Noore naise 1/4-figuur 1/2 pöördega paremale. Tumedad juuksed ja silmad. Vaade suunatud vaatajale. Peas helesinine rätik. Seljas helesinakas pluus punase dekooriga.
6709.de: 1/4-figure of a young woman with a 1/2 turn to the right. Dark hair and eyes. Gaze directed at the viewer. A light blue kerchief on her head. Wearing a light bluish blouse with red decoration.

6710.d: Vanamehe rinnakujutis kerges pöördes vasakule. Lühike juus. Seljas karvase kraega lambanahkne, sissepoole karvaga kasukas.
6710.de: Bust portrait of an old man in a slight turn to the left. Short hair. Wearing a sheepskin coat with a shaggy fur collar, fur turned inward.

6722.d: Tumehallil foonil kolmveerandpöördeskeskealise mehe rinnaportree: mehel juustepiir meelekohtadel taandunud, väikese kühmuga sirge nina. Seljas valge särk, tumesinine kuub ja tumepunane lai lips. Maalitud etüüdlikult, laiade pintslilöökidega.
6722.de: Bust portrait of a middle-aged man in three-quarter turn against a dark grey background: the man's hairline receding at the temples, a straight nose with a small bump. Wearing a white shirt, a dark blue coat and a wide dark red tie. Painted in an étude-like manner, with broad brushstrokes.
