6724.d: Esiplaanil hobuste ja vankritega mehed palke rannal seisvaist virnadest paatidesse vedamas. Paremal paar puud, ranna ääres vees paadid palkidega. Foonil rohekashall meri kahe purjekaga. Taevas merekarva, hallide pilvedega.
6724.de: In the foreground men with horses and carts carrying logs from piles standing on the shore into boats. On the right a couple of trees, boats with logs in the water by the shore. In the background a greenish-grey sea with two sailboats. The sky sea-coloured, with grey clouds.

6725.d: Esiplaanil rehealuses kaks naist lambaid pügamas. Neist paremal väike poiss villakorvi juures. Rehealusest avaneb maastikuvaade, kelpkatusega taluhoonega paremal. Talumaja ümber puud ja roigasaed. Taamal vasakul väike puumaja, silmapiiril mets. Majadevahelisel karjamaal, rehealuse läve juures sööb kari lambaid, punane lehm ning vasikas, pisut kaugemal must lehm. Erinevates toonides roheline üldkoloriit.
6725.de: In the foreground under the threshing barn's shelter two women are shearing sheep. To their right a small boy by a wool basket. From the shelter a landscape view opens up, with a hip-roofed farm building on the right. Trees and a pole fence around the farmhouse. In the distance on the left a small wooden house, forest on the horizon. On the pasture between the houses, by the threshold of the shelter, a flock of sheep is grazing, a red cow and a calf, a little further away a black cow. General colour scheme in various shades of green.

6726.d: Paljufiguuriline rannastseen: maaninal kolm võrgukuuri, millel vankriga hobune ja skitseerivalt antud inimgruppe. Esiplaanil keskel rannanaiste ja kalurite grupp kalu võrgust välja võtmas. Neist vasakul kolm, paremal nurgas üks paat nende juures askeldavate kaluritega. Kõrgel asetseva silmapiiri kohal rohekashall pilvine taevas ning tumedamas toonis meri laineharjadega ning merre ulatuvate maaribadega. Muidu värvilaikudena maalitud figuuride kehaosi piiritletud pruuni joonega.
6726.de: A multi-figure beach scene: on the headland, three net sheds, with a horse and cart and sketchily rendered groups of people. In the foreground in the middle, a group of beach women and fishermen taking fish out of a net. To their left three, in the right corner one boat with fishermen busying themselves nearby. Above the high-set horizon, a greenish-grey cloudy sky, and the sea in a darker tone with wave crests and strips of land reaching into the sea. Otherwise the body parts of the figures, painted as patches of colour, are outlined with a brown line.

6727.d: Vaade kaldanõlvakul paiknevale rannaäärsele talule. Vasakul madalate mändide vahelt paistab punase viilkatusega hoone ots. Sellest paremal, lattaedade vahel madal hallikas maja ümbritsetud puude-põõsastega. Taamal paremal kääruline lahesopp. Taevas hele, rohekassiniste pilvedega. Maalitud hoogsalt sinakas-, beežikas-rohelistes toonides.
6727.de: A view of a coastal farm situated on a sloping bank. On the left, between low pines, the end of a building with a red gable roof is visible. To the right of it, between pole fences, a low greyish house surrounded by trees and bushes. In the distance to the right a winding bay. The sky is bright, with greenish-blue clouds. Painted vigorously in bluish and beigish-green tones.

6728.d: Vaade sadamale mere poolt. Kai ääres otse ja vasakul väiksemad sõudepaadid, sadamasillal inimesi. Paremal kõrgete mastidega suuremad laevad. Taamal ühe- ja mitmekorruselised majad. Vasakul, helesinise taeva foonil kaks suitsevat korstnat, keskel Oleviste siluett. Maal sinises, hallis, pruunides toonides.
6728.de: A view of the harbour from the sea. Directly at the quay and on the left smaller rowing boats, people on the harbour pier. On the right larger ships with tall masts. Beyond, one- and multi-storey houses. On the left, against a light blue sky background, two smoking chimneys, in the middle the silhouette of St. Olaf's Church (Oleviste). The painting in blue, grey and brown tones.

6729.d: Esiplaanil veekogu ääres heinamaa kirevate lilledega esiplaanil, vasakul triibulises särgis ja mütsis mees niitmas, tema taga valges pluusis korviga naine, reha õlal. Paremal luiskab roosas pluusis naine vikatit, temast paremal ja vasakul kaks inimest niitmas. Veekogu ääres põõsaid, taamal heinamaa ja metsatukad. Sinakasrohelistes külmades värvitoonides.
6729.de: In the foreground, by a body of water, a meadow with colourful flowers in the foreground, on the left a man in a striped shirt and cap mowing, behind him a woman in a white blouse with a basket, a rake on her shoulder. On the right a woman in a pink blouse whets a scythe, to her right and left two people mowing. Bushes along the water, further away a meadow and small woods. In cold bluish-green tones.

6730.d: Esiplaanil kidura taimestikuga liivane rannaäärne jämedatüvelise männiga keskel. Viimase läheduses karjatab laps lambakarja. Vasakul servas väike palkmaja halli tara ning paari lehtpuuga. Paremas servas helepruun viilkatuse ja roheline, kelpkatusega maja kuuskede vahel. Pildi rõhtjoonel lippidest aed. Taamal kooguga kaev, mõned majad ja sügavsinine meri. Ülal üksikute pilvedega taevas.
6730.de: In the foreground a sandy shore with sparse vegetation and a thick-trunked pine tree in the centre. Near it a child herds a flock of sheep. On the left edge a small log house with a grey fence and a couple of deciduous trees. On the right edge a light brown gable-roofed house and a green hip-roofed house among spruces. On the horizontal line of the picture a fence made of pickets. Further back a well with a sweep, a few houses and a deep-blue sea. Above, a sky with scattered clouds.

6731.dm: kõrgus: 55.3 cm; laius: 55.3 cm (b külje kujutise mõõt); kõrgus: 62.2 cm (b külje kujutise mõõt); laius: 62.2 cm
6731.d: a. Külatänav lattidest taraga, tagaplaanil mõned majad ja puud, maapinnal lumelaigud. Hallikas koloriit.
6731.de: a. Village street with a pole fence, in the background some houses and trees, patches of snow on the ground. Greyish colouring.

6732.d: Naised kalu puhastamas, paati tühjendamas, mehed hobusevankri juures, keskel ees väike poiss korviga. Paremal meri, kalda ääres purjekad, tagaplaanil hooned.
6732.de: Women cleaning fish, emptying a boat, men by a horse cart, in the centre foreground a small boy with a basket. At right the sea, sailboats along the shore, buildings in the background.

6733.d: Mees ja kolm naist heina riisumas ja saadudesse panemas, paremal ees kaks last ja koer sao ääres. Tagaplaanil taluhooned ja puud. Tuhm, rohekas koloriit.
6733.de: A man and three women raking hay and putting it into stacks, in front on the right two children and a dog by the stack. In the background, farm buildings and trees. Dull, greenish colouring.

6734.d: Helerohelistes toonides heinamaa, millest läbi lookleb jalgrada, mõned mändidegrupid. Tagaplaanil üksikud majad ning tume metsaviirg, vasakul veekogu nurk.
6734.de: A meadow in light green tones, through which a footpath winds, some groups of pines. In the background scattered houses and a dark strip of forest, on the left a corner of a body of water.

6735.d: Tumerohelised männid, neli madalat puithoonet, pilves hall taevas.
6735.de: Dark green pines, four low wooden buildings, a cloudy gray sky.

6740.d: Sinakashall meri sulab silmapiiril kokku sama halli taevaga. Üle kogu merepinna kaootiliselt paigutunud kaluripaadid, milledes mehed askeldavad võrkudega. Kokku on 19 paati. Taamal, pildi paremal poolel asuvad kolm heisatud purjedega vaevumärgatavat paati. Paatide kohal tiirlevad kajakad. Impressionistliku maalilaadiga.
6740.de: The bluish-grey sea merges with the equally grey sky on the horizon. Fishing boats with men busy with nets are chaotically scattered across the entire sea surface. In total there are 19 boats. In the distance, on the right side of the picture, three barely noticeable boats with raised sails. Seagulls circle above the boats. In an impressionistic painting style.

6766.d: Teivasaia taga aia nurgas väike roosa majake. Kaugemal, naaberaias kõrgetüvelised raagus puud.
6766.de: Behind a pole fence, in the corner of the garden, a small pink house. Farther away, in the neighboring garden, tall bare trees.

6771.d: Noore naise kolmveerand figuur. Pea poolprofiilis vasakule. Istuvas asendis, parem käsivars toetatud lauale.
6771.de: Three-quarter figure of a young woman. Head in half-profile to the left. In a sitting position, right forearm resting on a table.

6772.dm: lehe laius: 25.0 cm; lehe kõrgus: 35.0 cm
6772.d: Hommikumantlis istuva noore naise täisfiguur; poolprofiilis vasakule. Mantli hõlmad avatud. Seljas valge pesu. Parem käsi toetatud kõrvalolevale laual.
6772.de: Full figure of a young woman sitting in a dressing gown; in half-profile to the left. The flaps of the gown open. Wearing white underwear. Right hand resting on the table beside her.

6789.d: Ees kitsal rannaribal paremal kaks seisvat ja üks hobusel sõjaväelane, vasakul grupp relvastatud sõjaväelasi (selgvaates) sammumas paadisillale. Silla juures vees paat sõjaväelastega. Horisondil näha vastaskalda joon.
6789.de: In the foreground on a narrow strip of shore on the right two standing soldiers and one on horseback, on the left a group of armed soldiers (seen frontally) marching towards a boat pier. By the pier a boat with soldiers in the water. On the horizon the line of the opposite shore can be seen.

6803.dm: kõrgus: 35.5 cm; laius: 47.8 cm (vm); kõrgus: 37.0 cm; laius: 46.8 cm (km)
6803.d: Esiplaanil keskel taluhooned ja naisefiguur kaevul. Maja taga ja vasemal üksikud puud; paremal küngas. Tagapool mere poole kõrgenev kallas vasemal, paremal madalamal puuderida. Taamal meri.
6803.de: In the foreground centre farm buildings and a female figure at a well. Behind the house and to the left solitary trees; on the right a hill. Further back a shore rising toward the sea on the left, on the right a lower row of trees. Beyond, the sea.

6804.dm: kõrgus: 47.0 cm; laius: 61.5 cm (vm); kõrgus: 48.5 cm; laius: 60.3 cm (km)
6804.d: Esiplaanil looklev oja puudereaga ääristatud. Paremal kaldal üksikud väikesed majad. Taga tõusevad rohelised mäed, kauguses lumised mäeharjad.
6804.de: In the foreground a winding stream lined with a row of trees. On the right bank a few small houses. Behind, green mountains rise, in the distance snowy mountain ridges.

6818.d: Ees lage, üksikute raagus põõsastega lumine plats. Tagapool, vasakul, üksikud suured raagus puud, keskel kuusk. Puude taga teivasaiast piiratud hooned. Paremal vaade üle jäätunud veekogu taamal olevale asulale.
6818.de: In front, an open snowy area with a few bare bushes. Further back, on the left, a few large bare trees, a spruce in the middle. Behind the trees, buildings enclosed by a pole fence. On the right, a view over a frozen body of water to a settlement in the distance.

6823.d: Interjöör esialal keskel viini tooliga, millel vaas lilledega; tooli ees põrandal turukorv aedviljaga, korvi kõrval seeni. Vasakul näha ümmarguse laua serv lilledega. Taga paremal ukseaval seisev naine.
6823.de: Interior, in the foreground centre a Vienna chair with a vase of flowers on it; in front of the chair on the floor a market basket with vegetables, mushrooms beside the basket. On the left the edge of a round table with flowers is visible. Behind, on the right, a woman standing in a doorway.

6827.d: Ees keskel kahe seisva mehe täisfiguurid. Paremal toolile asetatud maal. Parempoolse mehe jalg toetatud toolile. Parema käega hoiab vaadatavat teost. Vasakpoolsel käed ristamisi rinnal.
6827.de: In front in the center full figures of two standing men. On the right a painting placed on a chair. The right-hand man's leg is resting on the chair. With his right hand he holds the work being viewed. The left-hand man has his arms crossed on his chest.

6831.d: Esiplaanil kahel pool raagus puud ja vasakul mäenõlv. Tagapool paistavad uduselt majade katused ja raekoja torn. Maapind ja katused kaetud lumega.
6831.de: In the foreground on both sides bare trees and on the left a hillside. Behind, the roofs of houses and the town hall tower appear hazily. Ground and roofs covered with snow.

6847.d: Esiplaanil varemete vahel töötavad taastajad, keskel väljaku ehitajad, taga Niguliste kiriku varemed.
6847.de: In the foreground, restorers working among ruins, in the centre builders of the square, behind the ruins of St. Nicholas' Church.

6848.d: Esiplaanil vasakul madalas vees asuvalt paadilt täies relvastuses mehi välja ronimas; keskel vees paremal asuva kivise ranna suunas jooksvaid sõdureid, kelledest mõned juba jõudnud randa. Rannal madal männik, millest üle paistavad mürskude detonatsioonidest tekkinud tule ja suitsusambad. Aovalguses taeval üksikuid pilvi.
6848.de: In the foreground at left, fully armed men are climbing out of a boat in shallow water; in the middle, soldiers running through the water towards a rocky shore at right, some of whom have already reached the shore. On the shore a low pine grove, above which pillars of fire and smoke from shell detonations are visible. In the dawn light, scattered clouds in the sky.

6849.d: Esiplaanil lage koht. Vasakul purustatud katusega hoone ees viis sõdurit suurtüki taga askeldamas. Paremal viis sõdurit valmistumas rünnakuks.
6849.de: In the foreground an open area. On the left, in front of a building with a damaged roof, five soldiers busy behind a cannon. On the right five soldiers preparing for an attack.

6864.de: Three men painting in front of easels.

6865.d: Ees keskel telefonipost. Pisut tagapool vasakul vedur, keskel depoo otsvaade, paremal rida kaubavaguneid.
6865.de: In the front centre a telephone pole. A little further back on the left a locomotive, in the middle a frontal view of a depot, on the right a row of freight cars.

6868.d: Ees paat, paadi otstes paati aerudega paigalhoidvad mehed, paadi keskel kaks veest võrku välja tõmbavat meest. Taga vasakul vette ulatuv neemik kõrgete puudega.
6868.de: In the foreground, a boat; at the ends of the boat, men holding it in place with oars, in the middle of the boat two men pulling a net out of the water. In the background on the left, a headland reaching into the water with tall trees.

6874.d: Murtud hallikates ja rohekates ning üksikutes, nendega harmoneeruvates roosakasvioletsetes toonides maalitud külamaastik veekogu ääres. Esi- ja keskplaanil peegelsileda veepinnaga hõbehall tiik. Esiplaanil vasakus kuldlõikes väike maariba sellel kasvava hõreda lehestikuga puuga, mis maapinnalt hargneb paljudeks pikkadeks, peenteks, habrasteks tüvedeks. Tagaplaanil, veekogu kaldal, kolm ühekorruselist hoonet, neist parempoolne osaliselt lehtpuudesalu varjus. Hele-sinakashall taevas.
6874.de: A village landscape by a body of water, painted in broken greyish and greenish tones and, in a few places, in harmonising pinkish-violet tones. In the foreground and middle ground, a silver-grey pond with a mirror-smooth water surface. In the foreground, on the left, in the golden section, a small strip of land with a tree with sparse foliage growing on it, which branches from the ground into many long, thin, fragile trunks. In the background, on the shore of the body of water, three single-storey buildings, of which the one on the right is partially shaded by a grove of deciduous trees. A light bluish-grey sky.

6906.d: Esiplaanil rand üksikute kivide ja mändidega. Taga meri. Vasakul ja taamal rannariba metsaga.
6906.de: In the foreground a beach with solitary stones and pines. Behind it the sea. On the left and in the distance a strip of shore with forest.

6947.d: Keskel kuuskede vahel tahumata palkidest ehitatud onn.
6947.de: In the middle, among spruces, a hut built of unhewn logs.

6948.d: Esiplaanil tänava nurgal viltu vajunud telefonipost. Taga diagonaalselt vasemalt paremale kulgeva tänava ääres varemeis hooneid. Nende vahel põõsaid ja kolm lehtpuud.
6948.de: In the foreground on a street corner a telephone pole leaning askew. Behind it, along a street running diagonally from left to right, ruined buildings. Between them bushes and three deciduous trees.

6955.d: Avar panoraammaastik erksinise järvesilmaga keskel. Järve kaldal üksikud puud, kaldad tõusevad küngastikuks. Taamal ülal metsatukad ja hall taevaviirg. Maalitud pastoosselt, kohati spaatli ja pintslivarrega. Kollakasroheline värvigamma.
6955.de: Wide panoramic landscape with a bright blue lake in the centre. Solitary trees on the lakeshore, the banks rising into a hilly area. Further away above, patches of forest and a grey strip of sky. Painted pastosely, in places with a palette knife and the brush handle. Yellowish-green colour range.

6985.d: Esiplaanil paremal küün, selle juures askeldava viie inimesega, kolm neist istuvad. Taga tume okaspuumets.
6985.de: In the foreground on the right a barn, with five people busy near it, three of them sitting. Behind, a dark coniferous forest.

7002.d: Esiplaanil oleva laua taga istuva sileda, lühikesejuukselise soenguga naise poolfiguur. En face. Sõrmed toetavad alustassi servadele. Laual klaaskauss, leivataldrik, kruus.
7002.de: Half-figure of a woman with smooth, short-haired hairstyle sitting behind a table in the foreground. En face. Her fingers rest on the edges of a saucer. On the table a glass bowl, a bread plate, a mug.

7008.d: Prillidega noore mehe rinnaportree kerges pöördes paremale. Lühikesed juuksed, kõrge laup, lühike laiavõitu nina. Seljas hall pintsak, sinine pluus tumeda lipsuga, foon kirju halli põhitooniga. Maalitud laiade, erivärviliste pintslilöökidega.
7008.de: Bust portrait of a young bespectacled man, in a slight turn to the right. Short hair, high forehead, short broad nose. Wearing a grey jacket, a blue blouse with a dark tie, background variegated with a grey base tone. Painted with broad, differently coloured brushstrokes.

7016.d: Esiplaanil sileda pinnaga veekogu, all, paremal tükike lagedat randa, kus profiilis paremale astuv, pikas rõivas naisfiguur. Paremal, keskel, üle veekogu maismaa-riba. Ülal sinakas-hallikas-rohekas taevas.
7016.de: In the foreground a body of water with a smooth surface, below, on the right, a strip of open shore, where a female figure in a long garment steps in profile to the right. On the right, in the middle, a strip of land across the water. Above, a bluish-grayish-greenish sky.

7017.d: All, esiplaanil, horisontaalne rida värvilistest põõsastest, millede seas, vasakul, peenikese võraga ja väheste, kollakate lehtedega, üksik puu. Keskel lehe laiuses horisontaalne rida tumepunastes ja lillades toonides, madalaid maju valgete korstendega. Taevas tumesinine-rohekas-lilla.
7017.de: Below, in the foreground, a horizontal row of colourful bushes, among which, on the left, a solitary tree with a thin crown and few yellowish leaves. In the middle, spanning the width of the sheet, a horizontal row in dark red and purple tones, low houses with white chimneys. Sky dark blue-green-purple.

7032.d: Ees keskel poolitavad pildi kaheks paar peenikest puutüve. Paremas servas puudeoksi, vasakus maja nurk. Rohekas-hallist foonist oranžikas toonis kolmnurkne laik. Maalitud säpsivate, lühikeste pintslilöökidega.
7032.de: In the front centre, a pair of thin tree trunks divide the picture in two. In the right edge tree branches, on the left the corner of a house. Against a greenish-grey background, a triangular patch in an orangish tone. Painted with jerky, short brushstrokes.

7033.d: Punasel riidel istuv tiibadega, alasti mehefiguur. Pea pöördes paremale; parem käsi vasakul reiel, vasak toetumas taha. Vasakus servas samba kapiteeli ning ülaosa kujutis. Maalitud etüüdlikult.
7033.de: A winged, nude male figure sitting on red fabric. Head turned to the right; right hand on the left thigh, left hand resting behind. In the left margin the depiction of a column capital and its upper part. Painted in an étude-like manner.

7036.d: Keskplaanis, valgetel linadel lamav naisakt, põlved kõverdatud, parem käsi niudeil, vasak küünarnukist kõverdatult voodil, pea kuklasse heidetud. Vasakult langeb valgus naise kõhule. Foon rohekashall, esiplaan maalitud pastoosses värvilises pintslikirjas.
7036.de: In the central plan, a female nude lying on white sheets, knees bent, right hand on hip, left arm bent at the elbow on the bed, head thrown back. Light falls on the woman's belly from the left. Background greenish-grey, foreground painted in a pastose, colourful brush stroke.

7089.d: Otsevaates naise rinnaportree: naisel pisut puhevil sõõrmetega nina ja tugeva ülahuulega suu, tumedad kitsad kulmukaared, kõrge laup. Hallisegused satäänid juuksed kuklasse rullidesse seatud. Seljas tume, valge pitskraega kleit, rinnal rahvuslikus laadis sõlg.
7089.de: Frontal bust portrait of a woman: the woman has a slightly flared nose and a mouth with a full upper lip, dark narrow eyebrow arches, a high forehead. Greyish satin hair arranged in rolls at the nape. Wearing a dark dress with a white lace collar, a brooch in national style on the chest.

7107.d: Lumine tänav. Mõlemal pool kahekorruselised, punaste viilkatustega majad. Tänava servas kased, Kaetud paksult valge härmatisega. Kontuurid kergelt rõhutatud; maalipind osaliselt faktuurne.
7107.de: A snowy street. On both sides two-storey houses with red gable roofs. Birches at the edge of the street, thickly covered with white frost. Contours slightly emphasised; the paint surface partly textured.

7127.d: Korovonlikult impressionistlikus laadis maalitud rahvarohke stseen: esiplaanil vasakul ja paremal inimesed, hobused, kõik antud võbelevate värvilaikude kõrvuti asetamisega. Ülal vasakul kaks suurt maja (ühel neist valge korsten). Tagumise maja kõrval mõned puud ja põõsad. Ülal beež taevas. Maalitud kollakaspruunides toonides.
7127.de: A crowd scene painted in a Korovin-like impressionistic manner: in the foreground on the left and right people, horses, all rendered through the juxtaposition of flickering patches of colour. Upper left two large houses (one of them with a white chimney). Beside the rear house some trees and bushes. Upper part beige sky. Painted in yellowish-brown tones.

7128.d: Eskiiskavand paljufiguurilisele kompositsioonile: esiplaanil oleval rannaribal moodustavad kalurid ja valgetes rättides rannanaised kompositsioonilisi gruppe. Rannal mõned vankri ette rakendatud hobused, neli väikeste purjedega paati on kaldale tõmmatud. Paremal servas rookatustega kalurihütid üksikute puudega nende taga. Silmapiiril tume meri, ülal pilvine taevas. Hallikaspruunis üldkoloriidis on kõik detailid antud skitseerivalt.
7128.de: A sketch for a multi-figure composition: on the strip of beach in the foreground, fishermen and beach women in white headscarves form compositional groups. On the beach a few horses harnessed to carts, four small-sailed boats have been pulled ashore. At the right edge fishermen's huts with reed roofs, with individual trees behind them. On the horizon a dark sea, above a cloudy sky. In an overall greyish-brown colouring all details are rendered sketchily.

7156.d: Rohekashallides pastelsetes toonides maalitud ülaltvaade linnale. Vasakul punakad viilkatused, puukroonid, keskel silmapiiri suunas ahenev tänav aimatavate sõidukite ja inimestega. Taamal ja paremal servas kollakate valguslaikudega majasein, ülaosas karniis. Maalitud lühikese pintslilöögiga, puude osas pastoossemalt.
7156.de: A view of a town from above, painted in greenish-grey pastel tones. On the left reddish gable roofs, tree crowns, in the centre a street narrowing towards the horizon with vaguely discernible vehicles and people. In the distance and on the right edge a house wall with yellowish patches of light, a cornice at the top. Painted with short brushstrokes, more impasto in the trees.

7157.d: Pildi allääres punaste katustega, kõrgete korstendega majad, taustaks suur lehtpuude grupp. Vasakul paistab puude vahelt valge, helerohelise katusega hoone. Paremal suubub maali sügavusse lai, sirge tänav. Koloriit hele, hallika üldtooniga.

7169.d: Linnavaate esiplaanil paremal lagunenud voodi lumes, keskel kõrgepinge liini raudsõrestikposte. Taamal majad.
7169.de: In the foreground of the city view, on the right a dilapidated bed in the snow, in the middle steel lattice poles of a high-voltage line. Houses in the distance.

7170.d: Esiplaanil vasakult paremale suunduv jõekäär. Jõekaldal rida raagud puid. Taamal keskosas silla kontuurid.
7170.de: A river bend running from left to right in the foreground. A row of bare trees on the riverbank. In the middle background, the outlines of a bridge.

7171.d: Ees lage kivine rand üksikute põõsastega, rohu ja lillelaikudega. Kaugemal kuni horisondini laiuv meri.
7171.de: In front, a bare stony shore with occasional bushes, patches of grass and flowers. Farther away the sea extending to the horizon.

7172.d: Tumedajuukselise kabimütsis ja rahvarõivais poolfiguuris vasakule noore naise põlvpilt.
7172.de: A knee-length portrait of a dark-haired young woman in a bonnet and folk costume, in half-figure view to the left.

7173.d: Tugitoolis istuva vanema sõjaväelase põlvpilt. Keha kerge pöördega vasakule. Pea en face. Seljas sinine kindrali esindusmunder. Rinnas aurahad.
7173.de: Knee-length portrait of an older military man sitting in an armchair. Body slightly turned to the left. Head en face. Wearing a blue general's dress uniform. Medals on his chest.

7174.d: Esiplaanil tööpingi taga seisev töötav naine kolmveerand vasakule, üleskääritud varrukatega, tööpõlles, sinise pluusiga ja punase pearätikuga, tagaplaanil ääsi ees töötavad mehed.
7174.de: In the foreground a working woman standing at a workbench, three-quarters turned to the left, with rolled-up sleeves, in a work apron, with a blue blouse and a red headscarf, in the background men working in front of a forge.

7236.d: Esiplaanil rannal kirevates riietes rahvahulk, tagaplaanil sünge meri ja hoonete katused.
7236.de: In the foreground on the beach a crowd in colourful clothes, in the background the gloomy sea and roofs of buildings.

7237.d: Keskealise tumedajuukselise mehe rinnapilt poolprofiilis paremale, sinakas kuues.
7237.de: Chest-length portrait of a middle-aged, dark-haired man in three-quarter profile facing right, wearing a bluish coat.

7238.d: Esiplaanil põõsastik, keskel järve kaldal taluhooned, taamal künklik maastik metsatukkadega.
7238.de: In the foreground, shrubbery, farm buildings in the centre on the lakeshore, a hilly landscape with groves of trees beyond.

7239.d: Esiplaanil vasakul maastikukallakul maju, keskel järv, taamal kõrgeneval maastikul talumaja ja mets.

7240.d: Esiplaanil sügavusse suunduv põldudevaheline külatänav, piiratud kivitaraga; tänaval rühm inimesi. Taamal taluhooneid ja puid.
7240.de: In the foreground a village street between fields, leading into the depth, bordered by a stone fence; a group of people on the street. In the distance farm buildings and trees.

7242.d: Esiplaanil põllud, taamal all orus järve ääres grupp maju. Selle taga künklik maastik metsaga.
7242.de: In the foreground fields, in the distance below in a valley by a lake a group of houses. Behind it a hilly landscape with forest.

7243.d: Esiplaanil paremal ja vasakul lumise okaspuu metsa all meeste figuure laasimas, saagimas. Paremal puude all lõkketule ääres istuvaid inimfiguure.
7243.de: In the foreground on the right and left, under a snowy coniferous forest, figures of men pruning branches, sawing. On the right, under the trees, figures of people sitting by a campfire.

7245.d: Ees rannaliivale laotatud linal naised lambaid pügamas. Vasakul vee ääres naisi ja mehi lambaid pesemas. Taga paremal rannamaastik taluhoonetega, vasakul meri.
7245.de: In front, women shearing sheep on a sheet spread on the beach sand. On the left by the water women and men washing sheep. Behind on the right a coastal landscape with farm buildings, on the left the sea.

7246.d: Lumisel jääl mehi jääplaate murdmas. Tagapool hobuseid koormatega. Taamal mets, vasakult paistab kõrge vabrikuhoone suitseva korstnaga. Koloriit hall, tume.
7246.de: On the snowy ice, men breaking ice plates. Behind them horses with loads. In the distance a forest, on the left a tall factory building with a smoking chimney is visible. Colouring grey, dark.

7247.dm: kõrgus: 43.5 cm (vm); laius: 37.5 cm (vineeri mõõt); kõrgus: 46.2 cm (vineeri mõõt); laius: 35.5 cm (vm)
7247.d: Ees puude vahel lumised pargiteed üksikute figuuridega. Taga kõrged majad.
7247.de: In front, among trees, snowy park paths with solitary figures. Behind, tall buildings.

7248.d: Esiplaanil tasandik, keskel mäenõlvak põõsaste ja puudega, taamal künklik maastik.
7248.de: In the foreground a plain, in the middle a mountain slope with bushes and trees, in the distance a hilly landscape.

7252.d: Esiplaanil valge linaga kaetud lamandil tekiga kaetud lamav figuur selgvaates. Katmata pea padjal. Vasakul tool riietega. Foon valkjas, tekk beežikas-sinisega. Foon ja teki osa õhukese värvikihiga, lina tugevate pintslitõmmetega maalitud.
7252.de: In the foreground, on a couch covered with a white sheet, a reclining figure covered with a blanket, seen from the front. The uncovered head rests on a pillow. On the left a chair with clothes. The background whitish, the blanket beige-blue. The background and part of the blanket are painted with a thin layer of paint, the sheet with strong brushstrokes.

7258.d: Esiplaanil raagus puude vahelt vaade lumistele linnamajadele. Tagant paistavad suitsevad tehase korstnad.
7258.de: In the foreground, a view through bare trees of snowy town houses. In the background smoking factory chimneys are visible.

7260.d: Esiplaanil lage, määrdunud lumega kaetud org. Tagapool pikk madal rehehoone. Paremal, hoone ees, naine punases seelikus, ämber vasakus käes.
7260.de: In the foreground an open valley covered with dirty snow. Behind it a long low threshing barn. On the right, in front of the building, a woman in a red skirt, a bucket in her left hand.

7261.d: Noore naise rinnaportree. Tume juus, lilla hallikasruuduline rõivastus. Pea pööratud veidi vasakule.
7261.de: Bust portrait of a young woman. Dark hair, purple greyish-checked clothing. Head turned slightly to the left.

7265.d: Istuva vanamehe 3/4 figuur kerges pöördes paremale, kaabu peas, tumepunane kampsun, must vest. Piip vasakus käes. Vana talutuba, taadi selja taga väike aken.
7265.de: Three-quarter figure of a seated old man, slightly turned to the right, wearing a hat, dark red jumper, black waistcoat. A pipe in his left hand. An old peasant room, a small window behind the old man's back.

7267.d: Seisva noore naise 3/4 figuur sinise mantli ja laiaäärse kübaraga, käed taskus, vaade üle vasaku õla. Mantli hõlmad avatud - valge pluus, hall seelik, pluus lilla sidusega. Foon hele. Vasakul altäärest ja paremalt nurgast näha lõuend.
7267.de: A 3/4 figure of a standing young woman with a blue coat and a wide-brimmed hat, hands in pockets, gaze cast over the left shoulder. The coat's front open - a white blouse, a grey skirt, the blouse with a purple trim. Background light. On the left from the lower edge and from the right corner the canvas is visible.

7270.d: Esiplaanil laual vasakul kõrge kaelaga valge kann, paremal madal vaas. Taga pildiraamide külge drapeeritud punase ja mustaruuduline riie, mille üks ots voltidena lauale ulatuv.
7270.de: In the foreground on a table, on the left a tall-necked white jug, on the right a low vase. Behind, a red and black checkered cloth draped over picture frames, one end of which reaches the table in folds.

7276.d: Esiplaanil rohtmaal kaks põõsast, keskel üle pildipinna ulatuv roigastara, mille taga segametsa taustal kelpkatusega talumaja.
7276.de: In the foreground on grassland two bushes, in the middle a pole fence extending across the picture plane, behind which a farmhouse with a hipped roof against a background of mixed forest.

7351.d: Künklik varakevadine maastik. Esiplaanil lahtist vett ja raagus põõsaid. Mõlema ääre suunas kerkivail nõlvakuil kuuski. Taamal keskel hooneid.
7351.de: Hilly early-spring landscape. In the foreground open water and bare bushes. On the slopes rising towards both edges, spruces. In the background, buildings in the middle.

7358.d: Esiplaanil külavahetee, mida vasakult poolt ääristab kiviaed ja talumajad. Paremal pool tee ääres kaks tuulikut.
7358.de: In the foreground a village road, bordered on the left by a stone wall and farmhouses. On the right, beside the road, two windmills.

7363.d: Ees keskel eest taha suunduv lumine tänav. Vasakul ees plankaia taga üksik raagus puu ja kahekordne hoone. Tagapool madalamate hoonete rida. Paremal plangu taga kaks kasvuhoonet kõrgete korstnatega. Taga majad.
7363.de: In the middle foreground, a snowy street leading from front to back. On the left in front, behind a plank fence, a lone bare tree and a two-story building. Further back, a row of lower buildings. On the right, behind a fence, two greenhouses with tall chimneys. Houses in the back.

7364.d: Roheka tausta foonil valgel alusel lamav naisakt. Vasak käsi ning jalg kõverdatud. Ülakeha toetumas padjale, pea pööratud vasakule, vaatajast ära. Maalitud laiade, vabade pintslitõmmetega; figuuri modelleerimisel kasutatud värvipinda sissekraapimist.
7364.de: A female nude lying on a white base against a greenish background. Left arm and leg bent. Upper body resting on a pillow, head turned to the left, away from the viewer. Painted with broad, free brush strokes; scraping into the paint surface was used in modelling the figure.

7369.d: Punakalt kumava näoga naise portree: seljas ookrikarva kolmnurkse kaelaväljalõikega pluus, väikesed silmad ja suu, juuksed langevad sirgelt seljale. Ülestõstetud parema käe sõrmede vahel hoiab kergelt pea kohal kätele ja õlgadele langevat valget linikut. Vasak käsi toetab õla ümber mähkunud liniku serva. Foon rohekates ja hallides toonides.
7369.de: Portrait of a woman with a reddish glowing face: wearing an ochre-coloured blouse with a triangular neckline, small eyes and mouth, hair falling straight down her back. Between the fingers of her raised right hand she holds a white cloth slightly above her head, falling onto her hands and shoulders. Her left hand supports the edge of the cloth wrapped around her shoulder. Background in greenish and grey tones.

7371.d: Samblarohekal, diagonaalsete pintslitõmmetega maalitud foonil kaks kõrvuti asetsevat pruuni lillepotti piklike lehtedega kaktustega. Parempoolsel kaktusel kaardunud varre küljes lopsakas punakas-roosa roosõieline õis. Vorme peene kuiva pintsliga markeeritud.
7371.de: Against a moss-green background painted with diagonal brushstrokes, two brown flowerpots side by side with cacti of elongated leaves. On the cactus on the right, on a curved stem, a lush reddish-pink rose-like blossom. Forms marked with a fine dry brush.

7397.d: Paremal pildipoolel jõgi, järsu pöördega keskkohal, samas suitsev laev, kalda ääres paate, taga sillakaared. Vasakul puiestee ja mitmekorruselised majad. Kauguses linna panoraam. Domineerivad pruunikad toonid, kontrasteeruvad erksad sinised.
7397.de: On the right side of the picture, a river with a sharp bend in the middle, at the same spot a smoking ship, boats along the shore, bridge arches behind. On the left, a boulevard and multi-storey houses. A panorama of the city in the distance. Brownish tones dominate, contrasted by bright blues.

7399.d: Hallika taeva all suviselt roheline, põllusiilude ja metsaga kaetud, kupliline maastik. Paremal üksik, vasakul, künka taga kaks talumaja. Maalitud hoogsalt rohekais- ja ookertoonides.
7399.de: Under a grey sky a summery green, domed landscape covered with field patches and forest. On the right a single farmhouse, on the left, behind a hill, two farmhouses. Painted vigorously in greenish and ochre tones.

7400.d: Sünge, hallipilvise taeva all hoonetega ümbritsetud mäenõlvak. Mäel vasakul, puude vahelt paistab kiriku punakaspruun katus ja tornikiiver, paremal üle mäe viiv loogeline maantee. Koloriit hallikas-, kohati mustjasroheline, üksikud kollakad põllulaigud vahel. Pintslilöök jõuline.
7400.de: A gloomy mountain slope surrounded by buildings under a grey-clouded sky. On the mountain on the left, through the trees, the reddish-brown roof and spire of a church are visible; on the right a winding highway leads over the mountain. The colouring is greyish, in places blackish-green, with occasional yellowish field patches. The brushwork is vigorous.

7406.d: Panoraamne talvemaastik. Esiplaanil vasakul all puude vahel kolmest hoonest koosnev talumajapidamine; lääbakil tara taga üks naine pumbakaevust vett võtmas, teine kahe ämbriga käes lauta suundumas, allservas paremal väike saun. Kõrgemal küngaste vahel madalad metsatukad ja võsad ning üksikuist puudest ümbritsetud lummemattunud talumajad. Ülal hall, sume talvine taevas. Domineerivad hallid ja pruunid toonid.
7406.de: A panoramic winter landscape. In the foreground on the lower left, among trees, a farmstead consisting of three buildings; behind a low fence one woman drawing water from a pump-well, another heading to the barn with two buckets in hand, at the bottom right a small sauna. Higher up, among the hills, low patches of forest and scrub, and farmhouses buried in snow surrounded by solitary trees. Above, a grey, hazy winter sky. Grey and brown tones dominate.

7418.d: Esiplaanil eest taha kulgev tee, paremal karjavärav ja teelahk, mis suundub vasemale. Tee palistatud kõrgeist lehtpuist. Vasemal taga meri.
7418.de: In the foreground a road running from front to back, on the right a cattle gate and a fork in the road leading to the left. The road is lined with tall deciduous trees. In the background on the left, the sea.

7422.d: Paremal rõduga aida ees teel töövankur. Vasakpoolsel tee äärsel muruplatsil 3 suurt lehtpuud. Nende taga taluhoone. Taga risti üle tee karjavärav.
7422.de: On the right a work-cart on the road in front of a barn with a balcony. On the left side of the road, on a lawn, 3 large deciduous trees. Behind them a farm building. Further back a cattle gate across the road.

7423.d: Esiplaanil kivine mererand. Paremal kaks üksikut mändi, keskel lootsikuid ja võrgumaju. Taamal kõrgel kaldal männimets, vasakul avameri.
7423.de: In the foreground a rocky sea shore. On the right two solitary pines, in the middle boats and net-sheds. Beyond, on a high bank, a pine forest, on the left the open sea.

7426.d: Töötoas vasakul akende all pika laua ääres nais- ja meestöölised vaatamas savinõusid põrandal. Taga (paremal) laeni ülatuv riiul savinõudega. Selle kõrval avatud uks kõrvalruumi.
7426.de: In the workshop, on the left under the windows, along a long table, male and female workers looking at pottery on the floor. Behind (on the right) a shelf reaching to the ceiling with pottery. Next to it an open door to an adjoining room.

7430.d: Kloostri õue sisekäik hoonetega vasakul ja paremal. Vasaku hoone taga näha neli kiriku kuplit.
7430.de: Interior passage of a monastery courtyard with buildings on the left and right. Behind the left building four church domes are visible.

7437.d: Vasakul ja paremal asuvate pooleliolevate puuehituste vahel saevad, kopsivad, raiuvad mehed laudu. Vasakul ja paremal kaks meest tellingutel. Tagaplaanil traktor, mis sõidutab lauakoormat ning ülestõstetud puuhaamriga mees traktori taga lauahunnikul. Lauavirnade taga, maja sarikatel lehvib kaks punast lippu. Ülal helesinine, valgete pilvedega kaetud taevas.
7437.de: Between the unfinished wooden buildings on the left and right, men are sawing, knocking and chopping boards. Two men on scaffolding on the left and right. In the background a tractor hauling a load of boards, and a man with a raised wooden hammer behind the tractor on a pile of boards. Behind the stacks of boards, on the rafters of the house, two red flags are flying. Above, a light blue sky covered with white clouds.

7439.d: Suvine vaade taluhoovi. Keskel vasakul kohati ammaldunud õlgkatusega ristpalkidest ait. Aida uks on avatud. Paremal tagapool paiknev elumaja on heledas pruunikas koloriidis. Taamal väravad ning aed. Ees paremas servas kõrge vinnaga kaev. Taustaks pilvine suvetaevas. Ees all keskel tolmune tee. Paremal ja vasakul näha maakividest aeda.
7439.de: Summer view of a farmyard. In the middle left a cross-log barn with a partly bare thatched roof. The barn door is open. The dwelling house situated further right in the background is in a light brownish colour scheme. In the distance gates and a garden. In the right foreground a tall well sweep. The background is a cloudy summer sky. In the foreground centre a dusty road. On the right and left a fieldstone fence can be seen.

7443.dm: lehe kõrgus: 43.3 cm; kujutise laius: 49.5 cm; kujutise kõrgus: 34.4 cm; lehe laius: 56.0 cm
7443.d: Esiplaanil kõrkjais veekogu, tagapool paremal paadis õngitseja. Taamal näha kaldariba.
7443.de: In the foreground a body of water with reeds, behind it on the right an angler in a boat. In the distance a strip of shore is visible.

7445.d: Eest taha suunduv kõrgete kivimajade vaheline talvine tänav. Taga kuppelkatustega kiriku tornid. Tänaval inimfiguure.
7445.de: A winter street between tall stone houses, receding from front to back. In the background towers of a church with dome roofs. Human figures on the street.

7447.d: Vasakpoolne tiib: Osa veduridepoost, mida valgustab kõrge aken tagaseinas. Keskel vedurirataste ümber töötavaid meesfiguure.
7447.de: Left wing: Part of a locomotive depot, lit by a tall window in the back wall. In the middle, male figures working around locomotive wheels.

7448.d: Valge lume taustal reas suured tõukekelgud. Kelkude juures tumedates talirõivastes inimesed. Paremal erepunane lõke, mille kohale on kummardunud üks figuur. Ülaosas regi ja neli äralõigatud figuuri.
7448.de: Against a white snow background, large push sledges in a row. People in dark winter clothing beside the sledges. On the right, a bright red bonfire over which one figure is bent. In the upper part, a sledge and four cropped figures.

7449.d: Raamatutega kaetud pika laua taga istub esiplaanil noor, keskelt lahkukammitud, kergelt lokkis juustega naine kirju riidega kaetud punakaspruunil toolil. Paremas käes hoiab musta sulepead, millega toetub valgele paberile, vasak käsi hoiab tooli seljatoest. Keha pööratud pisut paremale, parem jalg tõstetud üle vasaku põlve. Seljas tume seelik ja pisut kõrgema kaelusega pluus. Laua taga vasakul, otsevaates punase mütsiga ja tumedas riides mees, küünarnukkidega lauale toetumas. Foon tumepunane.
7449.de: Behind a long table covered with books, in the foreground sits a young woman with slightly curly hair parted in the middle, on a reddish-brown chair covered with patterned fabric. In her right hand she holds a black pen holder, with which she rests on white paper, her left hand holds the back of the chair. Her body is turned slightly to the right, right leg raised over the left knee. She is wearing a dark skirt and a blouse with a slightly higher collar. Behind the table on the left, in frontal view, a man with a red cap and in dark clothing, leaning on the table with his elbows. Background dark red.

7452.d: Esiplaanil rühib vasakult paremale grupp tumedates riietes ja mütsides mehi, kellest mõnedel seljas kott. Vertikaalsest keskjoonest pisut vasakul pruuni hobuse seljas mees, kes näo ja kehaga on vaataja poole pöördunud. Meeste näod antud individualiseerimata, laikudena. Tagaplaanil tuulest tugevasti painutatud puud, nende kohal tume, hallikassinine taevas üksiku valge pilvega vasakul. Koloriit tume, õhuke värvikiht laseb kohati lõuendil paista.
7452.de: In the foreground, a group of men in dark clothes and caps, some carrying bags, push forward from left to right. Slightly left of the vertical centre line, a man on a brown horse, turned toward the viewer with his face and body. The men's faces are rendered without individualization, as patches. In the background, trees strongly bent by the wind, above them a dark, greyish-blue sky with a single white cloud on the left. The colouring is dark, with the thin paint layer letting the canvas show through in places.

7457.d: Kolm stseeni Saaremaa külaelust. Keskmisel osal on kujutatud kiviaiaga ääristatud külavaheteed teelistega vaataja suunas astumas. Taamal taluhooned puude taustal. Vasakpoolsel kiigeplats kiikujate ja uudistajatega esiplaanil. Parempoolsel kujutatud külatänav kahe üle aia vestlejaga. Tagapool talud puude vahel.
7457.de: Three scenes of village life in Saaremaa. In the middle part a village lane bordered by a stone fence is depicted, with travellers walking toward the viewer. Further away farm buildings against a background of trees. On the left side a swing ground with swingers and onlookers in the foreground. On the right side a village street with two people conversing over a fence. Behind them farms among trees.

7483.d: Suure, pildi ülaservaga äralõigatud puu all kumera katusega kiosk. Selle ees kõnniteel 3 jalakäijat, kaks meest ning üks naine. Esiplaanil roheline tänavalatern. Maalitud summutatud koloriidis.
7483.de: Under a large tree cut off by the upper edge of the picture, a kiosk with a curved roof. In front of it on the pavement 3 pedestrians, two men and one woman. In the foreground a green street lamp. Painted in a muted colour scheme.

7486.d: Rohelistes ja hallides toonides vihmane sügispäev: esiplaanil raudtee tõkkepuu, piirete ja telefonipostidega. Keskplaani paremal kaks puumaja, taamal udus Toompea siluett.
7486.de: In green and grey tones a rainy autumn day: in the foreground a railway barrier with fences and telephone poles. In the middle ground at right two wooden houses, in the distance the silhouette of Toompea in the mist.

7487.d: Vaade talvisele puumajade ja telefonipostidega ääristatud tänavale. Tänaval kaks hobust regedega, inimesi. Paremal, tänavanurgal kahekorruseline ereroheline maja, selle ees lumel kollakas päikeselaik. Roosaka taeva foonil vasakul suure puu oks. Maalitud lühikeste tihkete pintslilöökidega.
7487.de: View of a winter street lined with wooden houses and telephone poles. On the street two horses with sledges, people. On the right, on the street corner, a bright green two-storey house, in front of it a yellowish patch of sunlight on the snow. Against a pinkish sky background on the left, a branch of a large tree. Painted with short dense brushstrokes.

7500.d: Mehe rinnapilt, en face, sõjaväelase riietsuses.
7500.de: Bust of a man, en face, in military uniform.

7501.d: Vaade Rannamäelt Tallinna Stalingradi Väljaku suunas kulgevale linnamüürile. Vasakult nurgast diagonaalselt sügavusse suunduv tornide rida. Nende vahel linnamüüri najale toetuvaid maju. Paremal puid ja põõsaid Rannamäe nõlvakul. Tornide taga paistab Toompea nõlvak. Üle majakatuste paistva Toomkiriku torni kiivriga. Taevas pilves.
7501.de: View from Rannamäe towards the town wall running toward Stalingrad Square in Tallinn. A row of towers running diagonally into the depth from the left corner. Between them, houses leaning against the town wall. On the right, trees and bushes on the slope of Rannamäe. Behind the towers, the slope of Toompea can be seen. Above the rooftops, the spire of Toomkirik (the Dome Church) with its helmet roof is visible. The sky is cloudy.

7509.d: Turuplatsi vaade. All vasakus nurgas osa rohelisest plangust. Ees kaks, seljaga vaataja poole seisvat meest, taamal väiksemad turuliste grupid ning hobuveokid. Maalimislaad etüüdlik.
7509.de: View of a marketplace. In the lower left corner part of a green fence. In front two men standing with their backs to the viewer, in the distance smaller groups of market-goers and horse carts. Sketch-like painting style.

7538.d: Tee ääres kahes tihedas reas valgetüvelised kased. Ladvaosad pildi ülaservaga äralõigatud. Allee lõpus paistab madal hoone. Maalitud hallikas-pruunides toonides.
7538.de: Along the road, in two dense rows, white-trunked birches. The tops are cut off by the upper edge of the picture. At the end of the avenue, a low building can be seen. Painted in greyish-brown tones.

7539.d: Vaade madalatele punakate viilkatustega majadele. Esiplaanil kolm raagus kaske, taamal keskel kirikutorn. Maalitud valkjates rohekaspunastes toonides, kohati pastoosselt.

7540.d: Esiplaanil looklev tee lagedal maastikul. Paremal metsatukk, selle ees üksikud majad, taamal veetriip. Maalitud heledates hallikasrohelistes, beežides, tumepunastes toonides laiade spaatlitõmmetega.
7540.de: In the foreground a winding road in an open landscape. On the right a copse, individual houses in front of it, a strip of water further away. Painted in light grayish-green, beige, dark red tones with broad spatula strokes.

7567.dm: kõrgus: 43.3 cm (lm); kujutise laius: 22.6 cm; kujutise kõrgus: 28.8 cm; laius: 37.3 cm (lm)
7567.d: Kooguga kaevu juures kolme seisva naise täisfiguurid. Neist parempoolne selgvaates.
7567.de: Full figures of three standing women by a well with a sweep. The one on the right seen from the back.

7569.d: Laugjate kaldakäärudega, lamedate kivirahnude ja muruga kaetud mererand. Vasakul nõlval sügiseselt kirjud ja  poolraagus lehtpuude tuules. Paremal, all ranna pool madal rookatusega taluhoone. Üleni kohevas rünkpilves taevas. Sageli tumeda kontuuriga ümbritsetud, selgepiiriliste vormidega maal.
7569.de: A sea coast with gently sloping banks, covered with flat boulders and grass. On the left slope, autumnally colourful and half-bare deciduous trees in the wind. On the right, below near the shore, a low farmhouse with a thatched roof. The sky entirely filled with fluffy cumulus clouds. A painting with clearly defined forms, often surrounded by dark contours.

7587.d: Sinerdava veekogu kaldal pehmetes pruunides toonides, rohekate varjunditega põõsastik. Taevas kaetud valkjate pilvesagaratega.
7587.de: On the shore of a bluish body of water, shrubbery in soft brown tones with greenish shades. The sky is covered with whitish cloud masses.

7588.d: Hõberoheliste käharate lehtpuudega kaetud mäe ees lagedate kallastega jõekäär. Maalitud tugeva faktuuriga, taeva osas täiesti reljeefsena.
7588.de: A river bend with bare banks in front of a hill covered with silvery-green curly-leaved deciduous trees. Painted with strong texture, the sky area completely in relief.

7589.d: Keskplaani jäävate rohekat veekogu ümbritsevad igast küljest lumistel kallastel oranžikalt kumavate tüvedega mändide grupid. Maalipind pastoosne. Koloriit hele.
7589.de: In the middle ground, groups of pines with trunks glowing orange surround on all sides a greenish body of water on snowy banks. The paint surface is impasto. The colouring is light.

7590.d: All servas punakates värvirefleksides virvendav veepind sellel ujuva kahemastilise laevaga. Keskplaanis läbi punase tulekuma aimatavad hoonete kontuurid.
7590.de: Water surface flickering at the edges in reddish colour reflections, with a two-masted ship floating on it. In the middle ground, contours of buildings discernible through the red glow of fire.

7591.d: Tumehalli taeva all jõgi kaarsillaga. Esiplaanil paremal kaks inimest purjekal, vasakul pikk sõudepaat, väiksemaid paate. Maalitud tumedates sinakates, hallides toonides pastoosselt.
7591.de: A river with an arched bridge under a dark gray sky. In the foreground on the right two people in a sailboat, on the left a long rowboat, smaller boats. Painted in dark bluish, gray tones, impasto.

7592.d: Valkjas-roosades õites viljapuud ning õrnrohelised põõsaste puhmad. Nende vahelt paistavad kaks punaste katustega maja. Värvipind faktuurne. Värvigamma hele.
7592.de: Fruit trees with whitish-pink blossoms and soft green clumps of bushes. Between them two houses with red roofs are visible. The paint surface is textured. The colour range is light.

7593.d: Jõekalda ääres kaks purjekat figuuridega, taamal kaarsild ja linna siluett. Maalitud kirevalt, lopsakate lühemate pintslilöökidega, kohati tugeva faktuuriga.
7593.de: Two sailboats with figures by a riverbank, in the distance an arch bridge and the city silhouette. Painted colourfully, with lush, shorter brushstrokes, in places with strong texture.

7594.d: Beežides toonides lage maastik üksikute oranžide põõsatuttidega hallika taevatriibu all. Kaugemal heledad väikesed majad. Maalitud siledalt, värvi pühkivalt.
7594.de: An open landscape in beige tones with occasional orange bushy tufts under a greyish strip of sky. In the distance, small light-coloured houses. Painted smoothly, with sweeping colour.

7595.d: Beežides, hallides toonides lumine maastikumotiiv. Vasakul nõlvak kasesaluga, esiplaanil pruunikas veelomp. Maalitud hoogsalt, jõuliselt, kohati väga pastoosselt.
7595.de: A snowy landscape motif in beige and grey tones. On the left a slope with a birch grove, in the foreground a brownish puddle of water. Painted vigorously, forcefully, in places very pastose.

7596.d: Sulavates ookrites-oranžides toonides maalitud metsatukk. Vasakul väike lagendik kahe punasekatuselise majaga metsaservas. Maalipind kohati faktuurne.

7597.d: Esiplaanil raagus puude grupid. Nende vahel sulanud lumelaigud ning suured veelombid. Taamal paistavad ühekorruselised elamud. Taevas kahvatusinine. Üldkoloriit pastelne.
7597.de: In the foreground, groups of bare trees. Between them, melting patches of snow and large puddles of water. In the distance, single-storey dwellings can be seen. The sky is pale blue. The overall colouring is pastel.

7598.d: Tumedate, tinaraskete pilvede all lage maastik esiplaanil oleva üksiku põõsa ning taamal kollakas valgusvines seisva viie punasekatuselise hoonega. Maalimisel kasutatud pahtlit.
7598.de: Under dark, leaden clouds, an open landscape with a solitary bush in the foreground and, in the distance, five red-roofed buildings standing in yellowish light haze. Putty knife used in painting.

7599.d: Kollakaspruunis toonis maastiku taustal istuva keskealise mehe poolfiguur poolpöördes vasakule, pilk suunatud vaatajale. Mehel piklik nägu, sirge nina, kõrge laup, juuksed kammitud ülepea. Seljas tume ülikond, rohekas lips kaelas. Parem käsi toetub pildiraamile, vasakus hoiab kolme pintslit. Maalitud tihkelt.
7599.de: Half-figure of a middle-aged man sitting against a yellowish-brown landscape background, turned half-way to the left, gaze directed at the viewer. The man has an elongated face, straight nose, high forehead, hair combed back over the head. He wears a dark suit, a greenish tie at the neck. His right hand rests on the picture frame, in his left he holds three brushes. Painted densely.

7600.d: Pruunikasrohelise mägise maastiku taustal istub punases lühikeste puhvvarrukatega, ovaalse dekolteega kleidis noor naine otsevaates. Pea pööratud vasakule, pilk suunatud alla. Keskelt lahkukammitud pikad tumedad juuksed suljal. Käed kõrval ees, toetuvad lauaservale.
7600.de: Against a background of a brownish-green mountainous landscape sits a young woman in frontal view, in a red dress with short puffed sleeves and an oval décolletage. Head turned to the left, gaze directed downward. Long dark hair parted in the middle, loose. Hands in front to the side, resting on the edge of a table.

7601.d: Valkjashallis toonis maalitud pealtvaade lumiste puudega kaetud nõlvakule. Esiplaanil üle lagendiku metsa viiv tee. Maalitud pastoosselt.
7601.de: Top view painted in whitish-grey tones of a slope covered with snowy trees. In the foreground a road leading through a clearing into the forest. Painted pastosely.

7602.d: Sikk-sakina paigutatud värviline lillelett, selle vahel heledais rõivais naisfiguurid. Esiplaanil vasakul kaks istuvat naist kollases, vasakpoolne külg-, parempoolne otsevaates. Maalitud kirevalt, roosades-rohelistes-pruunides toonides kohati täppivalt pastoosselt, kohati spaatliga.
7602.de: A zigzag-arranged colourful flower bed, among it female figures in light-coloured clothing. In the foreground on the left two seated women in yellow, the left one in profile, the right one in frontal view. Painted vividly, in pink-green-brown tones, in places stippled and impasto, in places with a palette knife.

7603.d: Väljakut ümbritsevate hoonete ees heledad varikatused. Esiplaanil vasakul seisvate hobuste rida vankritega, nende vahel ja paremal värvikalt maalitud inimgrupid. Maalitud summutatud pruunis-beežis toonis üksikute erksate punakasroheliste laikudega.
7603.de: Light-coloured awnings in front of the buildings surrounding the square. In the foreground on the left a row of standing horses with carts, between them and on the right colourfully painted groups of people. Painted in muted brown-beige tones with occasional bright reddish-green patches.

7604.d: Tumehallides toonides maalitud vaade metsale. Esiplaanil lumise lagendiku serv aimatavate kuuskedega. Ülaosas kitsas triip kollakat taevast. Maalitud laiade spaatli tõmmetega.
7604.de: A view of a forest painted in dark grey tones. In the foreground the edge of a snowy clearing with faintly discernible spruces. At the top a narrow strip of yellowish sky. Painted with broad strokes of a palette knife.

7605.d: Esiplaanil, kaldal kaks veoautot, inimeste grupid. Merel hulk purjekaid, eespool väiksemaid paate. Tagaplaanil paremal suitsevad korstnad. Maalitud värvikalt, pastoosselt.
7605.de: In the foreground, on the shore two trucks, groups of people. On the sea a number of sailboats, smaller boats in front. In the background at right smoking chimneys. Painted colourfully, in impasto.

7618.d: Helerohelistes toonides, täppivas laadis maalitud lehtpuusalu, esiplaani keskosas madalamad põõsad. Tagaplaani keskel, taeva foonil hele torniga hoone.
7618.de: A grove of deciduous trees painted in light green tones, in a pointillist style, in the centre of the foreground lower bushes. In the centre background, against the sky, a light-coloured building with a tower.

7665.dm: kõrgus: 33.2 cm (lm); kujutise laius: 31.0 cm; kujutise kõrgus: 23.8 cm; laius: 42.2 cm (lm)
7665.d: Ees kolm pearätikus naist. Vasakpoolsel ja keskmisel süles viljavihk. Parempoolne kummardunud vihuköidiku keerutamiseks.
7665.de: Three women in headscarves in front. The left and middle ones hold a sheaf of grain in their laps. The right one is bent over, twisting a sheaf-binding.

7693.d: Kollakaspruunides toonides, impressionistlikus valguse- ja värvimängus antud metsatukk. Esiplaanil kollastes lehtedes kaskede grupp, keskplaanis vasakul ja paremal samasugused puudegrupid.

7699.d: Noore tumedajuukselise naise põlcportree, käed vaheliti rinnal. Tumeda kleidi kaelus ja varrukad kitsa valge pitsääristusega. Sõrmeküüned punased.
7699.de: Knee-length portrait of a young dark-haired woman, hands crossed on her chest. The collar and sleeves of the dark dress trimmed with narrow white lace. Fingernails red.

7700.d: Ees paremal näha suure kuuse tüvi ja alumine osa oksastikust vasakul vana kase tüve osa.
7700.de: In front on the right the trunk of a large spruce and the lower part of its branches; on the left part of the trunk of an old birch.

7708.dm: kõrgus: 47.5 cm (maal "Matuselised" mõõdud); laius: 47.5 cm; kõrgus: 60.0 cm (maal "Sirelid" mõõdud); laius: 60.0 cm
7708.d: Pruunil poleeritud ja ümbritsevat oma pinnal peegeldaval laual sinine ümar vaas suure lillade sireliokste kimbuga. Foon rohekaskollane. Maalitud kergete säpsivate pintslilöökidega.
7708.de: On a brown polished table reflecting its surroundings on its surface, a blue round vase with a large bunch of lilac lilac branches. The background yellowish-green. Painted with light, brisk brushstrokes.

7722.d: Kasukas ning sõdurimütsis mehe poolfiguur, vasak käsi risti üle kõhu.
7722.de: Half-figure of a man in a fur coat and soldier's cap, left hand crossed over the stomach.

7727.d: Esiplaanil, paralleelselt alumise servaga jõgi, mille ääres, vert. keskjoonest pisut vasakul punakaspruun, veevaadi ette rakendatud hobune. Hobuse ja vaadi juures valges pluusis naine jõest vett ammutamas ja sonis mees vett vaati valamas. Hobuse juurest viib kitsas liivane tee mäkke, mäel teest paremal elektripost, vasakul suured rohelised puud ja põõsad. Jõe ääres, teel, heledapäine naine, temast paremal kolm jões sulistavat last. Mäe otsas, silmapiiril keskel, kaks valget torni või korstent, vasakul serval puudetukk. Ülal helesinine, kiudpilvedega taevas.
7727.de: In the foreground, parallel to the lower edge, a river, by which, slightly to the left of the vertical centre line, a reddish-brown horse harnessed to a water barrel stands. By the horse and the barrel a woman in a white blouse draws water from the river, and a man in a cap pours water into the barrel. From the horse a narrow sandy path leads up the hill; on the hill, to the right of the path, an electricity pole, to the left large green trees and bushes. By the river, on the path, a fair-haired woman, to her right three children splashing in the river. At the top of the hill, in the centre of the horizon, two white towers or chimneys, on the left edge a clump of trees. Above, a light blue sky with cirrus clouds.

7788.d: Esialal neli meesfiguuri: keskmine, hallipäine mees kasukas ja papaahhas, hoiab käes paberit nagu näidates midagi tema kõrval seisvale noorele tumedajuukselisele nokkmütsis mehele. Paremal noor mees, kasukas ja läkiläkis, padrunivööd üle õla, rihma küljes käsigranaate, profiilis vasemale. Keskel seisvate meeste taga noor mees, punane lint ümber vasema käsivarre, pea suunatud vasakule. Tagapool vasemal raskekuulipildujat vedavad mehed, silmapiiril leekides hoone. Paremal raudteevaguni ees rühm sõjaväe vormis mehi askeldamas.
7788.de: In the foreground four male figures: the middle one, a grey-haired man in a fur coat and papakha, holds a piece of paper in his hand as if showing something to the young dark-haired man in a peaked cap standing beside him. On the right a young man, in a fur coat and forage cap, cartridge belts over his shoulder, hand grenades attached to his belt, in profile facing left. Behind the men standing in the middle a young man, a red ribbon around his left arm, his head turned to the left. Further back on the left men pulling a heavy machine gun, on the horizon a building in flames. On the right, in front of a railway carriage, a group of men in military uniform busy at work.

7791.d: Sinakas-lilla laigulisel foonil, roosaka riidega kaetud pingil istuv naisakt otsevates, helepruunide, õlgadeni juustega, vasak käsi toetub istme servale.
7791.de: A female nude sitting on a bench covered with pinkish cloth, against a bluish-purple mottled background, with straight, light brown hair to the shoulders, left hand resting on the edge of the seat.

7855.d: Künklik maastik. Esiplaanil üksikuid mände ja okaspuid. Keskel veekogu (järv). Taamal kõrgenev maastik metsatukkadega.
7855.de: Hilly landscape. In the foreground solitary pines and conifers. In the middle a body of water (a lake). Behind, rising terrain with clumps of forest.

7856.d: Esiplaanil Riia tn. Tartus üksiku hobuse ja vankriga seisvana parempoolsel tänavaäärel, millel kujutatud majaderivi puiesteega selle ees piirab vasakult Pauluse kirik, kõrgele tõusva torniga. Puiesteel jalutavaid inimfiguure.
7856.de: In the foreground Riia Street in Tartu, with a single horse and cart standing on the right side of the street, on which a row of houses with a boulevard is depicted, bordered on the left by St. Paul's Church with its tall rising tower. Figures of people strolling on the boulevard.

7891.d: Kollase linaga kaetud klaveril kolm vaasi mitmevärviliste lilledega. Nende ees hele kübar tumeda paelaga, mille peal roosa sall. Taga vasemal ja paremal rippuvad maastikumaalid.
7891.de: On a piano covered with a yellow cloth, three vases with multicoloured flowers. In front of them, a light hat with a dark ribbon, on which lies a pink scarf. Behind, on the left and right, hanging landscape paintings.

7892.d: Esiplaanil veekogu vastaskaldal oleva hoonestiku peegeldusega veepinnal. Vastaskaldal - lehtpuude vahel rida hooneid.
7892.de: In the foreground a body of water with a reflection on its surface of the buildings on the opposite shore. On the opposite shore - a row of buildings among deciduous trees.

7893.d: Esiplaanil lumine aed kolme kõrge raagus puuga. Tagaplaanil mitmekorruselised lumiste katustega majad.
7893.de: In the foreground a snowy garden with three tall bare trees. In the background multi-storey houses with snowy roofs.

7894.d: Laual pruun vaas suure segalilledest kimbuga.
7894.de: On the table a brown vase with a large bouquet of mixed flowers.

7896.d: Esiplaanil suvine heinamaa: vasakul, veel niitmata heinamaa osas, söövad punakaspruunid lehmad ja viis valget lammast, parempoolses osas ees veetakse hobusega heina pooleliolevasse rõuku, taga neli valmis rõuku. Heinamaa veeres keskel kaks kõrget puud, tagant ja paremalt piirab nurme roheliste põõsaste rivi. Paremal servas paistab jupike küntud põldu, tagaplaanil silmapiiril hulk puudest ja põõsastest ümbritsetud taluhooneid. Ülal kahvatu kollastes ja sinistes toonides taevas.
7896.de: In the foreground, a summer hayfield: on the left, in the part not yet mown, reddish-brown cows and five white sheep are grazing; in the right-hand part, in front, hay is being carted by horse to an unfinished stack, behind it four finished stacks. At the edge of the hayfield in the middle, two tall trees; the field is bordered at the back and on the right by a row of green bushes. On the right edge, a patch of ploughed field is visible; in the background on the horizon, a number of farm buildings surrounded by trees and bushes. Above, the sky is in pale yellow and blue tones.

7897.d: Esiplaanil keskel heledas keraamilises vaasis lopsakas kimp lilla- ja siniseõielistest lupiinidest ning oranžidest liiliatest. Taustal ookerkollane, kerges laines draperii ja osa ruudulise linaga kaetud lauast.
7897.de: In the middle foreground, in a light-colored ceramic vase, a lush bouquet of purple and blue lupines and orange lilies. In the background, an ochre-yellow, gently waving drapery and part of a table covered with a checkered cloth.

8013.d: Kõhetu näoga mehe rindportree otsevaates punakas-ruskel taustal.
8013.de: Frontal bust portrait of a gaunt-faced man against a reddish-brown background.

8014.d: Mehe pea poolprofiilis vasakule, pikkadele õlgadele langevate juustega.
8014.de: Man's head in three-quarter profile to the left, with hair falling onto long shoulders.

8015.d: Paremal figuur löögiks tõstetud mõõgaga; keskel figuur enda ees seisja õlale langetatud mõõgaga. Vasakul ja taga inimfiguure.
8015.de: On the right a figure with a sword raised for a strike; in the middle a figure with a sword lowered onto the shoulder of the one standing in front of him. On the left and in the background human figures.

8016.d: Esialal rühm mehi muistses sõdurivarustuses paremalt vasakule astumas. Tagapool paremal leekides linnuse taga rohkesti mehi, vasakul lumine nõlvak vasakult linnuse poole suunduvate meestega tagaplaanil.
8016.de: In the foreground a group of men in ancient soldier's equipment stepping from right to left. Further back on the right many men behind a burning castle in flames, on the left a snowy slope with men in the background moving from left towards the castle.

8017.d: Esiplaanil roigasaed, jooksvaid ja ratsa inimsiluette. Keskel üksikuid onne. Taamal künka otsas leegitsev tuli.
8017.de: In the foreground a pole fence, silhouettes of running and mounted people. In the middle individual huts. In the distance on top of a hill a blazing fire.

8018.de: Half-length portrait of a seated serviceman, three-quarter profile to the left.

8019.d: Ateljee interjööris ees keskel laua serv teekannu, klaasi ja paletiga (värvide ja pintslitega). Vasakul kolm üksteise taga seisvat meest. Keskel grupp kolmest mehest. Paremal vasakul seisev mees.
8019.de: In a studio interior, in front, centre, the edge of a table with a teapot, a glass and a palette (with paints and brushes). On the left three men standing one behind the other. In the centre a group of three men. On the right a man standing on the left.

8020.d: Kirikuhoov vanas Jaroslavis: eespool madalate majadega, paremal keskel avatud värava ja selle taga oleva kiriku torniga.
8020.de: A churchyard in old Yaroslavl: with low houses in the foreground, an open gate in the middle right and behind it a church tower.

8021.d: Postidele tugineva laega ruumis vasakul rida supikatlaid, mille juures askeldavad sõdurid. Tagaseinas avatud uks.
8021.de: In a room with a ceiling resting on posts, on the left a row of soup kettles, with soldiers busying themselves nearby. An open door in the back wall.

8022.d: Sõjatander, kus esiplaanil punker, millest väljumas kaks meest. Esimesel kiiver peas ja mantlikrae vahelt paistmas SS korpuse tunnusmärk. Vasemal 6 meest punkri kõrval ja paremal 2. Lumise välja taga on nähtav purustatud hoonete rida.
8022.de: A battlefield, in the foreground a bunker, from which two men are emerging. The first with a helmet on his head and, between the coat collar, the insignia of the SS corps visible. On the left 6 men beside the bunker and on the right 2. Behind the snowy field a row of destroyed buildings is visible.

8023.d: Võiduväljakul, vasakult sügavusest ette paremale liikuva rongkäigu kolonni esireas kolm rahvarõivais naist, lilled peos. Nende taga sammub rahvarõivais naisi ja mehi. Paremal ja vasakul pool kolonni lehvivad punased lipud. Üle kolonni horisontaal punasel kangal loosung "ELAGU EESTI NÕUKOGUDE SOTSIALISTLIK VABARIIK". Taustaks on kujutatud Võiduväljaku äärsed hooned Kunstihoonega keskel.
8023.de: On Victory Square, in the front row of a procession column moving from the left background to the right foreground, three women in folk costume, flowers in their hands. Behind them walk women and men in folk costume. On the right and left of the column red flags flutter. Above the column, on a horizontal red banner, the slogan "LONG LIVE THE ESTONIAN SOVIET SOCIALIST REPUBLIC". In the background the buildings around Victory Square are depicted, with the Art Hall in the centre.

8030.d: Vaade lahesopile vasakul. Esiplaanil paremal kiviaed, põõsastik, viljapõllu riba, liivane rand, mets. Kiviaia juures naine punase seeliku ning valge pluusi ja rätiga, tema järel väike poiss mustas ülikonnas. Kaugemal mets.
8030.de: View of a bay inlet on the left. In the foreground on the right a stone wall, shrubbery, a strip of grain field, a sandy beach, forest. By the stone wall a woman in a red skirt and white blouse and headscarf, behind her a small boy in a black suit. Forest further away.

8050.d: Armeenia mägine maastik. Vasemast alumisest nurgast kompositsiooni suhtes diagonaalselt, sügava sängina kulgev tee sügavasse kitsasse orgu, rohetava nõlvaga tagaplaanil paremal poolel, lõikudes tasasesse, avarasse platoosse ning jaotades selle kompositsioonil tinglikult kahte ossa: tagaplaanil roosakaks väljaks, esiplaanil paremal kolmnurkseks, suurte kividega kaetud maaribaks. Sellel, pildivälja äärel, fragment kergest kahekordsest vaiadest puitelamust balustraadiga balkoniga teisel korrusel, millel nööril kuivavad punased taimed. Teed, millel kõnnib üksik naine, piiravad vasakult kõrged kaljud. Horisondil paremal sinetav lame mägi.
8050.de: Armenian mountain landscape. From the lower left corner, running diagonally in relation to the composition, a road runs as a deep track into a deep narrow valley, with a greenish slope in the background on the right side, cutting into a flat, spacious plateau and conditionally dividing it into two parts in the composition: a pinkish field in the background, and in the foreground on the right a triangular strip of land covered with large stones. On this, at the edge of the picture field, a fragment of a light two-storey wooden pile dwelling with a balcony with a balustrade on the second floor, on which red plants are drying on a line. The road, on which a lone woman is walking, is bordered on the left by high cliffs. On the horizon on the right, a bluish flat mountain.

8120.d: Paremal noore naise stiliseeritud poolfiguur laua taga, pea toetumas paremale käele,
8120.de: On the right a stylised half-figure of a young woman at a table, head resting on her right hand,

8141.d: Suvises looduses puude varjus keskel põlvpükstes flööti puhuv noormees; paremal tütarlaps ja noormees puu all istumas, vasakpoolne paar seisab, tütarlaps pikas sinises kleidis, lehvik käes.
8141.de: In summer nature in the shade of trees, in the middle a young man in knee breeches playing the flute; on the right a girl and a young man sitting under a tree, the couple on the left standing, the girl in a long blue dress, a fan in her hand.

8155.d: Esiplaanil purunenud müüriosad. Nende taga keskel kõrged lehtpuud ja kaks taastatud hoonet.
8155.de: In the foreground, ruined sections of wall. Behind them in the centre, tall deciduous trees and two restored buildings.

8156.d: Ees neli sõjameest piikide ja kilpidega - kolm sammuvad paremale, neljas on ümber pöördunud, käsi piigiga tõstetud. Tagapool paremal kaks minejaile lehvitavat figuuri, kõrged puud ja õlgkatustega talumajad. Taamal mets.
8156.de: In front, four warriors with spears and shields - three walking to the right, the fourth turned around, hand raised with a spear. Behind on the right two figures waving to those leaving, tall trees and thatched-roof farmhouses. Forest in the distance.

8159.d: Vasakul tihe männimets, keskel lumme mattunud kraav. Paremal harvalt asetatud kõrged männid, nende vahel tagaplaanil majad.
8159.de: On the left a dense pine forest, in the centre a ditch buried in snow. On the right sparsely spaced tall pines, between them in the background houses.

8160.d: Võlvikäigust avanev vaade kitsale õuele väikeste hoonetega kahel pool. Hallid, roosad toonid.
8160.de: View opening from a vaulted passage onto a narrow courtyard with small buildings on both sides. Grey, pink tones.

8161.d: Esiplaanil kividega ja rauatükkidega pommidest lõhestatud maapind. Eemal suurte ja väiksemate hoonete varemete vahel 3 väikest tervemat hoonet. Keskosas suure beeži kivimaja varemed. Üldkoloriit sinkjas-hall.
8161.de: In the foreground, ground torn apart by bombs with stones and pieces of iron. In the distance, among the ruins of larger and smaller buildings, 3 small intact buildings. In the middle section, the ruins of a large beige stone house. Overall colour scheme bluish-grey.

8185.d: Mehe poolfiguur en face; terav lõuahabe, avatud särgikaelus, paremas käes ajaleht "Kommunist", vasemas piip. Temast vasemal istuv mees (sekretär) poolprofiilis (peaaegu selgvaates) kirjutamisvalmis.
8185.de: Half-figure of a man en face; sharp goatee, open shirt collar, newspaper "Kommunist" in his right hand, pipe in his left. To his left a seated man (secretary) in half-profile (almost full view) ready to write.

8186.d: Laua taga seisva mehe poolfiguur kerge pöördega vasakule, hallide juuste, pügatud vurrude ja väikse lõuahabemega enface näoga, vasak käsi püksitaskus, parem hoiab kuuerevääri rinna kohal; vasakul esiplaanil Lenini büst, paremal raamatud.
8186.de: Half-figure of a man standing at a table, slightly turned to the left, with grey hair, trimmed moustache and small chin beard, face en face, left hand in trouser pocket, right hand holding the coat lapel at chest level; on the left in the foreground a bust of Lenin, on the right books.

8190.d: Keskel rohelise linaga laua taga paremal seisab Viktor Kingisepp toetudes vasaku käega lauale, lahtise valge kraega. Ta parem käsi on ettesirutatud sama laua vastasäärel asuva kirjutusmasina suunas. Vasakul istub näpitsprillidega, triibulise salliga mees, kes paremas käes hoiab valget paberit. Temast vasakul, laua vasakul otsal istub vanamees profiilis prillidega. Ta vasak käsi, milles sonimüts, lebab laual, teine käsi paremal põlvel. Kingisepa vastassuunas selgvaates tütarlaps sinises pluusis kirjutamas masinal. Laua paremal otsal oleva tooli leeni najale toetub mõlema küünarnukiga valge kraega mees, kellel paremas käes valge paber. Samal toolil lebavad portfell ja mantel, millel kaabu. Esi
8190.de: In the middle, behind a table with a green cloth, Viktor Kingisepp stands on the right, leaning with his left hand on the table, with an open white collar. His right hand is stretched out toward a typewriter located at the opposite end of the same table. On the left sits a man with pince-nez glasses and a striped scarf, holding a white sheet of paper in his right hand. To his left, at the left end of the table, an old man in profile, wearing glasses, is seated. His left hand, holding a fur cap, rests on the table, the other hand on his right knee. Opposite Kingisepp, in full view, a girl in a blue blouse is typing. Leaning with both elbows on the back of a chair at the right end of the table is a man with a white collar, holding a white sheet of paper in his right hand. On the same chair lie a briefcase and a coat, with a hat on it. In the fore

8203.d: Nikerdatud selja- ja käetugedega punasest puust toolis istub profiilis, jalad välja sirutatud, vanem mees. Mehe vasak käsi toetub käsipuule, vasakus käes raamat, sõrm järge hoidmas. Parem käsi on küünarnukist kõverdatud ja toetab pead. Mehe pealagi paljas, külgedel lühikesed, tugevasti hallisegused juuksed, ninal kuldsete sangadega prillid. Mehel seljas must ülikond ja kingad, valge särk ja punaste triipudega hall lips. Fooniks tumehallide seintega toanurk. Seinal vasakul ripub maastikupilt, paremal ülanurgas on näha neljandik seinal rippuvast pildist.
8203.de: An elderly man sits in profile in a red wooden chair with carved back and armrests, legs stretched out. The man's left hand rests on the armrest, in his left hand a book, a finger keeping the place. His right arm is bent at the elbow and supports his head. The man's crown is bald, with short, heavily greying hair at the sides, and gold-rimmed glasses on his nose. The man wears a black suit and shoes, a white shirt and a grey tie with red stripes. The background is a room corner with dark grey walls. On the wall to the left hangs a landscape picture, in the upper right corner a quarter of a picture hanging on the wall is visible.

8281.d: Esiplaanil paremal põõsastikuga maariba, keskel veekogu saartega, taga maastik pilvede ja metsaga.
8281.de: In the foreground on the right a strip of land with bushes, in the middle a body of water with islands, behind a landscape with clouds and forest.

8379.d: Esiplaanil kaks karahvinide, pitside ja taldrikutega kaetud lauda. Parempoolse laua taga istub mustas ülikonnas valge särgiga mees, käsi toetub tema kõrval asuvale punase sametiga kaetud tooli või diivani seljatoele. Mehe pea on kergelt pööratud paremale, pisut väljakutsuv pilk vaataja poole pööratud. Foonil kaks portreed, üks narri -, teine klounikostüümis.
8379.de: In the foreground, two tables covered with carafes, lace and plates. Behind the table on the right sits a man in a black suit with a white shirt, his hand resting on the back of a chair or sofa covered in red velvet beside him. The man's head is turned slightly to the right, his gaze somewhat provocatively turned toward the viewer. In the background two portraits, one of a jester, the other in a clown costume.

8411.d: Noore mehe rinnapilt kerges pöördes paremale. Seljas sõduripluus, peas punase tähega pilotka.(eesti)
8411.de: Bust portrait of a young man, turned slightly to the right. Wearing a soldier's blouse, on his head a garrison cap with a red star.

8423.d: Esiplaanil vaibal valge teekann, õunad, kõrvitsad. Veidi kaugemal korv õunte või tomatitega, selle kõrval valge linik, mille tagaserval osa maalist.
8423.de: In the foreground on a rug a white teapot, apples, pumpkins. A little further away a basket with apples or tomatoes, next to it a white cloth, on the rear edge of which part of a painting.

8464.d: Noore astuva tütarlapse kolmveerandfiguur veerandpöördes paremale. Naise ülakeha veidi painutatud tahapoole, pööratud vaatajale. Vasak käsi kõverdatult tõstetud, parem küljel.
