Neiul seljas käisteta, kahara seelikuga, lopsaka kraega hele kleit, peas punaste - valgete lilledega küber. Kirev foon ja kleit maalitud pastoosselt, nägu ja käed siledamalt, vormi ümarusi järgivalt.
8464.de: Three-quarter figure of a young girl stepping forward, in a quarter-turn to the right. The woman's upper body slightly bent backward, turned towards the viewer. Left arm raised bent, right at her side. The girl wears a sleeveless light dress with a full skirt and a lush collar, and a cap with red and white flowers on her head. The colourful background and dress are painted pastosely, the face and hands more smoothly, following the roundness of the form.

8491.d: Kompositsioon koosneb kolmest istuva naise poolfiguurist, vasakpoolne profiilis, temale suunatud teiste pilgud. Maalitud laiade ja pikkade pintslitõmmetega, riietuse osas küllalt eskiislikult ja üldistavalt, lillakates ja punakates toonides, näod ühtlaselt punakad.
8491.de: The composition consists of three half-figures of a seated woman, the left-hand one in profile, the gazes of the others directed at her. Painted with broad and long brushstrokes, rather sketchy and generalised in the clothing, in purplish and reddish tones, faces uniformly reddish.

8501.dm: laius: 67.6 cm; kõrgus: 79.5 cm; kõrgus: 79.3 cm; laius: 68.0 cm
8501.d: Vana mehe täisfiguur klaveri ees istuvas asendis, kerge pöördega paremale. Taga paremal aken, vasakul raamaturiiul.
8501.de: Full figure of an old man sitting in front of a piano, slightly turned to the right. Behind him, a window on the right, a bookshelf on the left.

8505.d: Paremal istuva naise poolfiguur rätik peas suuri mitmevärvilisi õiekobaraid korraldamas. Üle laua neli kübarates naist otsevaates.
8505.de: The half-figure of a woman sitting on the right with a kerchief on her head, arranging large multicoloured flower clusters. Across the table four women in hats in frontal view.

8510.d: Lokkisjuukselise keskealise mehe figuur kirjutuslaua taga istumas (peaaegu en face). Kirjutuslaual hulk raamatuid ja kirjatarbeid. Mehe paremas käes pliiats, vasakul ta ees avatud raamatu serval.
8510.de: Figure of a curly-haired middle-aged man sitting behind a writing desk (almost en face). On the writing desk a number of books and writing implements. A pencil in the man's right hand, in his left, in front of him, the edge of an open book.

8518.d: Pruunis nõus peaaegu kogu pildi pinda kattev karikakarde ja rukkilillede kimp. Foon beežides ja pruunides toonides. Väga pastoosne maalifaktuur.(eesti)
8518.de: In a brown vessel a bouquet of daisies and cornflowers covering almost the entire surface of the picture. Background in beige and brown tones. Very pastose painting texture.

8547.d: Naise rinnapilt en face. Seljas avara dekolteega kleit, vasakus käes sinine mask.(eesti)
8547.de: Bust portrait of a woman en face. Wearing a dress with a wide décolletage, holding a blue mask in her left hand.

8554.d: Esiplaanil, vertikaalsest keskjoonest pisut vasakul kroogitud kaelusega, keskelt taljes ja alt kohevas kleidis punapäine poolpikkade juustega tantsijanna. Parem käsi kõrva juurde tõstetud ja hoiab värvilist lehvikutaolist eset. Naise selja taga vasakul seisab mustas keebis ja laia servaga kübaras mees ning hoiab naisel kätest. Naise peas must, pisikese põhja ja laia servaga kübar, punane lint ümber. Fooniks erksavärvilisi kujundeid.
8554.de: In the foreground, slightly to the left of the vertical centre line, a red-haired dancer with shoulder-length hair, in a dress gathered at the neckline, fitted at the waist and full below. Her right hand is raised to her ear and holds a coloured fan-like object. Behind the woman on the left stands a man in a black cloak and a wide-brimmed hat, holding her by the hands. On the woman's head a black hat with a small crown and wide brim, with a red ribbon around it. The background consists of brightly coloured shapes.

8580.d: Heledal hallikal foonil keskealise mehe portree, pea kerges pöördes vasakule. Mehel seljas tumepunane sviiter ja hall lühikeste revääridega kuub, poolpikad juuksesalgud langevad kõrvadele. Kõrge laup, kulm kortsus, terane pilk vaatajale suunatud.(eesti)
8580.de: On a light greyish background, a portrait of a middle-aged man, head slightly turned to the left. The man wears a dark red sweater and a grey coat with short lapels, half-long strands of hair falling over the ears. High forehead, furrowed brow, sharp gaze directed at the viewer.

8647.d: Esiplaanil keskel seisev poisi figuur, profiilis vasakule. Tumepunased püksid, valge särk. Vasakul pruun laud. Foon ebamäärane, maalitud soojades kollakates-pruunikates toonides.
8647.de: In the foreground, in the centre, a standing boy figure, in profile to the left. Dark red trousers, white shirt. On the left a brown table. The background indefinite, painted in warm yellowish-brownish tones.

8686.d: Paremal hoone nurk ja kõrge korsten, keskel tõstekraana, vasakul ehitusel olev vaatetorn.
8686.de: On the right the corner of a building and a tall chimney, in the middle a crane, on the left an observation tower under construction.

8689.d: Naise pea 3/4 profiilis vasakule, paksud käharad juuksed.
8689.de: A woman's head in 3/4 profile to the left, thick curly hair.

8691.dm: laius: 86.0 cm (arm   ); kõrgus: 73.0 cm; kõrgus: 72.5 cm (arm   ); laius: 87.0 cm
8691.d: Esiplaanil lumine õu, paremal servas hoone kõrge kiilkatusega. Pildi keskosas lumiste puude vahelt paistab roosa kohekordne hoone, vasakul mäkketõusev trepp.
8691.de: In the foreground a snowy yard, at the right edge a building with a tall pointed roof. In the middle of the picture, a pink two-storey building is visible among snowy trees, at left stairs leading up the hill.

8701.dm: kõrgus: 119.0 cm (km.    ); laius: 180.0 cm (arm.    ); laius: 178.5 cm (km.   ); kõrgus: 120.0 cm (arm.    )
8701.d: Esiplaanil vasakul ja keskel töötavaid töölisi palgivirna ja tõstekraana ümber, kail kaks väikest laeva. Paremal suur tõsteseadeldis. Taga vaade linnale.(eesti)
8701.de: In the foreground on the left and in the centre, workers working around a pile of logs and a hoisting crane, on the quay two small ships. On the right a large hoisting apparatus. Behind, a view of the city.

8728.d: Tugitoolis istuv sinises kleidis naine. Pea poolpöördes vasaku õla suunas.
8728.de: Woman in a blue dress sitting in an armchair. Head half-turned towards the left shoulder.

8756.d: Seina ääres osa madalast raamaturiiulist poolviltu nähtuna. Sellel ultramariinsinine ülalt ahenev kandiline vaas suure buketi punase ja ühe valge pojengiga, õielehti pudenenud riiulile. Taha, beezikale seinale, heidavad lilled varje, paremal nurk seinal rippuvast maalist.
8756.de: By the wall, part of a low bookshelf seen at an angle. On it an ultramarine blue, angular vase tapering upward with a large bouquet of a red and a white peony, fallen petals on the shelf. Behind, on the beige-ish wall, the flowers cast shadows, on the right the corner of a painting hanging on the wall.

8758.d: Kastil istuva  sasipäise tütarlapse täisfiguur. Tütarlapse käed kokkupandult süles.(eesti)
8758.de: Full figure of a tousle-haired girl sitting on a box. The girl's hands folded in her lap.

8759.d: Kitsas päikesest valgustatud hoovinurk madalate majade vahel.
8759.de: A narrow, sun-lit courtyard corner between low houses.

8764.d: Poolpimedas talutoas pildipinna keskel kaks naisefiguuri ja laps. Üks naistest, seljaga vaataja poole, ketrab; teine istub kõrval en face. Tagaservas laual küünal, mis heidab nõrka valgust figuuridele ja toaseintele.
8764.de: In a half-dark farmhouse room, in the middle of the picture surface, two female figures and a child. One of the women, back to the viewer, is spinning; the other sits beside her en face. On a table at the back a candle, casting faint light on the figures and the walls of the room.

8771.d: Vasakul istub nukrailmeline tumedas ülikonnas noormees, temast paremal sinises riietuses ja kübaras naine, kes hoiab enese ees laual lillekimpu.
8771.de: On the left sits a sad-looking young man in a dark suit, to his right a woman in blue clothing and a hat, holding a bouquet of flowers on the table in front of her.

8774.d: Pildi kompositsioonilises keskpunktis kaks järve: esiplaanil asuva järve ääres üks kask pildi servas ees ja kaks kaske paremas servas. Järvede ääres vasakul ja paremal majad, vasakul servas tume metsatukk, silmapiiril sinakas metsaviirg. Ülal helehallide pilvedega tihedalt kaetud taevas.
8774.de: At the compositional centre of the picture two lakes: by the lake in the foreground one birch at the edge of the picture in front and two birches at the right edge. Houses by the lakes on the left and right, a dark clump of forest at the left edge, a bluish strip of forest on the horizon. Above, a sky densely covered with light grey clouds.

8795.d: Keskealise mehe rinnaportree otsevaates: kõrge laup, tõstetud kulmud, kurrud laubal, pealagi poolpaljas, kergelt muigel ilme. Seljas karusnahkse kraega talvemantel, valge sall kaelas. Ühtlaselt rohekashallis gammas realistlikus laadis maal.
8795.de: Bust portrait of a middle-aged man in frontal view: high forehead, raised eyebrows, wrinkles on the forehead, top of the head half bald, expression with a slight smirk. Wearing a winter coat with a fur collar, a white scarf around the neck. A painting in realistic style in a uniform greenish-grey gamut.

8805.d: Esiplaanil kolm noort lehtpuud, nende taga kitsas põlluriba. Põllu taga üksikute suurte puude vahelt valendamas viljaväljad.
8805.de: In the foreground three young deciduous trees, behind them a narrow strip of field. Beyond the field, grain fields showing pale between individual large trees.

8866.d: Tumedas rõivastuses istuv vana naine kerges pöördes vasemale, süles valged, punased ja lillad lilled. Maalitud pastoosselt.(eesti)
8866.de: An old woman in dark clothing sitting in a slight turn to the left, white, red and purple flowers in her lap. Painted pastosely.

8976.d: Pruunis potsakas vaasis kogu pildi pinda kattev valgete, punaste, roosade õite meri. Maalitud tihedalt, väikeste pastoossete pintslilöökidega läbi. Foon roosaga varjutatud hall.(eesti)
8976.de: In a squat brown vase, a sea of white, red, pink blossoms covering the whole surface of the picture. Painted densely, worked through with small pastose brush strokes. Background a grey shaded with pink.

9015.dm: laius: 111.5 cm; kõrgus: 83.0 cm; kõrgus: 82.5 cm; laius: 112.0 cm
9015.d: Esiplaanil mööda külateed vasemalt paremale sõitev taluvanker naisega, vankri taga lehm. Tagaplaanil õlgkatustega taluhooned puude vahel. Hele koloriit.
9015.de: In the foreground a farm cart with a woman driving along the village road from left to right, behind the cart a cow. In the background farm buildings with straw roofs among trees. Light colouring.

9019.dm: laius: 100.5 cm (arm); kõrgus: 72.5 cm; kõrgus: 72.5 cm (arm    ); laius: 101.0 cm
9019.d: Esiplaanil paremal lai jõgi üksikute kergelt rohetavate leppade ja kaskedega kaldal. Vasakul üksik hoone. Keskel puude vahelt paistmas kivihoone. Taga paremal puud.
9019.de: In the foreground on the right a broad river with single slightly greening alders and birches on the bank. On the left a single building. In the middle a stone building visible among the trees. Behind on the right trees.

9037.d: Kõrge laubaga hallijuukselise mehe pea, kerge pöördega paremale. Riietuseks sinakat tooni särk pruunja pintsaku all.
9037.de: Head of a grey-haired man with a high forehead, slightly turned to the right. Clothing a bluish-toned shirt under a brown jacket.

9038.d: Esiplaanil lage rohumaa. Tagaplaanil paremal küngas puudega. Kaugemal puudegrupp.
9038.de: In the foreground bare grassland. In the background on the right a hill with trees. Further away a group of trees.

9044.dm: kõrgus: 79.0 cm (km.   ); laius: 66.7 cm (pm.   ); laius: 57.0 cm (km.   ); kõrgus: 82.0 cm (pm.   )
9044.d: Mehe poolfiguur poolprofiilis vasemale, istuvas asendis. Paremas käes pintsel, vasemas pabeross. Taga seinal rippuv maal.
9044.de: Half-figure of a man in three-quarter profile to the left, in a seated position. A brush in his right hand, a cigarette in his left. Behind him a painting hangs on the wall.

9089.d: Tumedajuukselise ning -silmse poisi portree otsevaates, suu kergelt avatud. Maalitud hoogsate, laiade pintslilöökidega. Värvipind kohati kergelt faktuurne.
9089.de: Portrait of a dark-haired, dark-eyed boy in frontal view, mouth slightly open. Painted with vigorous, broad brushstrokes. The paint surface is in places slightly textured.

9094.d: Vanema mehe rinnaportree veerandpöördes vasakule. Mehel kõrge paljas laup, hallid juuksed, sügav kurd ninajuurel, altkulmu pilk suunatud vaatajale. Seljas mustjas sallkraega jakk, selle kaelusest roosakas rõivas paistmas. Rohekashallid tumedad toonid.
9094.de: Chest portrait of an older man in a quarter-turn to the left. The man has a high bare forehead, grey hair, a deep furrow at the bridge of the nose, a gaze directed at the viewer from under his brows. Wearing a blackish jacket with a scarf collar, from whose collar a pinkish garment can be seen. Greenish-grey dark tones.

9128.d: Esiplaanil madal liivarand mida paremalt piiarb sopina vasakule ulatuv meri, kesosas vasakul järsult kõrgenev kallas okaspuuvõsaga. Taga paremal jätkub madal liivarand. Taevas kaugelt pilvine.
9128.de: In the foreground a low sandy beach bordered on the right by the sea extending in a bay toward the left, in the middle section on the left a steeply rising bank with coniferous scrub. Further back on the right the low sandy beach continues. The sky is cloudy in the distance.

9167.d: Esiplaanil kõrgendikult orgu suunduva tänava ääres üksikud 2-3 kordsed majad paremal pool. Vasakul laternaposti kohal plats. Paremal kõnniteel inimesi, põiktänav, hobune reega. Kaugemal majade siluetid.
9167.de: In the foreground, along a street leading from a height down into a valley, single 2-3 storey houses on the right. On the left a square above a lamp post. On the right people on the pavement, a cross street, a horse with a sledge. Further away, the silhouettes of houses.

9200.d: Töötajate figuure linnamajade ja varemete taustal. Kavand.
9200.de: Figures of workers against a background of city buildings and ruins. Sketch.

9204.d: Toolil istuva keskealise mehe täisfiguur, gitarr põlvedel. Tooli kõrval põrandal mapp ja vaas. Paremal tumeda linaga kaetud laua nurk, millel klaas ja pudel.
9204.de: Full figure of a middle-aged man sitting on a chair, a guitar on his knees. Beside the chair on the floor a portfolio and a vase. On the right the corner of a table covered with a dark cloth, on which a glass and a bottle.

9208.d: Lumega kaetud puudealune kuuvalgel. Esiplaanil tume veepind, mille paremal kaldal kolm raagus puud, vasemal kaks raagus puud, mille taga hoone.
9208.de: Snow-covered ground under trees in moonlight. In the foreground a dark water surface, on the right bank of which three bare trees, on the left two bare trees, behind which a building.

9247.d: Punases polsterdatud tugitoolis istuva mehe poolfiguur poolprofiilis paremale. Käed toetatud lauale.
9247.de: Half-figure of a man sitting in a red upholstered armchair, in half-profile to the right. Hands resting on the table.

9252.d: Keskosas õhtuse tänava taustal rõdul seisev naine otsevaates, nõjatumas rõdu balustraadile. Seljas lühikeste varrukatega kollane pluus, sinine seelik. Tumedad juuksed on seatud soengusse. Temast vasakul avatud rõduuks. Taustal majaderida, puud, valgustuspostid. Tumedad sinkjad, kollakad toonid, tumedad kontuurid, detailid maalipinda sisse kraabitud.
9252.de: In the middle section, against the backdrop of an evening street, a woman stands on a balcony in a frontal view, leaning on the balcony balustrade. She is wearing a yellow blouse with short sleeves and a blue skirt. Her dark hair is arranged in a hairstyle. To her left an open balcony door. In the background a row of houses, trees, lamp posts. Dark bluish, yellowish tones, dark contours, details scratched into the paint surface.

9285.d: Suverohelusse uppuv päikesepaisteline maastik: paremal suure hallikasrohelises lehestikus leinapaju all pink, mille istub valges pearätikus vana naine. Vana naise ees punases pluusis naine valge kitsega. Naiste taga tara ja selle taga puuriit. Vasakul servas veekogu, paat ja suurem paadikuur. Fooniks metstükk ja kollakashall taevas.
9285.de: A sunny landscape sinking into summer greenery: on the right, under a large weeping willow with grey-green foliage, a bench on which sits an old woman in a white headscarf. In front of the old woman a woman in a red blouse with a white goat. Behind the women a fence and behind it a woodpile. On the left edge a body of water, a boat and a larger boathouse. In the background a patch of forest and a yellowish-grey sky.

9303.d: Otsevaates maalitud poisi portree rinnust saadik. Seljas hall, pealeõmmeldud rinnataskutega pintsak ja valge särk, mille krae langeb revääridele. Vasaku käsi hoiab pintsaku kraest, näole maalitud valgushelke, juuksed kergelt lokkis. Foon hall.
9303.de: Portrait of a boy painted in frontal view down to the chest. Wearing a gray jacket with sewn-on breast pockets and a white shirt whose collar falls onto the lapels. The left hand holds the collar of the jacket, light reflections painted on the face, hair slightly curly. Background gray.

9330.d: Keskteljest pisut paremal pikliku näoga keskealise mehe pea veerandpöördes paremale. Pilk suunatud otse ette, huuled kokku pigistatud, kulmud veidi kergitatud, tumedad juuksed üle pea, kulmud veidi kergitatud, tumedad juuksed üle pea, kaeluses laiema sviitri krae. Maalitud hallides - pruunikates beežides toonides lopsakalt.
9330.de: Slightly right of the central axis, the head of a middle-aged man with an elongated face, in a quarter-turn to the right. Gaze directed straight ahead, lips pressed together, eyebrows slightly raised, dark hair combed over the head, eyebrows slightly raised, dark hair combed over the head, a wider sweater collar at the neckline. Painted richly in grey - brownish beige tones.

9352.d: Istuva mehe kolmveerandfiguur kerges pöördes paremale. Vasakus käes palett pintslitega. Hallid juuksed, pruun kuub.

9361.d: Valge pearätikuga naise pea 3/4 pöördes vasakule.
9361.de: Head of a woman with a white headscarf, in 3/4 turn to the left.

9370.d: Esiplaanil grupp istuvaid ja seisvaid figuure ähmaste majade kontuuride taustal.
9370.de: In the foreground a group of seated and standing figures against a background of blurred house contours.

9442.d: Metsalagendikul seisva noore sõdurivormis mehe poolfiguur kerges pöördes paremale.(eesti)
9442.de: Half-figure of a young man in soldier's uniform standing on a forest clearing, in a slight turn to the right.

9443.d: Esiplaanil rohelisse rõivastatud inimesi metsatööl, tagapool heleda katusega maja, mille ees seisab punane hobune veokiga.(eesti)
9443.de: In the foreground people dressed in green at forest work, behind a house with a light-coloured roof, in front of which stands a red horse with a cart.

9485.d: Interjööris istuv keskealine tumedajuukseline naine profiilis vasakule, pea pööratud üle vasaku õla, pilk vaatajal. Figuur lõigatud pahkluude kohalt. Naisel seljas punasekirju, lopsakate varrukatega ja punase volangiga kittelkleit. Vasak kõverdatud käsi õla kõrgusel tema ees oleval kollakasrohelisel vaibataolisel esemel. Maalitud pastoosselt jõulise, tihke pintslilöögiga.
9485.de: A middle-aged dark-haired woman sitting in an interior, in profile to the left, head turned over the left shoulder, gaze directed at the viewer. The figure cut off at ankle level. The woman wears a red-patterned smock dress with full sleeves and a red flounce. Her left bent arm at shoulder height rests on a yellowish-green carpet-like object in front of her. Painted pastosely with a vigorous, dense brushstroke.

9502.d: Ettpoole kummardunud sõduri täisfiguur profiilis paremale vintpüssist sihtimas.(eesti)
9502.de: Full figure of a soldier bent forward, in profile to the right, aiming with a rifle.

9531.d: Esiplaanil palke kandvad inimesed. Taga taluhooned. Paremal lõke.
9531.de: In the foreground people carrying logs. Farm buildings behind. A campfire on the right.

9541.dm: kõrgus: 78.5 cm (km.   ); laius: 101.0 cm (pm.   ); laius: 97.5 cm (km.   ); kõrgus: 82.0 cm (pm.   )
9541.d: Kasvuhoone sisemuses paremal laud, mille taga istuv töötav mees, ees tool, kastekann ja punase õiega lill potis. Vasakul ja paremal tagapool rohelisi taimi ja lilli.
9541.de: Inside a greenhouse on the right a table, behind which a working man sitting, in front a chair, a watering can and a flower with a red bloom in a pot. On the left and right behind, green plants and flowers.

9556.d: Ees kai, mille ääres kaks purjekat. Tagaplaanil laev ja hooneid.
9556.de: In front a quay with two sailboats by it. In the background a ship and buildings.

9613.d: Esiplaanil seisev mees, peas pruun läki-läki. Jalas pastlad. Käes rohelised käpikud, kaelas sall. Paremas käes kirves. Lumine väli. Taustaks tume lillakas taevas.
9613.de: A man standing in the foreground, wearing a brown fur cap. Wearing bast shoes. Green mittens in his hands, a scarf around his neck. An axe in his right hand. A snowy field. Background of a dark purplish sky.

9624.d: Esiplaanil rühm väikseid vanu puust onne. Onnide taga vasakul suurema maja pruun katus korstnaga. Tagaplaanil paremal roheline aas ja osa veekogust. Silmapiiril madalad metsaga kaetud kõrgendikud. Taevas sinakates - kollakates toonides.
9624.de: In the foreground a group of small old wooden huts. Behind the huts on the left the brown roof of a larger house with a chimney. In the background on the right a green meadow and part of a body of water. On the horizon low forested elevations. Sky in bluish-yellowish tones.

9629.d: Lumises maastikus nõkku kogunenud lahtist vett. Vasakul raagus puud ja põõsad. Taga okaspuumets. Paremal avaneb puude vahelt vaade lumelagendikule. Taevas pilvine.
9629.de: Open water gathered in a hollow in a snowy landscape. On the left, bare trees and bushes. Behind, a coniferous forest. On the right, a view opens between the trees onto a snowy clearing. Sky cloudy.

9645.d: Ees paremal laternaposti all inimgrupp. Tagapool vasakult paremale suunduva turuputkade rea ees inimsumm. Taga teater "Estonia" hoone tellingutega.
9645.de: In front on the right, under a lamppost, a group of people. Behind, in front of a row of market stalls running from left to right, a throng of people. In the back, the "Estonia" theatre building with scaffolding.

9691.d: Hilissügisene maastik sompus ilmaga. Esiplaanil vasakule liikuv härjavanker vana naisega vankril. Härja ees kõnnib vana naine kepiga. Keskplaanil teivasaed kogu kompositsiooni laiuses peaaegu parema ääreni, selle lõpus paremal ühekorruseline hall majake; aia ees kaks raagus kaske. Aia taga avara lagendiku ess laiguti lund, silmapiiril vasemal ja paremal metsaviirg. Taevas hallides pilvedes, hohati sinetades.
9691.de: A late-autumn landscape in gloomy weather. In the foreground an ox cart moving to the left with an old woman on the cart. In front of the ox an old woman walks with a stick. In the middle ground a pole fence spanning almost the whole width of the composition to near the right edge, at its end on the right a single-storey grey house; in front of the fence two bare birches. Behind the fence, in front of an open clearing, patches of snow, on the horizon left and right a strip of forest. The sky in grey clouds, here and there tinged blue.

9701.d: Esiplaanil lagedal karjamaal vasakul kaal piimakaalujatega, paremalt paistab osa piimakärust. Tagapool arvukas punane kari, mitu naist lüpsmas. Kõik töötajad valgeis kitlites ja valgete pearättidega.
9701.de: In the foreground on an open pasture, on the left a scale with milk-weighing equipment, on the right part of a milk cart is visible. Further back a numerous red herd, several women milking. All the workers in white smocks and white headscarves.

9707.d: Sangprillidega, kolmveerandpöördes paremale, istuva noormehe poolfiguur, käed põlvedel, vasakus käes põlev pabeross. Põhitoon: karmiin, sinakas - hall.
9707.de: Half-figure of a young man with dark glasses, seated in a three-quarter turn to the right, hands on his knees, in his left hand a burning cigarette. Main tone: carmine, bluish-grey.

9708.d: Vasakul akna all laud ja tool. Samas vasakul nurgas voodi.(eesti)
9708.de: On the left under the window a table and chair. In the same left corner a bed.

9716.d: Esiplaanil diagonaalselt paremalt vasakule rannajoon. Kaldaäärses vees suured kivid. Vasakult paistev Tallinna panoraam. Merel laevad ja üksikud lendavad kajakad.
9716.de: In the foreground a shoreline running diagonally from right to left. Large stones in the water by the shore. The panorama of Tallinn visible from the left. Ships at sea and scattered flying gulls.

9722.d: Taamal rida hooneid, kust väljub inimparv täites kogu pildi esiplaani.
9722.de: In the distance a row of buildings, from which a crowd of people emerges, filling the entire foreground of the picture.

9728.d: Pruuni- ja ookrikarva ruudulisel väikesel laual kõrge, ülalt laienev klaasist vaas punaste, roosade ja kollaste roosidega. Kogu pildi ulatuses paistab hõreda värvikihi alt lõuend. Foon kaetud lillakaspunaste hõredate pintslilöökidega.
9728.de: On a small brown and ochre chequered table a tall vase widening towards the top, of glass, with red, pink and yellow roses. Throughout the picture the canvas shows through the sparse layer of paint. The background covered with sparse brushstrokes of purplish-red.

9742.d: Istuvas, avaras rõivastuses naise kolmveerandfiguur kollakal - rohekal foonil. Teostatud vabas, skitseerivas laadis.
9742.de: Three-quarter figure of a seated woman in loose clothing against a yellowish-greenish background. Executed in a free, sketch-like style.

9770.d: Äärelinna tänav nelja jalakäijaga. Keskel roosakates toonides kiviaiaga piiratud hoonetegrupp. Taevas päike.
9770.de: A suburban street with four pedestrians. In the centre a group of buildings in pinkish tones enclosed by a stone wall. Sun in the sky.

9780.d: Pika halli habemega tugitoolis istuva mehe kolmveerandfiguur, parem käsi põlvel, vasak hoiab prille rinna kohal. Tagaplaanil paremal musta-punase vöödliline drapereering.
9780.de: A three-quarter figure of a man with a long grey beard sitting in an armchair, his right hand on his knee, his left holding glasses at chest level. In the background on the right, a black-and-red striped drapery.

9814.d: Paremal ees leel kookudes rippuvad kaks pada, nende ees vasakul pingil istuv vanem naine käed põlvedel. Põhitoon pruun ja ooker.(eesti)
9814.de: On the right in front, two pots hanging over the hearth being stirred, in front of them on the left an elderly woman sitting on a bench with her hands on her knees. Main tone brown and ochre.

9912.d: Vasakule jääva lagunenud lattaia kõrvalt kulgeb silmapiirini aiaäärsete kõrgete haabade ja paremale jäävate suurte põõsaste vahelt külavahe tee. Vasakult puude vahelt paistab vana talumaja. Maalitud laiade, hoogsate pintslilöökidega. Koloriit pehme - pruunikad, rohekad toonid.(eesti)
9912.de: Past a dilapidated picket fence on the left, a village road runs to the horizon between tall aspens along the fence and large bushes on the right. On the left, an old farmhouse is visible between the trees. Painted with broad, sweeping brushstrokes. The colouring is soft - brownish, greenish tones.

9936.dm: laius: 75.0 cm (vm.   ); kõrgus: 60.0 cm; kõrgus: 58.0 cm (vm.   ); laius: 73.0 cm
9936.d: Esiplaanil kivine rand paatidega; tagaplaanil tasane merepind.
9936.de: In the foreground a rocky shore with boats; in the background a calm sea surface.

9948.d: Esiplaanil lumine väljak üksiku puuga keskel, taamal raagus puuderida, mille taga majade varemed.(eesti)
9948.de: In the foreground a snowy square with a single tree in the middle, in the distance a row of bare trees, behind which are the ruins of houses.

9974.d: Naise rinnaportree, pea poolpöördes vasakule, pilk paremale. Näos tõusevad esile helepunaseks värvitud huuled. Pruunid, lainjas juuksed langevad õlgadele. Peas hallikas kübar, kaelas tume sall, kitsa punase triibuga. Koloriit tume.
9974.de: Bust portrait of a woman, head half-turned to the left, gaze to the right. In the face, lips painted bright red stand out. Brown, wavy hair falls to the shoulders. On the head a greyish hat, around the neck a dark scarf with a narrow red stripe. Dark colour scheme.

9982.d: Tumesinises rõivastuses langetatud peaga naise rinnafiguur profiilis paremale. Foon sinakas üksikute kollaste aksentidega.
9982.de: Bust figure of a woman with a lowered head, dressed in dark blue, in profile to the right. The background bluish with isolated yellow accents.

9991.d: Sõjaväelase vormis tugitoolis istuva mehe kolmveerandfiguur. Pea en face. Keha kerge pöördega vasakule. Vasak käsivars toetatud toolileenile. Taustaks tumepunane draperii.
9991.de: Three-quarter figure of a man in military uniform sitting in an armchair. Head en face. Body with a slight turn to the left. Left forearm resting on the armrest. Background of dark red drapery.

10011.d: Hallis kelidis naise portree kerges pöördes vasakule. Heledates juustes pisut halli, kõrva juurest üles tõstetud ja kinnitatud. Siniste silmade, ümarate põskede, pisut püstja nina ja väikese suuga suu. Kõrvas mererohelise kiviga kõrvarõngas. Foon kollakas-hall, ebaühtlaselt läbi maalitud.
10011.de: Portrait of a woman in a grey dress, in a slight turn to the left. Her light hair, slightly grey, is raised and fastened up from behind the ear. Blue eyes, round cheeks, a slightly upturned nose and a small mouth. In the ear an earring with a sea-green stone. The background yellowish-grey, painted unevenly throughout.

10016.d: Kolm üksteise kõrval seisvat täisfiguuri. Keskmine neist naine valgetes pikkades pükstes ja puusadelt kohevas sinises kuues. Kahel pool tumedas rõivas mehed.
10016.de: Three full figures standing next to one another. The middle one is a woman in white long trousers and a fluffy blue coat from the hips down. On both sides men in dark clothing.

10077.d: Paremal, sügava dekolteega, õlgu paljaksjätvas kirjus kleidis naise rinnafiguur. Pea pöördes paremale. Pruunid, laines juuksed ulatuvad õlgadeni. Vasakul, varjus, kübaraga naine, käes punakas - roosakad lilled. Üldkoloriit tume.
10077.de: On the right, the bust of a woman in a multicoloured dress with a deep décolletage, baring the shoulders. Head turned to the right. Brown, wavy hair reaching to the shoulders. On the left, in shadow, a woman with a hat, holding reddish-pink flowers. Overall colouring dark.

10079.d: Mahedates beežikates, kollakates, pruunides toonides vaade poolenisti raagus puudele - põõsastele. Paremal kaks tumedat jändrikku puutüve, okste vahelt paistab roosakassinine taevas. Maalitud lopsakalt, kohati täppivalt, võrdlemisi pastoosselt.
10079.de: In soft beige, yellowish, brown tones, a view of half-bare trees and bushes. On the right two dark, stunted tree trunks, with a pinkish-blue sky visible between the branches. Painted lushly, in places with dabs, rather impasto.

10114.d: Tumedates toonides maalitud istuva naise poolfiguur poolpöördes vasakule. Vasakul lillepott.
10114.de: Half-figure of a seated woman painted in dark tones, in half-turn to the left. On the left a flowerpot.

10115.d: Ristide keskel kolm pruunikas riietuses figuuri.
10115.de: Among the crosses, three figures dressed in brownish clothing.

10124.d: Pikas tumedas riietuses inimese täisfiguur otsevaates. Maalitud tugeva lakiga.
10124.de: Full figure of a person in long dark clothing, frontal view. Painted with a strong varnish.

10197.d: Ees keskel kirjutiivaline liblikas lilleõiel. Selle taga küljeli vajunud puudest üles kistud pinnase kamar juurtega. Taustaks tihe segametsa tüvestik.
10197.de: In the centre foreground a butterfly with patterned wings on a flower. Behind it a clump of soil with roots pulled up from trees fallen sideways. Background a dense mixed-forest trunk stand.

10202.d: Talvemaastik sinakates toonides. Esiplaanil kaks valgesse riietatud lamavat inimest saksa sõduri kiivrites. Samas vasakul murdunud puutüvi, eemal tank.
10202.de: Winter landscape in bluish tones. In the foreground two people dressed in white lying down in German soldier's helmets. Also on the left a broken tree trunk, in the distance a tank.

10209.dm: laius: 155.3 cm (arm   ); kõrgus: 156.0 cm; kõrgus: 155.5 cm (arm ); laius: 156.0 cm
10209.d: Esiplaanil rannal meesfiguur pooleldi selgvaates võrku lootsikust välja tõstmas. Paadi kõrval vanem mees suuremat kala vaatlemas. Paremal pool rauk piibuga ja noor naine, kartulikorv käevangus, väikene tüdruk kõrval. Tagaplaanil vanem naine korviga. Merel purjekad, silmapiiril metsaviirg.
10209.de: In the foreground, on the shore, a male figure lifting a net out of a boat, seen in half-view. Beside the boat, an older man examining a large fish. On the right an old man with a pipe and a young woman with a potato basket on her arm, a small girl beside her. In the background an older woman with a basket. Sailboats at sea, a strip of forest on the horizon.

10217.d: Kollakas kuuljas vaasis mitmesuguseid aia- ja põllulilli.(eesti)
10217.de: In a yellowish glass vase various garden and field flowers.

10220.d: Eest keskelt taha paremale suunduvat jõge läbistamas majade poolt veetud palgikoormad; vastaskaldal maju. Keskel kõrgel mäetipul linnuse puutaral askeldavad inimfiguurid.(eesti)
10220.de: From the front centre towards the back right runs a river crossed by log rafts towed by houses; houses on the opposite bank. In the middle, on a high mountaintop, human figures busy on the wooden fence of a castle.

10223.d: Esiplaanil vasakul lumine kai aurikuga ja vagunisse kaupa laadiva tõstukkraanaga. Paremal meri puksiiridega ja Tallinna panoraamiga tagaplaanil.
10223.de: In the foreground on the left, a snowy quay with a steamer and a lifting crane loading goods into a wagon. On the right, the sea with tugboats and a panorama of Tallinn in the background.

10239.d: Akna all ruumis triipmustrilise lianaga laud täis kuhjatud igat liiki aiasaadusi, nõusid, lillevaasid põrandal, vilju ja anumaid aknalaual ja alustel akna ees. Ees keskel suur laud, millel vasakult kaks taldrikut õuntega, poolitatud roheline kõrvits, taldrik viljadega. Linal oakaunu, õunu, peete, baklažaan, keskel jalaga vaagnal pirnid. Paremal lehti, oksi viljadega. Põrandal vasakul vaas punaste gladioolide, ees kirju kimbuga. Maali ülaosas aknast paistab päikeseline rohelus. Vaba impressionistlik laad, tingilkult vorme markeeriv.
10239.de: Under the window, in the room, a table with a striped tablecloth is piled high with all kinds of garden produce, vessels, flower vases on the floor, fruits and containers on the windowsill and on stands in front of the window. In front, in the middle, a large table on which, from the left, two plates with apples, a halved green squash, a plate with fruits. On the tablecloth beans, apples, beets, an aubergine, in the middle pears on a footed dish. On the right leaves, branches with fruits. On the floor on the left a vase of red gladioli, in front a colourful bouquet. In the upper part of the painting, sunny greenery is visible through the window. A free impressionistic manner, conditionally marking forms.

10273.d: Mustrilise riidega diivani nurgas istuva poisi põlvportree, käed vaheliti süles. Seljas sinakas pluus, jalas lühikesed sinised püksid, peas punane müts. Draperii taga punakas.
10273.de: A knee-length portrait of a boy sitting in the corner of a patterned-cloth sofa, hands clasped in his lap. Wearing a bluish blouse, short blue trousers, a red cap on his head. Behind him a reddish drapery.

10274.dm: lehe kõrgus: 46.0 cm; lehe laius: 66.0 cm
10274.d: Esiplaanil veeloigu ääres lauatükke ja koormat mahalaadivate veoautodega ja raudtee valtsiga, keskel taga kõrgete akendega, kahe ümmarguse korstnaga tehase hoone.(eesti)
10274.de: In the foreground, by a puddle of water, pieces of boards and trucks unloading a load, and a railway roller, in the middle behind a factory building with tall windows and two round chimneys.

10288.d: Akna juures tugitoolis istuva mehe kolmveerandfiguur poolprofiilis vasakule, käed süles. Aknast vaade lumistele mändidele.
10288.de: Three-quarter figure of a man sitting in an armchair by a window, in half-profile to the left, hands in his lap. From the window a view of snowy pines.

10291.d: Esiplaanil raudteetööliste majade tagant paistab keskel Tallinna Balti jaama hoone. Selle taga, puiestiku äärest kerkib Toompea nõlvak, seal asuvate majade reaga, mille lõpus paremal Pika Hermanni torn. Üle majade paistab Toomkiriku katus torniga.
10291.de: In the foreground, past the railway workers' houses, the building of Tallinn's Baltic Station is visible in the centre. Behind it, beyond the edge of the boulevard, the slope of Toompea rises, with a row of houses on it, at the end of which, on the right, the Tall Hermann Tower. Above the houses the roof of the Dome Church with its tower is visible.

10293.d: Talvine Tartu äärelinna vaade: esiplaanil lumme mattunud tehaseõu, lumiste katustega pikad laohooned. Keskel punakas, mitmejärguline tehase peahoone, korsten selle juures suitsemas. Vasakul ja taamal paremal raagus puud ja põõsad. Ülal kollakas talvine taevas.
10293.de: A winter view of a Tartu suburb: in the foreground a factory yard covered in snow, long warehouse buildings with snowy roofs. In the middle a reddish, multi-tiered main factory building, a chimney beside it smoking. On the left and further back on the right, bare trees and bushes. Above, a yellowish winter sky.

10295.d: Noore naise rinnapilt end face. Sinised silmad ja heledad juuksed. Lilla kleit, valge lehv.
10295.de: Bust portrait of a young woman en face. Blue eyes and light hair. Purple dress, white bow.

10305.d: Hallipäise mehe rinnapilt en face, valges pluusis.
10305.de: Bust portrait of a grey-haired man en face, in a white blouse.

10307.d: Esiplaanil kaldaribal ankrus kaks paati, kuni silmapiirini hall meri, paremal vähe tumenev. Kauguses paistavad majaka siluetid. Taevas heledam.
10307.de: In the foreground on the shore strip two anchored boats, a grey sea to the horizon, darkening slightly on the right. In the distance the silhouettes of lighthouses can be seen. The sky is lighter.

10308.d: Esiplaanil lumiste katustega majad ja puud. Vasakul Oleviste kirik. Tagaplaanil Toompea panoraam.
10308.de: In the foreground houses and trees with snowy roofs. On the left the Oleviste Church. In the background a panorama of Toompea.

10311.d: Esiplaanil vasemal vanamees kokkurullitud riidega õlal ja väike poiss aerudega õlal. Keskel rahvariides naise, lapse ja madruse figuurid. Paremal kaks madrust selgvaates. Nende taga rahvarõivais naisi. Taustaks meri.
10311.de: In the foreground on the left an old man with rolled-up cloth on his shoulder and a small boy with oars on his shoulder. In the middle figures of a woman in folk costume, a child and a sailor. On the right two sailors seen from the back. Behind them women in folk costume. Background of the sea.

10313.d: Kollakaspruunides ja roosades toonides linnatänav: esiplaanil kaks hobust kergete voorimehe troskadega, tumedasse riietatud voorimehed pukis. Tagaplaanil visandlikult antud tänavaäärsete majade rivi. Ülaservas riba kollakashalli taevast.
10313.de: City street in yellowish-brown and pink tones: in the foreground two horses with light cabman's droshkies, cabmen dressed in dark clothing on the box. In the background a sketchily rendered row of houses along the street. At the top edge a strip of yellowish-grey sky.

10316.d: Esiplaanil tee, kaugemal puude vahel talumajad.
10316.de: Road in the foreground, farmhouses among trees further away.

10340.d: Aknaaluse töölaua ääres istuv-töötav prillidega poolkiilaspäine vuntsidega töömees profiilis paremale. Mehel ülekeeratud käistega sinine särk, põll ees. Hoogne, visandlikult markeeriv maalilaad.
10340.de: A half-bald, moustached workman with glasses, sitting-working by a worktable under a window, in profile facing right. The man wears a blue shirt with rolled-up sleeves and an apron. A vigorous, sketchily gestural painting style.

10363.dm: lehe laius: 41.0 cm; lehe kõrgus: 33.0 cm
10363.d: Türkiissinistes, -rohelistes toonides põõsaste ja puude rohelus katab pildi vasakut poolt. Paremal osake veekogust, sillmapiiril helenduv taevas.
10363.de: Greenery of bushes and trees in turquoise-blue and -green tones covers the left side of the picture. On the right a portion of a body of water, a glowing sky at the horizon.

10364.d: Seisva naise poolfiguur otsevaates, pea kallutatud vasakule, seljas valge kleit ja tume mantel, peas punane müts, küünarnukist kõverdatud käed toetumas tema selja taga olevale toele.
10364.de: Half-figure of a standing woman in frontal view, head tilted to the left, wearing a white dress and a dark coat, a red hat on her head, arms bent at the elbows resting on a support behind her back.

10367.dm: kujutise kõrgus: 43.0 cm; lehe laius: 70.0 cm; lehe kõrgus: 50.0 cm; kujutise laius: 62.0 cm
10367.d: Mürkrohelist, türkiisi tooni rõõmsameelne maastik veekoguga, kulissina raamistav õitsev puu paremal türkiissinise, roosa pilvega taeva all. Pildi keskmes sinkjasrohelised nõlvad, kauguses vasakul tumesinine puudegrupp.
10367.de: A cheerful landscape in poisonous green and turquoise tones with a body of water, framed like a wing by a flowering tree on the right under a turquoise-blue sky with pink clouds. In the centre of the picture bluish-green slopes, in the distance on the left a dark blue group of trees.

10368.dm: kujutise kõrgus: 33.8 cm; lehe laius: 65.0 cm; lehe kõrgus: 50.0 cm; kujutise laius: 41.0 cm
10368.d: Põõsapuhmastega kaetud künklik maastik kahvatukollase taeva all. Puud kulissidena pildi külgedel. Ekspressiivne kujutamisviis, erksad sinkjasrohelised, ees punased toonid.
10368.de: Hilly landscape covered with bushes under a pale yellow sky. Trees as coulisses at the sides of the picture. Expressive manner of depiction, vivid bluish-green tones, red tones in front.

10373.d: Suvine vaade Estonia teatri esisele tänavale. Teatri ees noorte puude allee, jalutajad, keset teed hobusevanker. Hele, pastelne koloriit.(eesti)
10373.de: A summer view of the street in front of the Estonia theatre. An avenue of young trees in front of the theatre, strollers, a horse-cart in the middle of the road. Light, pastel colouring.

10376.dm: kujutise kõrgus: 46.2 cm; lehe laius: 65.0 cm; lehe kõrgus: 50.0 cm; kujutise laius: 55.2 cm
10376.d: Vaade puudesalu vahelisele avarale maastikule. Esiplaanil heinamaa, vasakul heinasaad, kaugemal sinakas mets rohekashalli taeva all. Summutatud toonid, krähmuline laad, paber kohati läbi kumamas.
10376.de: View of an open landscape between groves of trees. In the foreground a hayfield, on the left a haystack, further away a bluish forest under a greenish-grey sky. Muted tones, a crumbly manner, the paper shining through in places.

10379.dm: kujutise kõrgus: 24.0 cm; lehe laius: 48.0 cm; lehe kõrgus: 33.3 cm; kujutise laius: 41.0 cm
10379.d: Värvikas maastikuvaade väikeste majade suunas viiva teega esiplaanil. Tagapool hallide katustega hooned, veski, taevatriip puude tagant paistmas. Ees paremal lillakirjud põõsad. Krähmuline, rahutu kujutamisviis.
10379.de: A colorful landscape view with a road leading towards small houses in the foreground. Further back, buildings with grey roofs, a mill, a strip of sky showing through the trees. In front on the right, purplish-patterned bushes. A rough, restless manner of depiction.

10380.dm: kujutise kõrgus: 43.0 cm; lehe laius: 65.0 cm; lehe kõrgus: 50.0 cm; kujutise laius: 62.0 cm
10380.d: Maastikul vasakul kivist hoone varemed, korsten püsti, paremal kähar puu. Nende vahel kaugusest paistev sinine metsaviirg sünge hallika taeva all. Ekspressiivne laad, aluspind läbi kumamas.
10380.de: In the landscape on the left the ruins of a stone building, a chimney standing upright, on the right a curly tree. Between them a blue strip of forest visible in the distance under a gloomy greyish sky. Expressive manner, the ground surface showing through.

10399.d: Pastelsel rohekal taustal käed süles toolil istuva roosakate põskede ja naeratava naise poolportree otsevaates, seljas tumesinine kleit, millel kirju vest, lühikesed pruunid juuksed kõrvade juures kähardatud, paremal käel pruuni rihmaga käekell.(eesti)
10399.de: Against a pastel greenish background, a half-portrait in frontal view of a smiling woman with rosy cheeks sitting on a chair with her hands in her lap, wearing a dark blue dress with a colourful vest, short brown hair curled near the ears, on the right hand a wristwatch with a brown strap.

10401.dm: kujutise kõrgus: 43.0 cm; lehe laius: 70.0 cm; lehe kõrgus: 50.0 cm; kujutise laius: 62.0 cm
10401.d: Esiplaanil aimatav veekogu, kaldal paremal käharad puud, vasakul varemetes hele hoone, korstnajalad püsti. Hoone ees kaks inimkuju, parempoolne punases mantlis ja kübaraga. Sinkjaslillas taevas rohekad pilved. Krähmuline rahutu kujutamisviis, aluspind läbi kumamas.
10401.de: In the foreground a barely discernible body of water, on the bank on the right curly trees, on the left a light-coloured ruined building, chimney stacks standing. In front of the building two human figures, the right-hand one in a red coat and hat. Bluish-purple sky with greenish clouds. Scratchy restless manner of depiction, the underlying surface glowing through.

10410.d: Taburetile toetuva kirjus suvekleidis noore naise kolmveerandfiguur poolpöördes paremale, nägu vaatajale suunatud. Naisel helepruunid lokilised poolpikad juuksed. Parem käsi toetub taburetile, vasak süles. Heledad rohekad toonid, vaba maalilaad.
10410.de: Three-quarter figure of a young woman in a colorful summer dress, leaning on a stool, in half-turn to the right, face turned towards the viewer. The woman has light brown, curly, medium-length hair. Right hand resting on the stool, left in her lap. Light greenish tones, free painting style.

10416.dm: kujutise kõrgus: 40.0 cm; lehe laius: 65.0 cm; lehe kõrgus: 50.0 cm; kujutise laius: 55.0 cm
10416.d: Valdavalt ookerkollastes, tumepunastes toonides maastikuvaade hallika veekoguga esiplaanil. Üle vee vasakul paar pajupuud, kaldanõlval punakate lääpas katustega hooned, künka tipul kähar puu. Poolläbipaistev pühkemaneeris tehnika.
10416.de: A landscape view predominantly in ochre-yellow, dark red tones with a greyish body of water in the foreground. Over the water on the left a couple of willow trees, on the slope of the bank buildings with reddish hipped roofs, a curly tree on the top of a hill. Semi-transparent technique in a sweeping manner.

10420.d: Intensiivsetes rohelistes toonides põõsaste ja puude grupid nende vahelt paistva tumesinise taeva taustal. Esiplaanil, puude-põõsaste ees kirev oranži-ookertoonides lage ala.
10420.de: Groups of bushes and trees in intense green tones against a dark blue sky visible between them. In the foreground, in front of the trees and bushes, a colourful open area in orange-ochre tones.

10431.dm: kujutise kõrgus: 43.0 cm; lehe laius: 65.0 cm; lehe kõrgus: 50.0 cm; kujutise laius: 62.0 cm
10431.d: Vaade talvisele asulale läbi tumedate puuvõrade: lumiste viilkatustega. Madalad majad, nende vahel tossavad kõrged korstnad sinaka taeva taustal. Tumedale kontuurjoonele rajatud laad, osaliselt katmata aluspind.
10431.de: A view of a winter settlement through dark tree crowns: houses with snowy gable roofs. Low houses, tall smoking chimneys between them against a bluish sky. Composition built on dark contour lines, the underlying surface partly uncovered.

10432.d: Rohekas ülikonnas, valge särgi ja lipsuga, väikeste vunstidega mees hoiab käes paletti ja pintsleid. Teine käsi toetub põlvele, mehe taga seinal kaks maali.
10432.de: A man in a greenish suit, white shirt and tie, with a small moustache, holds a palette and brushes. His other hand rests on his knee, behind the man on the wall two paintings.

10439.d: Võitlus raudrüütlite ja eesti sõdalaste vahel. Esiplaanil vasakul kiivriga raudrüütel kilp seljal, keskel lamav eesti saadik, paremal mõõka tupest välja tõmbav eesti sõdalane.
10439.de: A battle between armoured knights and Estonian warriors. In the foreground on the left an armoured knight with a helmet and a shield on his back, in the centre a lying Estonian envoy, on the right an Estonian warrior drawing a sword from its sheath.

10443.dm: kujutise kõrgus: 34.0 cm; lehe laius: 65.0 cm; lehe kõrgus: 50.0 cm; kujutise laius: 41.0 cm
10443.d: Kulissidena paiknevate puude puhmaste vahelt avaneb vaade kaugusesse. Üksik raagus puu esiplaani keskel. Taamal üksikud punaste katustega majad maastikus. Silmapiiril sinkjas mets kollaka taeva all. Ekspressiivne rahutu laad, mürgised värvikooskõlad.
10443.de: Between clumps of trees arranged as coulisses a view opens into the distance. A single bare tree in the centre of the foreground. Further back, isolated houses with red roofs in the landscape. On the horizon a bluish forest under a yellowish sky. Expressive, restless manner, poisonous colour harmonies.

10444.d: Vaade kollasele mäenõlvakule põõsapuhmastega paremal. Silmapiiril künka harjal lilla krooniga puude vahelt paistmas punaste katustega valged majad. Erksavärviline, ekspressiivne laad.
10444.de: View of a yellow mountain slope with bushes on the right. On the horizon, on the ridge of a hill, white houses with red roofs showing between trees with purple crowns. Bright-coloured, expressive style.

10445.d: Väikese heledapäise tüdruku portree otsevaates. Seljas roosa lühikeste varrukatega kleit. Taust rohekas.
10445.de: Frontal portrait of a small fair-haired girl. Wearing a pink short-sleeved dress. Greenish background.

10446.dm: kujutise kõrgus: 43.0 cm; lehe laius: 70.0 cm; lehe kõrgus: 50.0 cm; kujutise laius: 62.0 cm
10446.d: Kahe täppivas laadis kollase-rohelisega kujutatud nõlva vahelt avaneb vaade  külmsinisele veekogule avara taevalaotuse all. Taevas kujutatud horisontaalsuunalises pühkemaneeris.
10446.de: Between two slopes depicted in a dotted manner in yellow-green, a view opens onto a cold-blue body of water under a vast expanse of sky. The sky is depicted in a horizontally swept manner.

10448.d: Post-impressionistlikes pintslitõmmetes roosasi ja siniseid toonivarjundeid vastandav pilt, käsi põsakil istuva naisega, kellel kuidagi endassevajunud pilk, süles musta-pruuni triibuline kass, rinnas hõbesõlg.
10448.de: A painting in Post-Impressionist brushstrokes contrasting pink and blue tonal shades, showing a woman sitting with her chin resting on her hand, her gaze somewhat withdrawn, a black-brown striped cat in her lap, a silver brooch on her chest.

10516.d: Ülaltvaade Tallinna vanalinna punastele katustele ja hallikatele majaplokkidele, mille vahel kõrgub vasakul Niguliste tornikiiver, paremal Toomkiriku torn valgete rünkpilvedega kaetud tumeda taeva taustal. Selgepiiriline illustratiivne maalilaad.
10516.de: A view from above of the red roofs and grayish house blocks of Tallinn's Old Town, among which on the left rises the spire of St. Nicholas' Church, and on the right the tower of the Cathedral, against the background of a dark sky covered with white cumulus clouds. A clear-outlined, illustrative painting style.

10531.d: Mere ja taeva taustal kaabuga noormehe poolfiguur veerandpöördes paremale, käte vahel kokku pigistatud purjeriie. Mehel piklik nägu, pilk alla suunatud. Seljas hele kuub, särk. Tema taga vasakul paistmas kaabulotiga vanamehe pea. Tuhmid tumedad pruunikasrohekad toonid.
10531.de: Against a background of sea and sky, the half-figure of a young man in a hat, in a quarter-turn to the right, holding a bundled sailcloth between his hands. The man has an elongated face, his gaze directed downward. Wearing a light-coloured coat and shirt. Behind him on the left, the head of an old man in a peaked cap is visible. Dull dark brownish-green tones.

10554.d: Kompositsioon võrku merest paatidesse sikutavate kaluritega. Kahel pool võrku paatides viis kaabudes meest, taustal vette ehitatud aedikud, taamal kallas puude ja hoonetega.
10554.de: Composition with fishermen pulling a net from the sea into boats. On either side of the net, five men in hats in boats, in the background enclosures built in the water, further back a shore with trees and buildings.

10569.d: Esiplaanil punaste juustega alasti naine puusast saati vees seismas, pea kallutatud paremale, üles seljataha tõstetud käed hoiavad roosakas-lillakat läbipaistva moega kangast. Taamal, päikeseloojangust lillakaks värvunud taeva  taustal  kaks tumedates toonides gorillat/ahvi.
10569.de: In the foreground a red-haired nude woman standing in water up to her hips, head tilted to the right, hands raised up behind her back holding a pinkish-purple, translucent-looking fabric. Further back, against a sky coloured purple by the sunset, two dark-toned gorillas/apes.

10570.d: Heledafooniline avar maastikuvaade, paremal keskel tuulik, selle ees seisva figuuri ja hobusega. Esiplaanil vasakul madalad muud, taamal paistab tume metsaviirg.
10570.de: A wide landscape view with a light background, on the right in the middle a windmill, in front of it a standing figure with a horse. In the foreground on the left low mounds, in the distance a dark strip of forest can be seen.

10571.d: Tinglikult antud linnavaade jõega keskel, mille ääres paremal hooned, vasakul puud. Esiplaanil vasakul ääres kolm seisvat figuuri.
10571.de: A conventionally rendered cityscape with a river in the middle, along which there are buildings on the right and trees on the left. In the foreground, on the left edge, three standing figures.

10574.d: Tumesinise veekogu ääres, roosat tooni rannaliival grupp inimesi supelkostüümides. Osa liival pikutamas, teised seismas. Ligi poole maalipinna ulatuses kujutatud valgete pilvedega tumesinine taevas.
10574.de: By a dark blue body of water, on pinkish-toned beach sand, a group of people in bathing costumes. Some lying on the sand, others standing. Almost half of the painted surface depicts a dark blue sky with white clouds.

10575.d: Pruunikal foonil, puidust laual sinisel taldrikul puuviljad, mille kõrval läbipaistvas vaasis lilleõis, õie südamik maalitud silmana. Vasakul nurgas seisab värvipaletti käes hoidev figuur.
10575.de: On a brownish background, on a wooden table on a blue plate fruits, beside which in a transparent vase a flower bloom, the flower's centre painted as an eye. In the left corner stands a figure holding a palette.

10579.d: Veekogu ääres viilkatusega maja, mille ees aimatavad paat ning kaks seisvat figuuri. Kujutised antud värvipinda kraabitud joonte abil.
10579.de: A house with a gabled roof by a body of water, in front of which a boat and two standing figures can be discerned. The images are rendered by lines scratched into the paint surface.

10580.d: Punakaspruuni fooniga ruumis valge lõuendi ees istuv kiilaspäine, pintslit käes hoidev kunstnik maalimisega alustamas. Pingil vasakul aimatavad erinevad nõud ja esemed.
10580.de: In a room with a reddish-brown background, a bald-headed artist holding a brush, sitting in front of a white canvas, about to begin painting. On the bench on the left, various vessels and objects can be discerned.

10581.d: Läbikumav, pastelsetes rohekassinakates toonides maastikuvaade. Keskel jõgi, mille paremal järsakul mets. Vasakul äärel põõsaid, väiksemaid puid esiplaanil
10581.de: A translucent landscape view in pastel greenish-blue tones. In the middle a river, on the right a steep bank with forest. On the left edge bushes, smaller trees in the foreground.

10582.d: Raamaturiiuli ees oleval laual ümar vaas erinevate suvelilledega, mille ees kaks raamatut. Vasakult langeb lauale hele kardin.
10582.de: On the table in front of the bookshelf a round vase with various summer flowers, in front of it two books. A light curtain falls onto the table from the left.

10584.d: Maastikuvaade, esiplaanil vasakul üksik kidur puu, taamal puudesalu ääres valge katusega hoone.
10584.de: Landscape view, in the foreground on the left a single stunted tree, in the background near a cluster of trees a building with a white roof.

10585.dm: kõrgus: 8.2 cm (vm); kujutise laius: 13.5 cm (km); kujutise kõrgus: 8.6 cm (km); laius: 12.3 cm (vm)
10585.d: Helesinises toonis maastikumotiiv. Taamal olev küngas, millel üksikuid maju ja puid, läheb sujuvalt üle veekoguks, millel kaks figuuri kahe paadi kõrval.
10585.de: Landscape motif in light blue tones. A hill in the distance, with a few houses and trees, merges smoothly into a body of water, on which two figures are seen beside two boats.

10586.dm: kujutise kõrgus: 8.5 cm; laius: 12.5 cm; kõrgus: 8.6 cm; kujutise laius: 12.7 cm
10586.d: Rohekas-sinaka fooniga veekogu, mille kaldal hooned ja puud.
10586.de: A body of water with a greenish-blue background, with buildings and trees on its shore.

10587.dm: kujutise laius: 13.5 cm; kujutise kõrgus: 8.0 cm
10587.d: Esiplaanil, rohekal maastikul inimeste grupp toimetamas madala ehitise ümber, mille kõrval hobune. Taamal puudesalu.
10587.de: In the foreground, on a greenish landscape, a group of people busy around a low structure, next to which a horse. A grove of trees in the distance.

10588.d: Töö keskel alt vasakust nurgast üles paremale kujutatud sild. Esiplaanil vasakul kõrged tihedad puud. Tagapool paistab värviküllane linnavaade. Impressionistlik maalilaad.
10588.de: In the middle of the work a bridge depicted from the bottom left corner up to the right. In the foreground on the left tall dense trees. Behind, a colourful view of the city can be seen. Impressionist painting style.

10589.d: Abstraheeritud ruumi taustal profiilis (seljaga vaataja poole?) kujutatud tumedate juuste ja punase mütsiga naise rindportree.
10589.de: Bust portrait of a woman with dark hair and a red hat, depicted in profile (back turned to the viewer?) against an abstracted spatial background.

10590.d: Heleroosa taeva taustal õrn sinakas-rohekates toonides maastikuvaade veekoguga, mille mõlemal kaldal puid, esiplaanil veekogu kaldal üksik figuur, taamal paistavad kõrgendikud.

10591.d: Metsalagendik, esiplaanil langetatud puid laasivad figuurid, ees paremal istub piipu suitsetav, kirvest põlvedele toetav mees. Tagapool hobuvanker ja mets.
10591.de: A forest clearing, in the foreground figures trimming felled trees, in front on the right a man sits smoking a pipe, resting an axe on his knees. Behind, a horse cart and forest.

10592.d: Impressionistlik linnavaade jõega, esiplaanil üks alus vees, kaldas paadid.
10592.de: Impressionist cityscape with a river, in the foreground a vessel in the water, boats on the bank.

10593.d: Helesinise fooniga, linna läbiv jõevaade kahe paadiga. Mõlemal pool hooned, siin-seal kaldal paate, ees paremal jalutavad figuurid, taamal paistab sild. Impressionistlik kujutamisviis.
10593.de: A view of a river running through a town, with a light blue background and two boats. Buildings on both sides, here and there boats on the shore, in front on the right strolling figures, in the distance a bridge can be seen. An impressionistic manner of depiction.

10596.d: Rohekates toonides istuva noore mehe portree poolprofiilis paremale. Hallikas pintsakus lahku kammitud soenguga mees istub kangaga kaetud toolil, üks käsi asetatud toolileenile, teine sülle.
10596.de: Portrait of a seated young man in greenish tones, in half profile to the right. The man, with hair combed apart, wears a greyish jacket and sits on a chair covered with fabric, one hand placed on the armrest, the other in his lap.

10597.d: Rahvariidesärgis ja tume vestiga habetunud hallipäise vanamehe portree poolpöördes vasakule, taustaks palkmaja sein ja lõikemustriga rahvakunstiese.
10597.de: Portrait of a bearded, grey-haired old man in a folk costume shirt and dark vest, in half-turn to the left, with a log-house wall and a folk-art object with a cut-out pattern as background.

10694.d: Pruunikates-rohekates toonides stseen lapsi süles hoidvate naiste ja kaluriga paadis. Esiplaanil kaks naist, kellest üks hoiab suuremat last ja teine imetab väiksemat last. Tagaplaanil paadi otsas köit hoidev kalur, taustaks tume lainetav meri.
10694.de: A scene in brownish-greenish tones showing women holding children in their laps and a fisherman in a boat. In the foreground two women, one of whom holds a larger child while the other is nursing a smaller child. In the background a fisherman at the end of the boat holding a rope, with a dark, wavy sea as backdrop.

10738.d: Helesinisel foonil, heledas riietuses tumeda peaga naisterahva rindportree.
10738.de: On a light blue background, bust portrait of a woman with a dark head, in light clothing.

10740.d: Tumedal foonil kiilaneva mehe rindportree. Pilk suunatud alla, käsi toetamas lõuga.
10740.de: Chest portrait of a balding man on a dark background. Gaze directed downward, hand supporting the chin.

10744.d: Visandlik rindportree paremale vaatavast noormehest halli pintsaku ning punase särgiga.
10744.de: Sketchy bust portrait of a young man looking to the right, wearing a grey jacket and a red shirt.

10752.d: Pruunides toonides naise portree pearätikuga. Pilk suunatud alla, alumises servas paistab figuuri parem käsi.
10752.de: A portrait in brown tones of a woman with a headscarf. Gaze directed downward, the figure's right hand visible at the lower edge.

10760.d: Noore naise pea otsevaates. Maali näo piirkond on välja joonistatud ja viimistletud, see-eest õlgu ja pead kattev rätt on visandlikus laadis.
10760.de: Head of a young woman, en face. The facial area of the painting is delineated and finished, whereas the shawl covering the shoulders and head is done in a sketchy manner.

10762.dm: lehe laius: 25.4 cm; lehe kõrgus: 36.4 cm
10762.d: Mehe täisfiguur profiilis vasemale jalutamispoosis. Paremas käes jalutuskepp, vasem puusal. Seljas frakk valge šabooga, jalas mahapööratud säärtega lakksaapad. Paremal varjukujutis.
10762.de: Full figure of a man in profile facing left, in a walking pose. In his right hand a walking stick, left hand on hip. Wearing a tailcoat with a white jabot, on his feet patent leather boots with turned-down tops. On the right a silhouette.

10763.d: Mehefiguur kerge pöördega vasemale. Seljas roheline frakk valge šabooga, peas kõrge kaabu. Käed piitsaga vaheliti rinnal. Nõjatub vasemale jalale, parem pisut kõverdatult ees. Paremal varjukutis.
10763.de: Male figure with a slight turn to the left. Wearing a green tailcoat with a white jabot, on his head a tall top hat. Hands crossed on the chest holding a whip. Leaning on the left leg, the right slightly bent in front. On the right a shadow silhouette.

10764.dm: lehe laius: 25.5 cm; lehe kõrgus: 36.4 cm
10764.d: Noorema naise figuur kerge pöördega vasemale. Pea õlgade vahel, käed hoiavad ees õlgadel asetsevat pikka salli. Taga varjukujutis.
10764.de: The figure of a younger woman with a slight turn to the left. Head between the shoulders, hands holding a long shawl lying across the shoulders in front. A silhouette behind.

10765.dm: lehe laius: 25.5 cm; lehe kõrgus: 36.4 cm
10765.d: Vana, küürus naise figuur profiilis vasemale. Seljas pikk rüü; õlgadel, kätelt alla rippuv punakas toonis rätt. Paremas käes kepp, vasak ees kobavas asendis. Taga tume varjukujutis.
10765.de: Figure of an old, stooped woman in profile facing left. Wearing a long robe; on her shoulders a reddish-toned shawl hanging down from her arms. In her right hand a stick, left hand extended in a groping gesture. Behind her a dark silhouette.

10766.dm: lehe laius: 27.5 cm; lehe kõrgus: 36.5 cm
10766.d: Naisfiguur poolprofiilis vasemale tantsimas. Riietatud avarasse seelikusse, pihik kitsas. Parem käsi asetatud ümber pea, vasem kõrval, õla kõrgusel, leht käes. Jalgade kõrgusel maastiku piirjooni, paremal lillekorv.
10766.de: A female figure dancing in half-profile to the left. Dressed in a wide skirt, tight bodice. Right hand placed around the head, left hand at the side, at shoulder height, holding a leaf. At the level of the legs the outlines of a landscape, on the right a flower basket.

10767.dm: lehe laius: 27.5 cm; lehe kõrgus: 36.5 cm
10767.d: Baleriinifiguur hüppe-poosis, pea pööratud vasemale. Kerges, õhulises kostüümis, tumedail juustel pärg. Parem jalg sirutatult vasemal, käed ristasendis rinnal.

10768.dm: lehe laius: 27.5 cm; lehe kõrgus: 36.5 cm
10768.d: Mehe tantsiv figuur poolprofiilis vasemale, hüpp-poosis - vasem jalg sirutatult ees, parem taga. Käed laiades varrukates, vasem puusas.

10770.d: Pikas punasega äärestatud sinakashalli tooniga vammuses hallijuukselise vanamehe täisfiguur otsevaates, pea pöördega vasakule. Kuuehõlm rinnale kinnitatud suure hoburaudsõlega, keskelt nahkrihmaga, mille küljes suur puss nahktupes. Varustuse juurde kuuluvad veel: krõllidega kee, käevõru ja karusnahast püstkõrvadega müts.
10770.de: A full-length frontal figure of a grey-haired old man in a long bluish-grey waistcoat trimmed with red, his head turned to the left. The coat's front is fastened at the chest with a large horseshoe-shaped brooch, and at the waist with a leather belt, from which hangs a large knife in a leather sheath. His attire also includes: a necklace with curls, a bracelet and a fur cap with upright ears.

10771.d: Laiaäärelist kübarat kandva kongusninalise mustaverd mehe täisfiguur poolprofiilis paremale. Riietuseks erinevate rinnapooltega, sakilise alläärega kuub, erinevat värvust säärtega püksid, teravaninalised, kannustega varustatud, pööratud säärega säärikud ja lai "tooga" tüüpi mantel. Käed kinnastatud, parem toetub puusale, vasem peos oleva piitsaga pisut ette sirutatud.
10771.de: Full figure of a dark-skinned man with an aquiline nose, wearing a wide-brimmed hat, in three-quarter profile facing right. His attire consists of a coat with differently shaped breast sides and a jagged lower hem, trousers with legs of different colours, sharp-toed spurred boots with turned-down tops, and a wide "toga"-type cloak. His hands are gloved, the right resting on his hip, the left slightly extended forward holding a whip.

10772.dm: lehe laius: 36.5 cm; lehe kõrgus: 51.2 cm
10772.d: Pruuni ääristusega halli tooni umbkuues ja sama värvust pükstes mehe täisfiguur profiilis paremale. Kaelus kinnitatud vitssõlega, ümber keha metallnaastudega nahkvöö, mille küljes pussitupp. Peakattena murumüts, jalas pööratud säärtega säärikud.
10772.de: Full figure of a man in profile to the right, wearing a gray overall with brown trim and trousers of the same color. The collar fastened with a twisted-wire clasp, around the body a leather belt with metal studs, from which hangs a knife sheath. Headgear a sedge cap, on his feet boots with turned-down tops.

10773.dm: lehe laius: 36.5 cm; lehe kõrgus: 51.2 cm
10773.d: Pruuni pronksnaastudega täiendatud ääristusega pihikut, hallpruuni tooni seelikut ja heledamat tooni pikavarrukalist särki kandva naistantsija kuju tantsupoosis, astuvana. Ülakeha kallutatud vasakule. Pihiku õlapaelad kinnitatud kolmekordset pronksist rinnakeed hoidvate rinnanõeltega; kaelusel suur hoburaudsõlg. Nahkvöö küljes rippumas tupes nuga ja nõelakoda.
10773.de: The figure of a female dancer in a dance pose, striding, wearing a bodice trimmed with an edging adorned with brown bronze studs, a greyish-brown skirt and a lighter-toned long-sleeved shirt. The upper body is tilted to the left. The bodice's shoulder straps are fastened with breast pins holding a triple bronze necklace; on the collar a large horseshoe brooch. Hanging from the leather belt is a sheathed knife and a needle case.

10774.dm: lehe laius: 36.5 cm; lehe kõrgus: 51.2 cm
10774.d: Punaka ääristusega halli tooni umbkuube ja sama värvi pikki pükse kandva mehe täisfiguur profiilis, sammuvana paremalt vasakule. Umbkuub keskelt kinnitatud nahkvööga, kaeluse juurest suure vitssõelaga. Mehel ettesirutatud paremas käes laiateraline kirves.
10774.de: Full figure, in profile, of a man wearing a grey overcoat with a reddish trim and trousers of the same colour, striding from right to left. The overcoat fastened in the middle with a leather belt, at the collar with a large wattle brooch. In the man's outstretched right hand a broad-bladed axe.

10775.dm: lehe laius: 36.5 cm; lehe kõrgus: 51.2 cm
10775.d: Pikas pruuni tooni vammuses, millele on tõmmatud rõngassärk harkisjalu seisva mehe täisfiguur eestvaates, pea pööratud parema õla suunas. Mehel paremas käes paljastatud kaheteraline mõõk, kuna rohekat tooni laia sõbataolise mantli varju jääv  vasak käsi hoiab sõõrjat puukilpi, metallist pideme ja sõrmekaitsega tsentrumis.
10775.de: The full figure, in frontal view, of a man in a long brown-toned tunic, standing with legs apart, over which is drawn a ring-mail shirt, his head turned toward his right shoulder. In his right hand the man holds a bared double-edged sword, while his left hand, falling into the shadow of a wide, wolf-like cloak of a greenish tone, holds a round wooden shield with a metal handle and finger-guard at the centre.

10780.d: Kikkhabemega istuva mehe kolmveerand figuur. Pea kerge pöördega paremale. Parem käsi tooli külgleenil, vasak süles.
10780.de: Three-quarter figure of a seated man with a goatee. Head slightly turned to the right. Right hand on the armrest of the chair, left in his lap.

10781.d: Vana naise põlvpilt otsevaates. Naisel suurrätt õlgadel, käed ristamisi asetatult toetumas kepile.
10781.de: Frontal knee-length portrait of an old woman. The woman has a large shawl on her shoulders, hands crossed and resting on a cane.

10849.d: Pehmes tugitoolis istuva tütarlapse kolmveerand figuur. Pea kerge pöördega vasakule, keha paremale. Peas punane barett.
10849.de: Three-quarter figure of a girl sitting in a soft armchair. Head turned slightly to the left, body to the right. A red beret on her head.

10884.d: Rätikuga naise portree kolmveerandpöördes vasakule. Naisel seljas valge pluus ja oranžikas pealisriie ning käes sinine lilleõis. Taustal maastik taeva ja puudega.
10884.de: Portrait of a woman with a headscarf in a three-quarter turn to the left. The woman is wearing a white blouse and an orangish outer garment and holds a blue flower in her hand. Background a landscape with sky and trees.

10911.d: Lühikese blondi soenguga noore naise figuurportree veerandpöördes paremale. Portreteeritu istub taburetil, käed ristis. Tema seljas on sinine jakk, bordoo seelik, valge sall, peas tumepruun kübar.
10911.de: Figure portrait of a young woman with short blonde hair, in a quarter-turn to the right. The sitter is seated on a stool, hands crossed. She is wearing a blue jacket, a burgundy skirt, a white shawl, and a dark brown hat on her head.

10936.d: Varemete taustal istuvad kõrvuti vaataja suunas neli täiskasvanut ja kolm last: vasakult, mustas mantlis kübaraga naine, komps kaenlas; heledas mantlis, pruuni seelikuga pearätis naine, käed süles. Keskel punase kübaraga noor naine heledas riietuses, sülelaps põlvedel; seisab tütarlaps paljajalu, mantlihõlmad lahti; poolkülgvaates mees paljapäi, toasussides, mantel õlgadel, tema taga poisikese kuju. Inimeste ees kööginõude kuhjad, topsid, kontsaking, ämber asjadega.
10936.de: Against a background of ruins, four adults and three children sit side by side facing the viewer: from the left, a woman in a black coat with a hat, a bundle under her arm; a woman in a light coat, brown skirt and headscarf, hands in her lap. In the centre a young woman with a red hat in light-coloured clothing, a child in her arms on her knees; a girl stands barefoot, her coat flaps open; a man in half-profile, bareheaded, in house slippers, a coat over his shoulders, behind him the figure of a boy. In front of the people, piles of kitchen utensils, cups, a heeled shoe, a bucket with things in it.

10943.dm: kujutise kõrgus: 22.5 cm; kujutise laius: 31.5 cm

10945.dm: kujutise kõrgus: 16.0 cm; kujutise laius: 20.5 cm

10963.de: Hara Location on object: Lower left corner

10973.d: Hara Asukoht objektil: Alumises paremas nurgas
10973.de: Hara. Location on the object: In the lower right corner

10976.dm: kõrgus: 17.7 cm; laius: 25.5 cm; Talvine agulivaade: aknast paistab väike sisehoov ja puidust majad.

11005.dm: kõrgus: 29.5 cm; laius: 30.1 cm; kõrgus: 40.5 cm (raamiga); laius: 41.9 cm (raamiga)

16839.d: See on see pilt, mis viis mind hullumajja. Maalitud 25-26 nov. 1948 a. 2-he lühikeseseansi jooksul pärast Leningradi reisust saadud ergutavaid muljeid. Maalitud vana töö pääle. Õli õrn-, värvi- ja nüansirikas etüüd. See, koos teistega oli mõeldud järgnevalt kavatsetava tõsisema tööperioodi alustuseks - kuna juba tükil ajal tundsin end pahasti ja ei saanud töötada vahepääl. Lakkimisel 28. nov - 1. dets. 1948 a. täielikult riknenud (läks väga tumedaks, poriseks, koloriit kadus, värv sulas üles, jooksis kokku ja aluspõhi tuli mitmest kohast nähtavale, sest et pealmine oli hävinenud. Sellele sündmusele järgnes suur meeleheit ja mitmeks ööks unetus. Edasi arenesid kõige raskemad hingelised läbiel
16839.de: This is the painting that drove me to the madhouse. Painted 25-26 Nov. 1948 in 2 short sessions after the stimulating impressions gained from a trip to Leningrad. Painted over an old work. A tender, colour- and nuance-rich oil study. This, together with others, was meant as the beginning of a more serious working period planned to follow - since for some time already I had been feeling unwell and had not been able to work in the meantime. Completely ruined during varnishing 28 Nov - 1 Dec 1948 (became very dark, muddy, the colour scheme was lost, the paint dissolved, ran together and the underlying ground became visible in several places, because the top layer had been destroyed). This event was followed by great despair and sleeplessness for several nights. Further on developed the most difficult mental experi[ences]

24640.d: Maalil kolm puud, tee. Teel kahehobuserakend, puude juures kaks naist, üks istub kivil, teisel on käes korv, üle tee veel kahe naise kogud. Maal süngetes sisakasrohelistes toonides, taevas sünge.
24640.de: The painting shows three trees, a road. On the road a two-horse carriage, by the trees two women, one sitting on a stone, the other holding a basket, across the road the figures of two more women. The painting in gloomy bluish-green tones, the sky gloomy.

24641.d: Maalil süngetes toonides taust, esiplaanil kolm puud, neist kaks kõrvuti vasakul pool, üks veidi eemal. Keskel ebamäärane meesterahva kuju, kes seisab arvatavasti põleva lõkke juures. Halliks värvitud raam.
24641.de: In the painting, a sombre-toned background, in the foreground three trees, two of them side by side on the left, one somewhat farther away. In the middle an indistinct figure of a man, presumably standing by a burning fire. Frame painted grey.

24645.d: Mehe rinnaportree otse vaates, mehel on tumedad juuksed, heledad silmad, seljal valge särk ja must pintsak. Rinnaportree taust paremal punastes toonides, vasakul kollastes toonides.(eesti)
24645.de: Frontal bust portrait of a man, the man has dark hair, light eyes, wearing a white shirt and a black jacket. The background of the bust portrait is in reddish tones on the right, yellowish tones on the left.

24646.d: Naise rinnaportree otse vaates. Naine on tumedate juuste ja pruunide simadega, seljas valge pluus. Taustaks punakad toonid.

24647.d: Mehe rinnaportree, külgvaates. Mehel on tumedad juuksed, heledad silmad, seljas  pruun-lillakas särk. Maali taust rohekates-hallides toonides.
